title: Real Estate Financial Analyst / Land Appraiser - Land Development & JV Modeling
description:
Real Estate Financial Analyst / Land Appraiser — Land Development & JV Modeling

Fully Remote · Philippines-Based · Full-Time · US Central Time Shift · Reports Directly to the VP of Operations



Why This Role Exists

We are a Central Texas land development and investment firm doing what most of our competitors cannot: turning raw acreage tracts of varying sizes into fully platted, revenue-generating subdivisions. We move fast, we structure JVs directly with landowners, and we deploy real capital on real deals every month.



The problem: our deal flow is outrunning our modeling capacity. Feasibility studies, absorption schedules, and JV waterfalls are stacking up on the VP of Operations' desk — and every day one sits there is a day a deal moves slower. That is where you come in.



What Success Looks Like in 90 Days

• You have taken 3+ live deals from raw acreage to landowner-ready JV pitch — independently.

• The VP of Operations and Founder review your models at the assumption layer, not the formula layer.

• Landowners see your work directly. Your name is on the pro forma at the meeting.



What You Will Actually Do

• Turn raw land into revenue models. Take a raw acreage tract — size depends on the project — decide the lot cut, allocate infrastructure cost, phase the release, and build the per-lot P&L.

• Model absorption like a real one. Monthly ramp schedules by phase — no flat annual averages, no divide-by-12.

• Run Sales Comparable Analyses on land and lots using aged, expired, and active comps to establish real value and defensible days-on-market.

• Build JV waterfalls that hold up under an attorney's audit — preferred returns, pari-passu tiers, IRR hurdles, promote splits, land-contribution structures.

• Produce investor-facing return summaries (IRR, equity multiple, cash-on-cash) for our own JV investment deals — reviewed by ownership and counsel prior to distribution.

• Package landowner-ready decks and spreadsheets that need no revisions before they hit a Zoom call.

• Sit in on live deal calls with US ownership and iterate on assumptions in real time.



Required — Non-Negotiable

• 3–5 years institutional real estate underwriting at Colliers, JLL, Leechiu, Santos Knight Frank, Cushman & Wakefield, CBRE PH, Ayala Land, Megaworld, SMDC, or equivalent.

• Portfolio of at least 2 land or JV models you personally built (anonymized acceptable).

• Demonstrated absorption rate modeling — you must be able to show a live sample ramped monthly schedule during the interview.

• Working knowledge of JV waterfall structures — preferred returns, pari-passu tiers, IRR hurdles, promote splits.

• Advanced Excel — dynamic formulas, sensitivity/data tables, scenario toggles, INDEX/MATCH, XIRR.

• Fluent business English — written and spoken, for direct communication with US ownership and occasional landowner presentations.

• Willing and able to work US Central Time business hours — 7:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Central Time (approximately 8:00 PM to 6:00 AM Philippine Time). This is a hard requirement: our deals happen on Texas time, and you sit on the Texas team.

Preferred (Not Required)

title: Project coordinator
description:
Part-Time Remote Construction Project Coordinator

20hrs 



We are a high-end residential glass and glazing contractor in California looking for a reliable part-time remote Construction Project Coordinator to help organize and maintain our project information.



This position will start by working directly with the company owner to set up and improve our project systems. As the person learns our business and projects, the role may expand into field coordination, project follow-up and daily job-status reporting.



Initial Responsibilities



The first phase of this role will focus on:



* Setting up and organizing our Google Drive project folder structure

* Creating consistent folders for all active projects

* Organizing plans, shop drawings, RFIs, field notes, schedules, quotes and project documents

* Reviewing and monitoring our DropTask project/task system

* Reviewing CompanyCam photos and project activity

* Keeping project information organized and current

* Working directly with the owner to understand what has been completed and what remains on each job

* Helping identify missing information, outstanding items and follow-ups

* Maintaining accurate project status information

* Helping improve our overall project tracking process



Potential Future Responsibilities



Once you understand our projects and systems, the role may expand to include:



* Daily communication with field lead employees

* Collecting job-status updates

* Updating completed work and remaining work

* Tracking items we are waiting on from contractors, architects or suppliers

* Following up on routine project items

* Maintaining project schedules

* Preparing short daily or weekly project-status summaries

* Communicating with contractors and suppliers on straightforward coordination items



Required Skills



* Excellent spoken and written English

* Previous experience with a U.S. construction company, contractor, subcontractor or construction-related business

* Strong understanding of construction terminology

* Familiar with RFIs, submittals, shop drawings, schedules, punch lists and project documentation

* Strong Google Drive and Google Workspace skills

* Very organized and detail-oriented

* Comfortable learning new software and systems

* Able to take unorganized project information and create a clear, logical system

* Comfortable working directly with a business owner

* Reliable internet connection and professional working environment



Experience with glass, windows, doors or architectural construction is helpful but not required.



Schedule



Approximately 15–20 hours per week to start.



Some overlap with Pacific Time business hours is required.



As the role develops, availability during the afternoon Pacific Time may become important for field coordination.



Compensation



Starting around $8–$10 USD per hour, depending on experience and communication ability.



There is potential for increased hours and responsibility as the position develops.



How to Apply



Please include:



1. A short description of your construction experience.

2. Your experience organizing Google Drive or construction project files.

3. Your experience with project-management or task-tracking software.

4. Any experience with construction photo/documentation software.

5. Your available working hours in Pacific Time.

6. A 1–2 minute voice recording introducing yourself and explaining your previous construction experience.



Applications without a voice recording will not be considered.



We are looking for someone who can first help us build a strong project organization system and then grow into a broader project-coordination role.

title: Bookkeeper for Canadian E-Commerce Brand
description:
ABOUT US

We're a Canadian DTC tea brand and sell through our Shopify store. We ship to the US and Canada from warehouses in both countries.



We're a startup and currently mid-six figures in annual revenue and growing. We transact in both USD and CAD, with most sales in USD.



We want to transition from an automated bookkeeping tool (Finaloop) to QuickBooks Online and looking for a detail-oriented bookkeeper to own our books going forward. We're looking for someone who wants to build a long-term relationship and grow with us - not a short-term gig.



THE SCOPE

Phase One: Catchup & Cleanup (First 1-2 Months)

You'll start by reconciling and cleaning up our books for the current year so far. This includes setting up a clean chart of accounts in QuickBooks Online, importing historical transactions, and getting everything reconciled and audit-ready.



Phase Two: Ongoing Monthly Management

Once the books are clean, this transitions into a long-term monthly role covering everything below.



RESPONSIBILITIES

Transaction Management

- Categorize and reconcile all bank and credit card transactions in QuickBooks Online

- Reconcile Shopify payouts against actual orders and refunds

- Reconcile multi-currency accounts (USD + CAD) - you must ensure the bank balance in QBO matches the statement exactly, including handling exchange rate differences

- Match and track Meta 
/Instagram) ad spend invoices against bank withdrawals

- Process and track expenses - supplier invoices, 3PL fees, freight, customs charges, software subscriptions

- Ensure every transaction has proper supporting documentation



Canadian Tax Compliance

- Prepare and file quarterly GST/HST returns

- Match receipts and invoices to maximize input tax credits (ITCs)

- Track provincial sales tax obligations

- Track US sales tax exposure (we use Shopify's auto-tax, but you'll verify)



Monthly Reporting

- Prepare monthly Profit & Loss, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow statements

- Flag anomalies, unusual charges, or budget variances

- Provide financial clarity to founders - not just numbers, but what they mean



Inventory & COGS

- Track landed costs (product cost + ocean freight + customs duties + warehousing)

- Maintain accurate COGS records aligned with inventory movements

- Reconcile inventory valuation quarterly



Expense Tracking

- Track recurring software costs

- Track supplier invoices, 3PL fees, freight, and customs charges

- Ensure all expenses are properly categorized and documented



Year-End

- Prepare working papers and schedules for our CPA/accountant

- Support annual corporate tax return preparation

- Prepare any required slips



REQUIRED TECH STACK (Do Not Apply Without This Experience)



- QuickBooks Online - Expert level. This is non-negotiable.

- Multi-Currency Banking  - We operate in USD and CAD. You must have experience reconciling multi-currency accounts and handling exchange rates so the bank balance in QBO matches the statement to the penny.

- Shopify - Experience reconciling Shopify payouts to QBO.

- Google Sheets - Comfortable with ad-hoc reports and collaboration.



REQUIREMENTS

Must Have:

- 3+ years of bookkeeping experience using QuickBooks Online

- Experience with Canadian GST/HST filing and input tax credits

- Experience with e-commerce businesses (Shopify strongly preferred)

- Experience reconciling multi-currency accounts (USD + CAD)

- Strong attention to detail - we have zero tolerance for sloppy entries

- Fluent in English with strong written communication



Nice to Have:

- Experience with DTC or subscription-based businesses

- Experience with inventory accounting and landed cost tracking

- Previous experience transitioning a company from another system onto QuickBooks



HOURS & COMPENSATION

- Part-time to start - most likely 10-20 hours a month as we're still a small business, but expect it to grow as we scale

- Schedule: Flexible, but must have overlap with Pacific Time for communication

- Rate: $5–$10 USD/hour depending on experience

- Long-term: We want someone who grows with us. This is not a one-off project.



WHAT THIS ROLE IS

- A key financial support role for a growing e-commerce brand

- Someone who brings order, accuracy, and visibility to our finances



WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT



- Not basic data entry

- Not a once-a-month check-in

- Not suitable for someone who needs constant direction



HOW TO APPLY

We ignore generic cover letters. To show us you've read this posting and have the attention to detail we need, please follow these steps:



**Step 1:** Start your message with the word TEA.



**Step 2:** In your message, answer the following questions:



**Question A:** We use multi-currency banking (USD and CAD). How do you handle the exchange rate difference in QBO when reconciling a multi-currency account to ensure the bank balance matches the statement?



**Question B:** We receive Shopify payouts approximately 3 times per week. Each payout bundles sales, refunds, fees, and adjustments. How would you reconcile these in QBO? Walk us through your approach.



**Question C:** What is your experience with Canadian GST/HST input tax credits? Give us a specific example of how you've maximized ITCs for a previous client.



**Question D:** We track our true landed COGS (product cost + inbound freight + duties + 3PL) in a separate inventory system that produces a monthly COGS figure. In QuickBooks Online, walk us through exactly how you'd record COGS each month so our P&L and balance sheet stay accurate. Be specific about which accounts you'd use and what entries you'd make.



**Step 3:** Include the following:

- A short intro about yourself and your bookkeeping experience

- Your experience with e-commerce / Shopify businesses specifically

- Your expected monthly rate in PHP

- Your available hours and timezone

- Your QuickBooks Online proficiency self-rating (1-10)



Applications that do not answer the screening questions will not be considered. We value accuracy, initiative, and clear communication.

You should also be comfortable identifying sales opportunities and confidently recommending or upselling SmileFam products when appropriate.

* Has excellent spoken and written English.

* Has experience in cold calling, outbound calling, sales, appointment setting, telemarketing, or customer success.

* Knows how to build rapport quickly and maintain professional relationships.

* Is comfortable asking for the sale and recommending additional products.

* Is highly organized and consistent with follow-ups.

* Is goal-oriented and motivated by achieving targets.

* Can work independently with minimal supervision.

* Has a reliable internet connection and a quiet work environment suitable for making calls.

* Has experience using Google Sheets, CRMs, or other customer management tools.



Bonus Points If You Have Experience With:



- Google Review campaigns

- Customer retention

- Upselling and cross-selling

- E-commerce or product sales

- CRM systems

-Working with international clients



What We Offer:



- Full-time remote work

- Long-term opportunity for the right candidate

- Supportive and collaborative team environment

-Performance-based growth opportunities



Important: Please Read Before Applying



We are looking for someone who is comfortable being on the phone and speaking with clients every day.



This position requires someone who can confidently communicate, follow up consistently, build trust, and identify opportunities to generate additional sales.



If you are someone who is afraid to make calls, uncomfortable handling objections, or prefers a purely administrative role, this position may not be the right fit for you.



How to Apply



Please send us the following:

 - Introduction about yourself.

Send your application to:

title: VSL VIDEO EDITORS (E-commerce Brand)
description:

title: Data Entry
description:
Data Entry / Admin Specialist – HubSpot

About Us



Go Tours USA is a growing U.S.-based tours and transportation company dedicated to creating memorable travel experiences. We specialize in tours, adventure experiences, cultural excursions, and reliable transportation services that help travelers discover the best destinations across the United States.



Our mission is to provide exceptional service while creating enjoyable and unforgettable experiences for our guests. We deeply value our Philippine team and warmly welcome new members to join our growing family.



As our company continues to grow, we are looking for a detail-oriented Admin / Data Entry Specialist with HubSpot experience to support our team by maintaining accurate records and helping keep our daily operations organized.



This is a long-term remote position for someone who enjoys structure, documentation, research, organization, and improving systems and processes.



Position Overview



The Data Entry / Admin Specialist will be responsible for entering, updating, reviewing, and maintaining accurate information across our systems, with a strong focus on HubSpot CRM.



The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, reliable, and comfortable working with data. You should be able to identify errors, keep information organized, follow established processes, and continuously look for ways to improve efficiency.



Key Responsibilities

Enter and maintain accurate customer and business information in HubSpot CRM.

Update contact records, customer information, deals, and other CRM data.

Review existing records for accuracy and completeness.

Identify and correct duplicate, outdated, or incorrect information.

Maintain clean and organized CRM records.

Perform regular data entry and data maintenance tasks.

Organize and update spreadsheets, databases, and tracking documents.

Research and verify information when needed.

Assist with customer and booking information management.

Track and update important details, statuses, and follow-ups.

Organize digital files and documentation.

Assist with creating and maintaining internal documentation and procedures.

Follow established workflows and processes accurately.

Help identify opportunities to improve data management and administrative processes.

Support the team with additional administrative tasks as needed.

Communicate with team members regarding missing, incomplete, or incorrect information.

Requirements

HubSpot experience is required.

Previous experience in data entry, administration, CRM management, or a similar position.

Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.

Strong written and spoken English.

Comfortable working with large amounts of information.

Strong organizational and time-management skills.

Good computer and internet skills.

Experience with Google Sheets and/or Microsoft Excel.

Ability to follow processes and instructions carefully.

Ability to identify problems and correct errors independently.

Reliable and consistent work habits.

Comfortable working independently in a remote environment.

Willingness to learn new tools and systems.

Preferred Experience



Experience with any of the following is a plus:



HubSpot CRM

CRM data management

Data cleaning

Customer database management

Lead management

Booking or reservation systems

Tours and travel industry

Customer service

Google Workspace

Microsoft Excel

Online research

Process documentation

SOPs and workflow management

Ideal Candidate



We are looking for someone who:



Takes accuracy and attention to detail seriously.

Enjoys organized, structured work.

Is dependable and takes ownership of responsibilities.

Can work independently without constant supervision.

Is comfortable researching information and finding answers.

Can recognize errors and solve problems.

Enjoys improving systems and processes.

Learns new software and tools quickly.

Is looking for a long-term opportunity with a growing company.

Wants to become a valued member of our Philippine team.

What We Offer

100% Remote Work

Long-term employment opportunity

Stable position with a growing U.S.-based tours company

Supportive and professional team environment

Opportunity to learn new systems and technology

Opportunities for growth and additional responsibilities

A company culture that values and appreciates our Philippine team

title: Growth Marketer — Meta Ads, Video & Social (DTC Brand)
description:
Kiddocap is a Canadian safety brand. We make an innovative protective headgear

for toddlers, we sell in Canada only, and we have a lot more products coming.



Here is where we actually are. We spend over CA$250 a day across Meta and

TikTok. Our blended ROAS is around 1. We are losing money on every single

order, and we have been for months.



Our founder is in China on a business trip for the next three months. He is

running the ads himself and he needs help — not someone to hand tasks to,

someone who knows how to make an ad account profitable and will take that on.



You will work Manila hours and speak with him live during your day. No

graveyard shift, no waiting fifteen hours for an answer.



We are small, so the job is broad. You will make ads. You will run our social

accounts. You will dig into the numbers and tell us what they mean. Some weeks

one of those takes over completely. If you want a narrow role with a fixed list

of duties, this is not it.



YOU WILL OWN



Making the ads — short-form video and static, hooks, scripts, the whole thing

Creative strategy: the angles, where they come from, and why they should work

The decision of what to kill, what to scale, and when

Organic social across Instagram, 
 and

Reading the numbers and turning them into decisions, weekly

Cost per order — this is the number you are judged on



WE WANT SOMEONE WHO



Has at least 3 years on Meta ads for e-commerce, direct response

Can explain Meta's delivery and learning mechanics simply

Is genuinely good at hooks and short-form video editing

Can grow a social account, not just post to one

Learns fast and stays current — you know what works on Meta this month, not

what worked two years ago

Uses data to make creative decisions, not to justify them afterwards

Writes excellent English

Owns the problem instead of waiting for instructions



Big advantages

You have taken a small brand and helped it scale

You have worked on a baby, kids, parenting or pediatric brand

You can film your own content

You speak French



We want someone who looks at our account and thinks:



"Here is what is wrong. Here is what I would change first. And here is what I

would need from you to be sure."



WHY THIS IS WORTH YOUR TIME



Most remote marketing jobs are maintenance. Keep the machine running, fill the

calendar, send the report.



This is the opposite. The brand is not profitable yet and one person can change

that. You would not be helping from the outside — you would be part of it, at

the exact point where it turns.



And you are not the one carrying the risk. The company is funded well beyond

what the brand currently earns, so this role does not depend on next month's

sales. Your base is guaranteed from day one. The bonus is upside on top of it.



This is not a two-month contract. We have a much larger product range coming and

we are looking for the person who is still here when this is a serious brand.



We want you to become necessary.



COMPENSATION



₱62,000/month base (about US$1,000), paid twice monthly via Wise



Monthly performance bonus based on account ROAS:

1.5 or above ₱6,200 (US$100)

1.8 or above ₱12,400 (US$200)

2.1 or above ₱18,500 (US$300)

2.5 or above ₱24,700 (US$400)

3 or above ₱31,000 (US$500)



13th month pay · HMO health coverage after 90 days

Salary review at 6 months — we expect this to go up



TO APPLY



Start your message with the word BLUE, or we will not read it.



Please send:



1. A short video introduction, under 3 minutes. Walk us through one piece of

your work — what you were trying to do and whether it worked.



2. 3-5 links to Meta ads you personally worked on: the brand, your actual role,

and what happened to the numbers.



3. One social account you grew, and where it started.



4. The challenge.



Here is where we are. Canadian safety brand, protective headgear for

toddlers, Canada only. Over CA$250 a day across Meta and TikTok. Blended

ROAS around 1 — we lose money on every order. Product sells for CA$69.99,

average order CA$85.



On Meta we run one campaign, one ad set, broad targeting. Last month we

launched 15 ads into it at once. One ad absorbed 79% of the spend and

produced 18 of the 21 sales. Eleven of the others received under CA$60 each.



Tell us what you would do.



We are not going to tell you what to look at, or where to find it. Working

that out is part of the test.



The more specific your answer is to us, the more seriously we take it. If you

tell us something about our brand that we did not tell you here, that is

exactly what we are looking for. Answers that could apply to any e-commerce

brand will not be read twice.



300 words maximum.



NO AGENCIES. We are hiring directly.

Applications without a video will not be reviewed.



Shortlist gets a paid US$50 test task on real footage from our brand — paid

whether or not we hire you. The two best have a video call with the founder,

then a 30-day paid trial at full salary.

title: Amazon Customer Support Specialist
description:
Company: Black Voyage (US e-commerce brand)

Location: Remote

Pay: 3-5USD [ / hour (based on experience) + raises for high performers



Quick Highlights

Own and elevate our entire customer support operation — not just answer tickets

Weekly sync 1–2x/week (10:00–11:00 AM Manila time) — no daily night shifts

You'll build and refine the SOPs, templates, and dashboards the team runs on

Direct line to leadership — your calls on tone, escalations, and process will shape the brand's customer experience

About Black Voyage



Black Voyage is a fast-growing US e-commerce brand specializing in premium vacuum compression travel gear. In our first year, we achieved multi-million USD revenue across Amazon and Shopify. Our customers are frequent travelers who care deeply about design, efficiency, and smart packing.



We're a small, fast-moving team that values: clarity, ownership, empathy, and high-quality communication.



Schedule



Flexible hours, with availability for a weekly team sync (1–2x/week) during Manila/Taiwan time 10:00–11:00 AM. In most weeks, you'll receive written priorities after the sync; live attendance may not always be required.



Role Overview



We're hiring a Customer Support Specialist to own the customer experience function end-to-end — not just handling tickets, but building the systems, standards, and (eventually) team that keep our support operation sharp as we scale.



This is not a "follow the script" job. We want someone who can set the standard, catch problems before they escalate, and make judgment calls when situations fall outside SOPs.



Focus Split (Typical)



Customer Support Oversight & Escalation Ownership: ~40–50%

Process, SOPs & Quality Management: ~25–30%

Reporting, Metrics & Dashboards: ~15–20%

Cross-functional Coordination (Ops/Influencer support as needed): ~10%

What You'll Do



1) Customer Support Oversight



Own the customer support inbox/queue end-to-end — response quality, tone, and turnaround time

Personally handle or review the most sensitive, high-risk cases (chargeback threats, angry customers, PR-sensitive situations)

Set and enforce response-time and resolution-quality standards



2) Risk & Escalation Management



Own the escalation process for disputes, chargebacks, and 1-star review threats

Make judgment calls on refund/compensation decisions within approved guidelines, and flag exceptions to the CEO

Identify recurring issues (product, shipping, policy) and proactively raise them before they become bigger problems



3) Process, SOPs & Quality



Build, document, and continuously improve customer support SOPs, macros, and templates

Spot-check ticket quality and provide coaching/feedback as the team grows

Maintain a clean, well-organized knowledge base so answers stay consistent



4) Reporting & Metrics



Track and report on key support metrics (response time, resolution time, CSAT, chargeback rate)

Maintain dashboards and trackers (Google Sheets / Notion) that give leadership a clear view of support health

Surface trends and recommendations based on the data, not just raw numbers



5) Cross-functional Support (as needed)



Coordinate with Operations on order/shipping-related support issues

Support light influencer/creator communication using existing templates and guidelines when needed

Who You Are

Excellent written English (you can switch tone: warm & professional for customers; clear & direct with the team/leadership)

Proven experience owning or managing a customer support function, ideally in e-commerce/DTC

Detail-oriented and structured — comfortable managing volume without dropping threads or letting quality slip

Emotionally intelligent — you can de-escalate, stay calm under pressure, and choose the right level of firmness

A builder, not just an operator — you improve the system, not just execute it

Resourceful problem-solver (you try to find the answer first, then ask smart questions when needed)

Tech-comfortable (Shopify +Amazon + Google Workspace is a plus, but not required)

How to Apply (Single-Step — Please Follow Exactly)



We're looking for candidates with strong attention to detail. Applications that don't follow instructions may be ignored.



 to 
 

with the subject line:

Customer Support Team Assistant



In your
, include ALL 3 items below:



1) Resume

Attach as PDF or share a link.



2) 1–2 Minute Loom Video

Briefly introduce yourself and answer:

"Tell us about a time you had to build or improve a process (not just follow one) at work. What did you do, and what was the result?"



3) Written Exercise (Copy & Paste Answers into the
)



Task A (Customer Support – Chargeback Prevention)

A customer is furious. They
:

"I never received my package! You guys stole my money. Refund me immediately or I'm calling my bank!"

You check tracking and it shows Delivered, with a clear Proof of Delivery (POD) photo showing the package at their front door.

Write your reply.

Goal: De-escalate their anger, show empathy, reduce chargeback risk, provide the POD info, and guide next steps.



Task B (Process/Quality Judgment Call)

You notice that 3 different customers this week have complained about the same issue (e.g., a packaging defect) but each was handled differently by past responses — one got a full refund, one got a partial refund, one got only an apology.

What would you do? Write a short plan (a few sentences) covering: (1) how you'd handle the current cases fairly, and (2) what you'd put in place going forward to prevent inconsistent handling.



Technical Requirements (Must Have)

Reliable internet (minimum 20 Mbps)

Backup internet option (mobile hotspot is fine)

Laptop/PC capable of multitasking

Interview Process



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a single interview. No second-round assignments.

title: Operations Manager
description:
The Operations Manager runs the operational backbone of the business and acts as the Management Representative for our Integrated Management System. You will keep day-to-day operations running smoothly and compliantly — procurement, supplier, asset and access management, business continuity, document control and cross-department coordination across our UK and Philippines teams — while owning the QMS, ISMS and AIMS: maintaining them, keeping them audit-ready, running internal audits and management reviews, and driving continual improvement. You will also run the quarterly project cadence that keeps every department's projects on track. It is a hands-on governance and operations leadership role reporting directly to the Managing Director, with scope to build an Operations Assistant function and automate recurring work.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Integrated Management System & governance (Management Representative)

• Establish, maintain and continually improve the IMS across ISO 9001, ISO 27001 and ISO 42001, and report its performance to top management.

• Own the internal audit programme end-to-end — plan, schedule, conduct or coordinate audits, log findings and drive them to closure; act as primary liaison with BSI and external/certification auditors.

• Organise and facilitate management reviews; capture minutes, decisions and actions.

• Run document control: the controlled-document register, version control, scheduled reviews and approvals.

• Coordinate nonconformity and corrective/preventive action (NC/CAPA) across all three systems, tracking each to closure.

• Own the integrated risk & opportunity process: maintain the register, facilitate assessments,

drive treatments and recommend residual-risk acceptance to the Managing Director.

• Steward the scope, Statement of Applicability, policies and objectives, keeping them current.



Project & portfolio governance

• Run the quarterly project cadence across the business — review each department's projects to ensure they are running as planned, on scope and on schedule.

• Maintain the project tracker; surface slippage, risks, blockers and dependencies, and hold owners to their commitments.

• Report project status and portfolio health to the Managing Director, and keep BAU (run) work and project (change) work clearly separated.



Compliance, information security & risk

• Administer information-security operations: asset inventory, access identities and periodic user-access reviews, supplier/third-party security management, BYOD compliance, i
 logging and coordination, and change management.

• Maintain the legal, regulatory and contractual requirements register and coordinate operational compliance (UK GDPR/data protection, sector and AI-governance obligations).

• Own business-continuity and disaster-recovery readiness — plans, drills and tests.



Operations & resource management

• Run the procurement and purchasing process, including supplier onboarding and due diligence.

• Coordinate cross-department alignment – weekly scoreboards and accountability, townhall inputs and BAU governance.

• Manage company tooling and the asset lifecycle; support operational budgeting.



People & culture (in partnership with HR)

• Support HR on onboarding/offboarding, the recruitment pipeline, the training & competence framework, the PDP cycle and rota/payroll oversight (HR owns execution).

• Champion an accountability culture across the UK and Philippines teams, and maintain the competence & awareness (training) matrix.



Performance, reporting & continual improvement

• Own monitoring and measurement – KPIs, scoreboards and performance evaluation – and report to leadership.

• Drive continual improvement and manage organisational change.



Leadership, delegation & automation

• Line-manage the operations and people-support functions; delegate effectively, and build and develop an Operations Assistant role.

• Use work-management tooling (
) and AI-enabled automation to streamline recurring governance and BAU work.





QUALIFICATIONS, EXPERIENCE & TRACK RECORD

We are hiring for experience. What you have actually run matters far more to us than the certificates you hold — a strong operator who has genuinely owned a live management system will always beat a certificate on its own. You should be able to point to concrete examples for most of the below.

• 5+ years in operations, quality or business-management roles, including at least 2 years managing people or running a function.

• Hands-on experience owning or running a live, ISO-certified management system in day-to-day operation — ISO 9001 and/or ISO 27001 (ISO 42001 a plus). This means having actually maintained it — document control, internal audits, management reviews, corrective actions and risk — not simply holding a certificate.

• Direct experience of external certification audits — preparing for and being audited by a certification body (e.g. BSI or similar) and taking findings and nonconformities through to closure.

• Proven experience running internal audits (ISO 19011 principles) and managing NC/CAPA and a risk & opportunity register.

• Experience running a regular project review or cadence and keeping delivery on track across multiple teams or departments.

• Practical experience of information-security governance operations — access reviews, asset management, supplier/third-party risk, i
 handling and business continuity.

• Experience of document control / management-system administration.

• Experience coordinating distributed or offshore teams (e.g. UK and Philippines) and working across time zones.

• Hands-on with 
 or a comparable work-management platform, and comfortable using automation or AI to reduce manual work.

• Experience line-managing, delegating and building out a team or an assistant function.

• Sound data-protection / UK GDPR awareness and the discretion to handle confidential security, HR and commercial information.

• Excellent English communication and stakeholder management at all levels, including with senior leadership and external auditors.

• Highly organised and self-directed — able to manage many concurrent recurring obligations to deadline with minimal supervision.

We prioritise proven experience over formal qualifications. A relevant degree (business, operations, quality or information management) is welcome but not essential, and ISO / audit certifications are a nice-to-have rather than a prerequisite — we will happily consider candidates whose hands-on track record demonstrates the same capability.



DESIRABLE/NICE TO HAVE (not required)

None of the below is essential — they are advantages. Where a certification is listed, equivalent hands-on experience is valued just as highly.

• ISO 27001 and/or ISO 9001 Lead Auditor or Internal Auditor certification – a bonus, not a prerequisite.

• A project-management qualification or method (e.g. PRINCE2, Agile) or a comparable delivery track record.

• ISO 42001/AI-governance exposure.

• Cyber Essentials familiarity; a data-protection qualification (e.g. GDPR Practitioner, CIPP/E).

• Procurement/vendor-management experience.

• Continual-improvement methods (Lean, Six Sigma) or change-management exposure.

• Experience in a SaaS or technology business.



If you’re ready to be a part of a team and are eager to pursue a path of continuous learning and career growth, we encourage you to apply and join us. Send your CV to

title: Intermediate / Senior Auditor
description:
At AMW Audit Group, we focus solely on external audit—and we do it exceptionally well. As one of Australia’s trusted independent audit firms, we support schools, charities, private businesses, and SMSFs across the country.

We’re now looking for experienced SMSF auditors to join our growing offshore team. This is a long-term, fully remote opportunity where your expertise is valued, your time is respected, and your work-life balance is protected.



You’ll work closely with our in-house team to audit SMSFs for Australian clients, following ATO standards from planning through to reporting. The role offers competitive pay, a flexible work setup, a realistic workload, and a team culture built on trust and clear communication.



We’re looking for auditors with proven SMSF experience and a solid grasp of Australian audit standards. CA, CPA, or equivalent qualifications are welcome, but what matters most is your attention to detail, professional mindset, and ability to deliver quality work independently.

If you’re looking for a stable role with a supportive team, we’d love to hear from you.



SMSF Intermediate/Senior Auditor Qualifications:



• At least 2 years audit experience including experience in SMSF audit and/or SMSF administration

• Prior Big 4 audit experience is a plus

• Knowledge of Australian Auditing Standards

• Knowledge of the SIS Act and Regulations

title: SEO & Website Growth Specialist
description:
A. Role Summary



Position: SEO & Website Growth Specialist

Employment: Full-time, remote

Reports to: Owner



Harris Plumbing is looking for a hands-on digital marketer to own the growth and performance of our website and organic search presence.

This is not primarily a blog-writing position and is not a traditional “SEO assistant” role. The successful candidate will combine strong SEO judgment, Webflow execution skills, local-search expertise, analytics, call attribution, and content management.



The primary objective is to increase qualified calls, booked jobs, and revenue generated by organic search and our website across Harris Plumbing's service areas in Ontario.



Our major service categories include residential plumbing repairs, leaks, clogged drains, flooding issues, dripping fixtures, well-pump/no-water calls, water heaters, water treatment, smart water shutoffs, water pressure problems, and related residential plumbing services.



B. What You Will Own



B1. SEO Strategy & Keyword Prioritization



You will maintain a structured keyword opportunity model covering:

- Search volume

- Commercial intent

- Search difficulty

- Geographic relevance

- Current Harris ranking

- Competitor rankings

- Existing landing page

- Estimated business value

- Search Console impressions and clicks

- Recommended action and priority



You will determine which opportunities should be addressed by improving existing pages, creating new pages, consolidating pages, building internal links, or earning additional authority.



We care more about ranking for commercially valuable searches than producing a predetermined quantity of content.



B2. Webflow Website Management



You should be comfortable independently building and managing a Webflow website. 



Responsibilities include:

-Creating service and educational pages

-Editing existing pages

-Managing CMS collections

-Updating copy and images

-Creating internal links

-Managing titles and meta descriptions

-Updating headings and page structure

-Adding and validating schema markup

-Managing redirects

-Optimizing image sizes and alt text

-Maintaining URL structure

-Performing basic mobile-layout adjustments

-Creating landing pages from approved templates and components



You are not expected to be a senior software developer. More complex custom development can be outsourced when necessary.



B3. On-Page & Technical SEO



You should understand and be able to diagnose:

-Search intent

-Keyword cannibalization

-Indexation

-Crawlability

-Canonicals

-XML sitemaps

-301 redirects

-Internal-link architecture

-Structured data

-Duplicate/thin content

-Page titles and headings

-Core Web Vitals

-Mobile usability

-Page speed

-Image optimization

-Broken links

-Site architecture



You should be comfortable using tools such as Google Search Console, Screaming Frog, Semrush or Ahrefs, and PageSpeed Insights.



B4. Local SEO



Harris competes market-by-market, so local SEO experience is particularly valuable.



You should understand:

-Google Business Profile

-Local Pack/Maps rankings

-Geographic search intent

-Service-area businesses

-Location landing pages

-Reviews and reputation signals

-Local citations

-NAP consistency

-Local backlinks

-Competitor Maps analysis

-Local search-grid/rank-tracking tools



You must understand the difference between building valuable location content and creating thin or repetitive doorway-style pages.



B5. Call Tracking & Marketing Attribution



You will help ensure that Harris can determine which marketing sources generate actual customers.



You should understand:

-Dynamic number insertion

-Tracking phone numbers

-CallRail or similar systems

-UTMs

-GA4

-Google Tag Manager

-Google Search Console

-Conversion events

-Source/medium attribution

-Form attribution

-Landing-page attribution

-CRM attribution



You will work toward connecting:

Search → landing page → call/form → booking → completed job → revenue



You should also understand how tracking numbers can be implemented without creating unnecessary local-SEO/NAP problems.



B6. LSA Lead Analysis



You will take ownership of reviewing and classifying Google Local Services Ads leads.



The objective is not simply to “score calls.”

You will categorize leads such as:



Booked / legitimate but unbooked / price objection / wrong service / outside service area / spam / missed opportunity / unavailable appointment / cancellation / existing customer



You will submit appropriate lead-quality feedback to Google where applicable and analyze the underlying economics of LSA.



Reporting should eventually include:

Cost per lead → qualified-lead rate → booking rate → cancellation rate → completed-job rate → revenue per lead → gross profit per lead



B7. Content Development



You will work collaboratively with Harris's owner, plumbers, managers, and other subject-matter experts.



The preferred process is:

Identify opportunity → research search intent → interview subject-matter expert → create content brief → use AI where useful → human edit/fact-check → build page → optimize → publish → measure → improve



AI should accelerate good research and subject-matter expertise rather than generate large quantities of generic content.



B8. Off-Page SEO



You should understand sustainable authority building, including:



-Competitor backlink analysis

-Supplier/manufacturer links

-Industry organizations

-Legitimate business directories

-Local organizations

-Community relationships

-Local media

-Partnerships

-Digital PR opportunities

-Link-worthy resources



We are not interested in bulk low-quality backlinks, link farms, automated link schemes, or buying hundreds of links.



B9. Reporting & Continuous Improvement



Reporting should focus on business outcomes rather than vanity metrics. Important KPIs will include:



- Qualified non-brand organic clicks: Measures acquisition beyond people already searching Harris

- Organic calls and forms - Measures actual lead generation

- Booked jobs from organic traffic - Measures lead quality and conversion

- Revenue / GP from organic customers - Ultimate economic result

- Priority keywords in Top 3 / Top 10 - Measures search visibility

- Share of search by service/category - Measures competitive position

- Website visitor-to-lead conversion - Measures site effectiveness

- Search impressions and CTR - Identifies ranking and messaging opportunities

- Local/Maps visibility - Measures local availability

- Publishing/optimization backlog completed - Measures execution velocity



C. Required Experience



An ideal candidate will have approximately 3–6+ years of practical SEO experience, preferably serving local businesses or North American lead-generation businesses.



Strong candidates should have experience with:

Webflow, Google Search Console, GA4, Google Tag Manager, Google Business Profile, Semrush and/or Ahrefs, Screaming Frog or similar, call-tracking platforms, keyword research, local SEO, technical SEO, content briefs, internal linking, and basic HTML/CSS.



Experience with plumbing, HVAC, roofing, restoration, electrical, legal, dental, pest control, or other local-service industries is highly desirable.



Experience building sophisticated Webflow animations or custom applications is not required.
