title: Trades Administration Coordinator | Quoting, Scheduling, Invoicing & Bookkeeping
description:
A busy, relationship-driven construction/trades business owner needs a Virtual Assistant to take quoting, scheduling support, invoicing, and bookkeeping off his plate so he can stay focused on the field. This is a genuine clean-slate hire — the business's existing admin support is being retired entirely, not restructured, so the new VA will build these functions from the ground up rather than inheriting a working system.



The core challenge is that virtually everything currently lives in the owner's head — job details, client history, scheduling logic, and financial tracking. The right VA will be comfortable learning the business exactly as it runs today (informal, relationship-driven, low-tech) before introducing structure, and confident enough to make suggestions once they understand the business, without ever getting in the way of the personal relationships the owner has built with clients over 25 years.



Success in the first 30 days looks like: the inbox cleaned up and organised, unpaid invoices actively being chased, the VA fluent in how QuickBooks Online is currently used, and the first SOPs starting to take shape from live handover sessions with the owner.



What You'll Own



Quoting & Proposals



Convert quote requests that come in by text, photo, or voice message into proper written proposals

Use the existing Word-based proposal template and reference past proposals for similar jobs so wording, detail, and line-item style stays consistent

Keep proposals thorough and detailed — plenty of line items, even on smaller jobs

Draft proposals from voice messages describing a job, researching similar past jobs or clients as needed

Create reusable templates for recurring project types over time

Design and implement a clear file-naming convention and filing system for proposals and job documents from scratch



Scheduling & Job Coordination



Help build a consistent, structured weekly schedule for crews, supporting the owner in holding to it rather than jobs constantly bumping each other

Build simple crew profiles over time (core skills, strengths, jobs to avoid) once familiar with the team

Research and help set up a trades scheduling/quoting/invoicing platform as the business's system of record (not required from day one)



Invoicing & Cash Flow



Manage a mix of billing types: AIA billing, bi-weekly progress billing on longer jobs, and end-of-job invoicing on smaller ones

Set up and run a consistent invoicing rhythm, including structured follow-up on unpaid invoices

Follow up on currently outstanding invoices as an immediate priority

Help create predictable, consistent collections to close cash flow gaps



Bookkeeping & Financial Admin



Maintain QuickBooks Online and help bring it up to date in real time — currently only updated after the fact

Track what's owed and what needs to be paid, working from the owner's existing spreadsheet-based job and invoice tracking

Build a proper project ledger — assign a project name or number to every job, past and current

Formalise a daily crew location log (currently handwritten) into a system that can feed weekly payroll

Payroll is currently run outside QuickBooks; moving it in is future scope, not a day-one task



Client & Project Communication



Help set up a dedicated client communication channel per client or project so requests don't only land on the owner's personal number

Draft quotes from incoming requests for the owner's approval before they go out

Handle some direct phone communication with clients and contractors as the role matures



 & Inbox Management



Set up a proper business
 address and clean up/organise the owner's inbox — unsubscribing from marketing noise and surfacing what actually needs a response

Possibly send or draft correspondence on the owner's behalf

Review the inbox thoroughly in week one — supplier relationships, invoice history, and industry language are all sitting in there



Daily Rhythm & Reporting



Send a message at the start of each shift outlining the day's priorities

Send an end-of-day report covering tasks completed, work in progress, and anything needing review or approval

Maintain a running task list to track ad hoc requests sent throughout the day (often via voice message) so nothing is lost between check-ins



Process Documentation



Document each task as a simple SOP as it's handed over via live, screen-shared handover calls — this becomes the ongoing knowledge base for the business



Week One Priorities



Review the inbox in full — a high-value way to learn suppliers, industry language, and current business context

Get familiar with QuickBooks Online exactly as currently set up

Begin following up on currently outstanding/unpaid invoices — immediate, tangible value with minimal ramp-up needed



What We're Looking For



Experience



Prior experience working with trades or construction clients, ideally supporting multiple clients or projects in a fast-paced environment

Hands-on bookkeeping experience, including reconciliation, expense allocation, and job costing

Experience supporting a business owner who is largely off-site/on the road, with limited real-time availability



Technical Proficiency



QuickBooks Online: mandatory, confident working knowledge (Online version, not Desktop)

A trades scheduling/invoicing platform (e.g. ServiceM8 or similar): a strong advantage, not currently mandatory

Microsoft Word: comfortable building and formatting detailed, multi-line-item proposals

Microsoft 365/Outlook: comfortable managing and organising a business inbox

Comfortable with day-to-day virtual team tools (messaging apps, video calls, call recording/note-taking, task management); training provided on specific setup

Basic website/web publishing skills: a nice-to-have, not a non-negotiable



Organisational Skills



Able to design and maintain a clear, logical filing and naming system from scratch

Comfortable building a project ledger and tracking system for jobs, invoices, and crew allocation



Non-Negotiables



Genuinely proactive — comfortable flagging a better way of doing something without being asked

Comfortable working from voice messages and informal, on-the-fly instructions rather than always expecting things in writing

Able to absorb instructions the first time — retains process detail without needing repeated explanation

Familiarity with construction/subcontractor billing structures (AIA billing, progress billing, retainage-style invoicing) is a strong plus

Willing to learn the business's current, informal way of working first, before introducing new structure or systems

Comfortable being the one to research and recommend a platform rather than being handed a fully defined system

Warm, relationship-minded communicator who supports a long-standing, relationship-driven client base without making interactions feel transactional

Comfortable working with minimal daily contact when the owner is flat out on-site, and equally comfortable stepping up when more support is needed

Discreet and trustworthy — will have visibility into financial and client information

Patient through a genuinely from-scratch build — early weeks involve construction, not just handover



Why This Role



Real ownership: build the business's admin, scheduling, and financial systems from the ground up

Fast, tangible early wins — chasing outstanding invoices from week one

Clear path from part-time to full-time as the role and trust develop

Direct, close working relationship with the business owner as systems come together



How to Apply



To be considered, please complete this form and include a short video introduction — it helps us shortlist quickly:

title: YouTube Story Producer / Writer – Family Entertainment
description:
YouTube Story Producer / Writer – Family Entertainment



We are The Beverly Halls, a large family entertainment YouTube channel, and we're looking for a creative Story Producer / YouTube Writer to help develop high-retention long-form episodes.



This is not a blog-writing, SEO-writing, copywriting, or traditional screenplay position. We are looking for someone who understands how to build stories specifically for YouTube.



We need someone who can take a strong title or video concept and turn it into a filmable 10–20 minute episode with a clear promise, escalating story, memorable character moments, comedy, mystery or light suspense when appropriate, and a satisfying payoff.



Our videos are personality-driven. One of the most important parts of this role is writing for a funny, curious young protagonist who should feel like the viewer's on-screen best friend and star of the adventure — not simply a child following adults through a story.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



• Develop complete YouTube episode stories from concepts and titles we provide

• Establish a strong opening promise and satisfying payoff

• Create A/B/C storylines when appropriate

• Break stories into clear, filmable beats

• Build escalation so the situation meaningfully changes throughout the episode

• Give viewers a reason to keep watching for the next moment or answer

• Create situations that naturally produce funny, surprising, suspenseful and emotional family reactions

• Write dialogue and AI-character lines when needed

• Think visually — what can actually happen on camera, not simply what sounds good on paper

• Revise stories based on creative feedback

• Work ahead so our filming team has a consistent pipeline of episodes ready to produce



WE'RE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO UNDERSTANDS



• YouTube retention and viewer curiosity

• Story structure, setup, escalation and payoff

• Family and kids entertainment

• Character-driven storytelling

• Comedy and light mystery/suspense

• How to turn a simple premise into a sequence of meaningful events

• How to make the main character actively drive the story rather than simply react to it



You do not need experience writing for a huge YouTube channel. Strong storytelling instincts, creativity and an understanding of entertaining video matter more to us than a perfect résumé.



IMPORTANT



We are not looking for someone to paste AI-generated scripts into a document. We already use AI tools within our production process.



We are hiring for what AI cannot replace for us: your creative judgment, story instincts, character ideas, sense of humor, ability to create unexpected turns, and your ability to develop an episode that we genuinely want to film.



SELECTION PROCESS



Shortlisted applicants may be invited to complete a brief story-development trial inside our private production Studio before a final hiring decision is made.



Trial details, instructions, timing and compensation will be provided directly to candidates selected to move forward.



TO APPLY



Please send:



A short introduction about yourself and your storytelling/writing experience.

Links to any YouTube videos, scripts, stories or entertainment content you've helped develop. If you don't have YouTube experience, send your strongest relevant creative work.

Tell us about one YouTube channel whose storytelling you think is excellent and explain why.

In 3–5 sentences, answer this:



If the title were:



“Our Son Tried to Outsmart Our AI House for 24 Hours”



What would make you want to keep watching until the end?



Do not write the full episode. We are interested in seeing how you think about the story.



Please begin your application with the words:



STORY FIRST



This lets us know you read the full posting.



We're looking for someone who wants to grow with a long-term production team and eventually take real ownership of our story-development pipeline.

title: Arkero Growth Partner | Sales End to End
description:
Arkero Growth Partner | Sales End to End

Commission-Based, No Cap on Earnings



Arkero connects Australian and New Zealand businesses with skilled Philippines-based remote professionals through our technology led staffing platform.



We're looking for confident, self-driven sales and business development professionals who know how to build relationships, start conversations with business owners, and turn those conversations into committed clients.



As a Growth Partner, you develop your own sector, build your own pipeline, and close new business, then Arkero's team takes over everything else: staffing, worker onboarding, contracts, payments, and ongoing account management. Your job ends at the close, you don't manage the client relationship afterward.



Why Arkero Is Different

Traditional staffing and outsourcing can take weeks to source, shortlist, and place someone. Arkero is building a faster, technology-led model designed around simplicity, speed, and better matching, AI-driven talent matching and scoring, a pre-qualified Philippines talent pool, fast client onboarding, and simple contracting and payments.



You won't just be selling another BPO service, you'll be introducing businesses to a genuinely different way of finding and managing remote talent.



Compensation:

No hourly base pay — fully commission-based

45% commission on the qualifying billing cycle, roughly $450 per successful placement on average

No cap on how much you can earn

No fixed minimum KPI — you build your pipeline and earn based on what you close



The Role

Pick a sector and build relationships with business owners and decision makers

Prospect, start conversations, and understand staffing needs

Explain the Arkero model and follow up with prospects

Manage opportunities through the sales process and close new clients

Once a client commits, hand off entirely to Arkero's operations team





You Could Be a Strong Fit If You:

Have experience in BPO, outsourcing, remote staffing, sales, or business development

Are confident speaking with business owners and senior decision makers

Can build rapport quickly and are comfortable prospecting and following up

Are organized with your own pipeline

Have excellent written and spoken English

Have personally generated and closed new business (not just managed existing accounts)



What We Offer

Uncapped commission-based earnings

Flexible hours, works well as part-time or a side opportunity

Direct exposure to Australian and New Zealand businesses

The chance to join a technology-led staffing business at an early stage

Significant growth opportunity as Arkero expands into new markets





To Apply, Please Answer These 3 Questions:



1. What was your previous BPO, outsourcing, or sales role? Did you personally generate and close new business, or primarily manage existing accounts?

2. Have you worked directly with Australian or New Zealand business owners or decision makers? Please briefly explain your experience.

3. This role has no fixed hours or guaranteed pay, it's entirely commission based. What makes you confident you can succeed in a role like this?

title: Founding Operations & Virtual Team Manager
description:
#Founding Operations & Virtual Team Manager



**Company:** Right Work Solutions

**Location:** Remote — Philippines

**Schedule:** Full-Time, 40 Hours Per Week

**Starting Pay:** **$1,500 USD per month**

**90-Day Compensation Review:** Opportunity to increase to **$1,750–$2,000 USD per month** based on performance, leadership ability, and expanded responsibility

**Growth Path:** Operations Manager → Philippines Operations Director



## About Right Work Solutions



Right Work Solutions is a U.S.-based virtual operations and executive support company being built to serve executives, entrepreneurs, churches, nonprofit organizations, community organizations, and professional service organizations.



We are building more than a traditional virtual assistant agency.



Right Work Solutions will recruit, train, manage, and support highly capable virtual professionals who become trusted extensions of our clients' teams.



Our clients will rely on us not only to provide virtual talent, but also to provide the systems, accountability, management, quality control, and operational structure needed to make virtual support successful.



We are looking for an experienced operations professional in the Philippines who wants the opportunity to help **build this company from the ground up and eventually lead much of its day-to-day operations.**



# About the Position



We are hiring a **Founding Operations & Virtual Team Manager** who will work directly with the Founder & CEO during the startup and growth stages of Right Work Solutions.



This is **not a basic Virtual Assistant position**.



We are looking for someone who already has meaningful professional experience and can move beyond simply following instructions.



The right candidate should be capable of hearing:



**“We need a better system for this.”**



…and independently assessing the problem, recommending a solution, creating the workflow, documenting the SOP, implementing the process, and helping train others to follow it.



You will help build the infrastructure that allows Right Work Solutions to recruit exceptional virtual professionals, onboard new clients, manage remote teams, maintain quality, and grow without requiring the Founder to personally oversee every task.



# Primary Responsibilities



## 1. Build Company Operations



You will help establish the operating foundation for Right Work Solutions.



Responsibilities include:



* Create and maintain Standard Operating Procedures

* Develop internal workflows, templates, and checklists

* Build repeatable operational processes

* Organize company files and documentation

* Maintain company project-management systems

* Create operational dashboards

* Track priorities and deadlines

* Identify operational bottlenecks

* Recommend improvements and automation

* Develop quality-control processes

* Establish documentation standards

* Help create systems capable of supporting a growing virtual workforce



We are looking for someone who understands that good operations should make the company **more consistent, easier to manage, and easier to scale.**



## 2. Lead VA Recruitment



You will help build and manage the Right Work Solutions talent pipeline.



Responsibilities include:



* Develop recruiting workflows

* Prepare and post job opportunities

* Review applications

* Screen candidates

* Conduct first-round interviews

* Coordinate paid assessments

* Evaluate candidate assignments

* Assist with reference checks

* Maintain a qualified talent database

* Recommend finalists to the Founder

* Maintain a bench of pre-screened virtual professionals

* Track recruiting metrics and hiring needs



You should be able to distinguish between a candidate who simply interviews well and a candidate who can actually perform.



## 3. Build the VA Onboarding and Training Program



You will help develop a consistent onboarding and training experience for Right Work Solutions team members.



Responsibilities include:



* Develop orientation materials

* Create onboarding checklists

* Coordinate system access

* Organize training resources

* Train new team members on company expectations

* Coordinate client-specific training

* Track training completion

* Document role expectations

* Maintain appropriate team documentation

* Help establish confidentiality and data-security standards

* Identify ongoing training needs



## 4. Manage the Virtual Team



As Right Work Solutions grows, you will become increasingly responsible for day-to-day team management.



Responsibilities include:



* Conduct regular team check-ins

* Monitor assignments and deadlines

* Track workload and capacity

* Evaluate performance

* Coach team members

* Identify performance concerns early

* Provide corrective feedback

* Coordinate additional training

* Help resolve routine team issues

* Coordinate backup support

* Recommend staffing changes when necessary

* Maintain accountability across the virtual team



Previous experience supervising remote professionals is highly valuable for this role.



## 5. Build and Manage Client Onboarding



You will help design and oversee the Right Work Solutions client onboarding experience.



Responsibilities include:



* Coordinate client kickoff meetings

* Prepare onboarding questionnaires

* Document client goals and preferences

* Identify responsibilities that can be delegated

* Convert client responsibilities into clear processes and SOPs

* Set up client project-management environments

* Organize client files and resources

* Coordinate VA-to-client matching

* Coordinate client and VA introductions

* Track the first 30 days of every client relationship

* Identify problems before they negatively affect the client experience



## 6. Quality Assurance



Right Work Solutions will compete on quality, not simply low-cost labor.



You will help protect that standard.



Responsibilities include:



* Review selected client deliverables

* Monitor accuracy and professionalism

* Track missed deadlines

* Identify recurring mistakes

* Investigate quality concerns

* Develop corrective training

* Improve SOPs when problems occur

* Maintain consistent standards across team members

* Monitor adherence to company processes



## 7. Client Success Support



You will help maintain strong, long-term client relationships.



Responsibilities include:



* Prepare client status reports

* Track unresolved client requests

* Monitor client satisfaction

* Coordinate review meetings

* Identify service concerns

* Recommend operational improvements

* Document new client needs

* Help resolve routine client issues

* Identify opportunities for additional support or services



## 8. Executive Reporting



You will provide the Founder & CEO with a clear weekly operations report.



The report should include:



* Active clients

* Active virtual professionals

* VA capacity

* Client hours or service utilization

* Open positions

* Recruiting pipeline

* Upcoming deadlines

* Outstanding client requests

* Performance concerns

* Client satisfaction concerns

* Training needs

* Operational risks

* Recommended actions

* Priorities for the upcoming week



The Founder should not have to search through multiple systems to determine what is happening inside the company.



You will help make that information clear and actionable.



# Experience Requirements



Because this is a founding operations and management role, we are looking for an experienced professional.



## Required or Strongly Preferred



* **5+ years of professional experience** in operations, executive assistance, project management, agency operations, administrative management, or virtual assistance

* **At least 2 years of experience supervising, training, leading, or managing other team members**

* Experience creating or improving SOPs, workflows, onboarding systems, or internal operating processes

* Experience supporting U.S.-based executives, businesses, organizations, or clients

* Strong written and spoken English

* Excellent organizational skills

* Strong professional judgment

* Strong attention to detail

* Ability to independently manage multiple priorities

* Demonstrated problem-solving ability

* Experience using Google Workspace

* Experience with project-management software

* Reliable computer and high-speed internet

* Ability to handle confidential information professionally



## Highly Preferred Experience



We are especially interested in candidates who have worked in:



* A virtual assistant agency

* An outsourcing company

* A remote staffing organization

* A startup

* An executive support company

* A professional services agency

* A remote operations team



Additional preferred experience includes:



* Recruiting virtual assistants

* Conducting interviews

* Candidate screening

* Team leadership

* Performance management

* Client onboarding

* Client success

* Quality assurance

* Training and development

* Creating operational dashboards

* Managing remote teams

* Building processes from scratch

* Supporting nonprofit, church, healthcare, or executive environments



# Technology



Experience with some of the following is preferred:



* Google Workspace

* ClickUp

* Asana

* 

* Slack

* Zoom

* Calendly

* HubSpot

* Canva

* ChatGPT

* Microsoft Office

* CRM platforms

* Time-tracking systems

* Password-management platforms



You do not need experience with every platform.



You **must be comfortable learning new technology quickly and helping others use it effectively.**



# Who We Are Looking For



## A Builder



You enjoy creating something where systems do not yet exist.



You can take a business need and turn it into a functioning process.



## A Systems Thinker



You naturally ask:



**“How can we create a repeatable process so this problem does not keep happening?”**



## A Leader



You have experience holding people accountable while still helping them improve.



You are comfortable providing direction, feedback, coaching, and correction.



## A Problem Solver



You do not simply report problems.



You investigate what happened, identify possible solutions, and bring recommendations.



## Proactive



You do not require constant instructions or reminders.



You anticipate needs and follow through.



## Organized



You can manage people, clients, projects, systems, deadlines, and documentation simultaneously.



## A Strong Communicator



You communicate clearly and professionally with executives, clients, candidates, and team members.



## Accountable



When you own an assignment, you take responsibility for its completion.



## Comfortable With Growth



This is an early-stage company.



Some processes will already exist.



Others will need to be built.



Your responsibilities will grow as the company grows.



# First 30 Days



Your first month will focus on understanding the company and helping establish its operating foundation.



Priorities may include:



* Organize the Right Work Solutions company workspace

* Establish the project-management system

* Build the initial SOP library

* Create the VA recruiting workflow

* Develop a candidate scorecard

* Create the paid assessment process

* Develop VA onboarding

* Develop client onboarding

* Build the talent database

* Create weekly reporting templates

* Establish quality-control checklists

* Begin identifying and screening potential VAs



# First 60 Days



By approximately 60 days, you should help establish:



* A documented recruiting process

* A qualified VA talent pipeline

* Standardized candidate assessments

* A VA onboarding program

* A client onboarding workflow

* Training materials

* Quality-control procedures

* Performance-management processes

* A workload and capacity dashboard

* Backup staffing procedures

* Clear weekly reporting to the Founder



# First 90 Days



By approximately 90 days, we expect the successful candidate to be capable of taking meaningful ownership of daily operations.



Success may include:



* A bench of 5–10 qualified virtual professionals

* Major operating procedures documented

* Routine recruiting handled independently

* Client onboarding operating consistently

* VA onboarding and training functioning effectively

* Weekly operations reporting completed without reminders

* Team performance monitored consistently

* Client concerns identified early

* Quality-control procedures being followed

* Founder involvement in routine operations significantly reduced



# Compensation



## Starting Compensation



**$1,500 USD per month**



This is a full-time position of approximately 40 hours per week.



## 90-Day Compensation Review



Successful candidates will receive a formal performance and compensation review after approximately 90 days.



Compensation may increase to approximately:



**$1,750–$2,000 USD per month**



depending on:



* Performance

* Leadership ability

* Level of independence

* Team-management responsibilities

* Client-management responsibilities

* Company growth

* Ability to successfully build and manage systems



## Long-Term Opportunity



We are looking for someone who can grow with the company.



Potential career path:



**Founding Operations & Virtual Team Manager**



↓



**Operations Manager**



↓



**Philippines Operations Director**



↓



**Director of Global Virtual Operations**



As the company grows, this person may eventually supervise recruiters, team leaders, client-success professionals, and a larger virtual workforce.



Compensation will be reviewed as responsibilities increase.



# Working Relationship With the Founder



During the startup phase, you will work closely with the Founder & CEO.



The Founder will focus primarily on:



* Company vision

* Sales

* Business development

* Strategic partnerships

* Major client relationships

* Growth strategy

* Final senior hiring decisions



The Founding Operations & Virtual Team Manager will increasingly own:



* Company systems

* Recruiting

* Staffing

* VA onboarding

* Training

* Quality assurance

* Client onboarding

* Team management

* Daily operations

* Operational reporting



The long-term goal is for the Founder to be able to say:



**“Build the system, staff it, manage it, and keep me informed.”**



# Application Instructions



Please include the following with your application:



1. Your resume

2. A brief introduction

3. Total years of professional experience

4. Description of your operations, executive assistance, or management experience

5. Description of your experience supervising or training others

6. Approximate number of people you have supervised

7. Description of a system, SOP, or workflow you personally created or significantly improved

8. Description of your experience recruiting or interviewing candidates

9. Description of your experience supporting U.S.-based clients or executives

10. List of software platforms you have used

11. Confirmation that you are comfortable with the **$1,500 USD monthly starting compensation**

12. Your computer specifications

13. Your internet speed

14. Your availability and preferred working hours



# Required Application Questions



Please answer all three questions at the end of your application.



### Question 1



You join Right Work Solutions and discover that there are no established SOPs, recruiting system, or client onboarding process.



**What are the first three systems you would build, and why?**



### Question 2



A virtual assistant you supervise has missed two important client deadlines. The client has now complained.



**Walk us through exactly how you would handle the situation with both the VA and the client.**



### Question 3



Tell us about a process that was inefficient when you inherited it.



**What did you change, how did you implement the change, and what was the result?**



Generic or AI-only responses without specific examples from your experience may receive less consideration.



# Hiring Process



Qualified candidates may advance through the following process:



**Application Review**



→ **Initial Operations Interview**



→ **Paid Practical Assessment**



→ **Final Interview With Founder & CEO**



→ **Reference Check**



→ **Offer**



The paid assessment will evaluate:



* Leadership judgment

* Systems thinking

* Written communication

* Organization

* Prioritization

* Recruiting judgment

* Client communication

* Problem solving

* Attention to detail

* Ability to work independently



# Why Join Right Work Solutions?



This is an opportunity to join at the beginning of a company and help shape how it operates.



We are not looking for someone who simply wants another task-based VA position.



We are looking for an experienced professional who wants to:



* Build systems

* Lead people

* Develop teams

* Improve operations

* Work directly with a Founder

* Help shape company culture

* Grow into senior leadership

* Build something that can scale



If you have significant operations experience, have successfully managed people, enjoy creating systems, and want the opportunity to help build a growing U.S.-based virtual operations company, we would like to hear from you.

 a client

title: Client Success & Sales Coordinator (Solar Sales Support and Sales Virtual Assistant)
description:
PLEASE READ THIS IN FULL BEFORE APPLYING



ABOUT US



Billabong Solar is a growing Australian solar and battery installation company based in Victoria. We help homes and businesses across Melbourne reduce their energy costs — and we're looking for a reliable, long-term team member to join us.



WHAT WE NEED



There are three things that matter most to us for this role:

- Excellent, confident spoken English — non-negotiable, and the thing we assess most closely

- Someone who genuinely enjoys talking with customers on the phone, not just tolerates it

- Demonstrable experience in a customer-facing or customer service role — be ready to speak to this directly in your application



Beyond that, we're a small, close-knit team, and we want someone with a warm, friendly manner who is coachable, reliable, and organised, and comfortable picking up new tools and software. This is not a short-term role or a stepping stone. We want someone who wants to grow with the business and become a trusted part of how we operate.



Working hours

Monday to Friday, 9am to 7pm Melbourne time, with a one hour lunch break (approximately 7am to 5pm Philippine time) — a normal daytime schedule. Plus a 3-hour session on Saturday to review progress together. Total: 48 hours per week. If you've previously worked graveyard shifts for American clients, this is a genuine quality of life improvement.



The role

You'll be our main point of contact for customer communications and day-to-day admin support, and you'll also be involved in online sales — following up on enquiries and quotes, keeping our sales pipeline moving, and helping convert leads into customers.



Compensation

- Base salary as stated, reviewed based on performance

- Commission on sales becomes part of your package after successful completion of probation

- With strong performance, total take-home can reach up to ₱70,000/month



What we're looking for

- Excellent written English

- Clear, confident spoken English — non-negotiable

- A friendly, patient nature and genuine enjoyment of speaking with customers, especially on the phone

- Previous experience in a customer-facing or customer service role, which you can clearly demonstrate

- Comfortable with technology and happy to learn new tools (CRM, Google Workspace, and similar business software)

- Coachable, direction-taking, and reliable

- Someone looking for a long-term position, not a stepping stone



PLEASE READ THIS IN FULL BEFORE APPLYING



We are looking for one person to join us for the long term. We are not looking to fill a seat for a few months.



DO NOT APPLY IF:

- You are not serious about the role or the hours

- You are looking for something short-term, or treating this as a stopgap while you look for something else

- You are not comfortable with the schedule or the pay as stated

- You are not prepared to have your previous employers contacted



We would rather receive five genuine applications than fifty casual ones. If the terms do not suit you, we completely understand — please simply pass on this one.



PLEASE ALSO NOTE:

- We contact previous employers as a standard part of our hiring process, and we do this before making any offer.

- We leave reviews on OnlineJobs.ph reflecting our actual experience with the workers we engage. We take this seriously in both directions — good work is recognised, and so is conduct that falls short.



To apply

Please include a short video (2–3 minutes) where you introduce yourself and talk us through a customer call or interaction you've handled in a previous role while working for a Western (US/UK/Australian) client — what the situation was and how you handled it. Along with your written application, please also include the names and contact details of two previous employers we may contact. Both the video and the written application are required to be considered.



Salary

₱30,000/month base + commission (up to ₱70,000/month with strong performance)

title: Growth Strategist - Meta Ads + Direct Response Copy (Full Time, EST Hours)
description:
Perfect Growth Agency is a digital marketing agency running paid

acquisition for service businesses in North America. We are hiring ONE

full-time Growth Strategist to take ownership of ad performance across

our existing client accounts.



This is a thinking role, not a button-pushing role. You will not be

handed a complete brief and told what to build. You will be given a

client, an account, and a goal, and we expect you to dig in, ask sharp

questions, and come back with a plan.



ABOUT THE SCHEDULE (please read before applying)



This role runs on US Eastern Time, which means working nights in the

Philippines. We would rather be upfront about this than have you find

out in month two. If a night schedule does not work for your life

right now, please skip this one, no hard feelings.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN



- Write the ad copy and the landing page copy. This is a major part of

  the job, not a side duty

- Learn our existing client accounts deeply: their customers, their

  offers, what has been tested, what is working and what is fading

- Report weekly per client. Not a numbers dump, a clear story: what we

  tested, what we learned, what is next

- Propose and run the next moves: new angles, new hooks, new creative,

  budget and structure changes

- Concept the creative, then brief our video editors and AI design

  tools clearly enough that they get it right first time

- Build landing pages using AI tools, and diagnose why a page is not

  converting

- Make the daily Meta ads calls: kill, scale, or iterate



YOU ARE A FIT IF



- You write direct response copy. Not "I can write" but: you

  understand awareness levels, you can take a rough draft or AI output

  and pull it up to a standard, and you can explain what you changed

  and why

- You have 2+ years hands-on Meta ads experience with real budget, and

  can walk through an account you personally ran and defend every

  decision you made

- You have written and built landing pages and understand what makes

  them convert

- You use AI daily as a real part of how you work, not as a novelty

- You ask WHY before HOW. The how you can research and figure out. The

  why you push on

- You communicate clearly in writing and on video



NOT IN THIS ROLE



GoHighLevel builds, video editing, sales calls, client account

management. We have people for those. Your job is thinking, writing,

testing, and performance.



SALARY AND GROWTH



USD 800 to 1000 per month to start, depending on experience.



Reviewed at 3 months with a clear path to USD 1400+ based on results.



Paid on time, every time. Weekends off. This is a long-term role and

we are hiring someone to grow into a lead seat as we scale, not a

short-term contractor.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with the word ANGLE. Applications without it

are not read.



Then send links to 3 to 5 pieces of copy you wrote that actually ran.

Ads still live in the Meta Ad Library, landing pages or sales pages

(the URL is fine even if it has since changed),
s, or your own

portfolio. Public links only, so nothing breaches an NDA. If most of

your work is not public, send what you have and tell us the context.



Then answer these three, briefly:



1. One Meta account you personally ran: the niche, roughly the monthly

   ad spend, and your best result

2. The best performing hook you ever wrote, and why you think it worked

3. Tell us about a campaign you d
 to kill. What did you see, and

   how long did you wait before pulling it?



Short answers are fine. We are reading for how you think, not how much

you write. We read the copy before we read the CV.



Shortlisted applicants will be asked to record a short Loom video

walking through one real campaign they ran.

title: Guest Experience Specialist, Third Coast Elevated Stays
description:
Third Coast Elevated Stays is a locally rooted, family-owned property management company serving the Texas coast markets of Galveston, Corpus Christi, Rockport, Port Aransas, and South Padre Island. We are focused on providing elevated stays for our guests and elevated stewardship for our homeowners. Our goal is to grow in a way that celebrates what makes the Texas coast special - its people, coastal culture, beach communities, and local character - while delivering elevated experiences for guests and thoughtful, reliable stewardship for homeowners.



Tech stack (daily tools): Guesty (PMS + guest inbox), Breezeway (tasks/workorders + cleaning), RingCentral (calls/SMS).



Our Elevated Promises

Everything we do is guided by our Elevated Promises. They are our operating standard and the way we earn five-star stays and trusted, long-term homeowner partnerships.



1. Elevated Guest Engagement: Proactive, elevated hospitality from booking to five-star review. 

We believe vacations are special—something people save for, plan for, and look forward to. Our job is to make every stay feel seamless and memorable. We anticipate needs, communicate early, check in during the stay, and resolve issues quickly with warmth and care. Our guest journey is intentionally crafted to deliver the kind of responsiveness, thoughtfulness, and attention to detail that turns great trips into truly elevated experiences.



2. Elevated Home Stewardship: We care for every home as if it were our own.

As homeowners in these markets, we know what true home stewardship looks like. We operate with a proactive mindset of quality, consistency, and pride. Weekly home checks, rigorous cleaning standards, quality control, seasonal readiness, and preventive maintenance are all part of how we ensure every property is clean, protected, and presentation ready, for guests and for you. We treat every home with the same respect and diligence we expect for our own.



3. Elevated Homeowner Partnerships: We treat each home like our own investment.

Every homeowner has different goals – maximizing revenue, balancing personal use, focusing on long-term appreciation, or simply enjoying peace of mind. Our role is to be a true partner in those goals, not simply a property manager. As owners and operators in this region ourselves, our guidance comes from real-world results, not theory. Through regular business reviews, thoughtful design and amenity recommendations, revenue and pricing insights, and brand-building support, we help each property reach its highest potential.



Our Guest Experience team is one of the biggest ways we deliver these promises. This is hospitality work. You are a core part of our team, not an outsourced call-center function.?



Job Description: Guest Experience Specialist - Texas Coast

As a Guest Experience Specialist, you own guest communication and coordination. You are the voice of Third Coast, a core part of our team, and a key driver of five-star stays. You will manage guest messaging and calls, coordinate workorders and cleaning schedules with our local teams and vendors, and bring elevated hospitality and experiences to every stay.



You will own:

• Proactive outreach and warm guest engagement that drives five-star stays

• Guest messaging and phone communication

• Workorder coordination and task follow-through

• Cleaning scheduling and day-to-day coordination with our local team and vendors



Working Hours

We provide live coverage from 7:00am to 11:00pm Central Time (CDT). You will be assigned a consistent shift. On-call after-hour coverage (11:00pm-7:00am CDT) is handled by a separate rotation.



Central Daylight Time (CDT) ? Philippines Time (PHT):

• 7am–3pm CDT ? 8pm–4am PHT

• 11am–7pm CDT ? 12am–8am PHT

• 3pm–11pm CDT ? 4am–12pm PHT

• 11pm–7am CDT ? 12pm–8pm PHT



Compensation and Incentives

• Base pay: $800 USD per month (full-time, based on experience)

• 13th month pay: offered in December (prorated for partial years)

• Monthly 5-Star Bonus: $50 if the monthly average rating is 4.85+ and the review rate is 60%+.

• PTO: Accrues at 1 paid days per month (usable after 90 days; no annual rollover)



Location

These roles are fully remote within the Philippines. 



Role and Responsibilities



Elevated Guest Engagement (Guesty + text/email)

• Answer guest messages (text,
, OTA inbox via Guesty) with warmth, clarity, and genuine care

• Proactively share helpful guidance (arrival, access, weather/roads, home-specific tips) and check in during the stay

• Keep conversations organized and ensure no guest is left waiting or confused

• Ensure every guest experience feels special and elevated



Welcome outreach (required for every reservation)

• Place a welcome phone call to every guest prior to arrival day and send a personalized welcome text

• Confirm access and comfort, offer help, and document any concerns quickly

• Identify opportunities to make the guest’s stay an elevated and memorable experience



Phone support (RingCentral)

• Answer calls quickly and calmly and return missed calls promptly

• Troubleshoot common issues (access, Wi-Fi, amenities, heating/hot tub basics) and escalate when needed



Workorders and coordination (Breezeway)

• Create workorders fast when issues arise and confirm vendor/team acknowledgment

• Track progress, follow up, and close the loop with guests and the local team

• Keep notes and task status clean so handoffs are seamless



Cleaning scheduling and turnovers (Breezeway)

• Coordinate turn cleaning schedules and special requests

• Ensure all turns are scheduled a minimum of one week prior to booking and confirm scheduled cleaner by 6:00pm CDT the night prior to a scheduled cleaning and communicate key notes to cleaners



Documentation and handoffs

• Maintain accurate property notes and updates

• Close out open items before shift end and hand off active issues with clear context



Monthly SLA Standards (required for bonus eligibility)

• Guest messages answered within 15 minutes during your shift (text,
, Guesty inbox)

• Phone calls answered within 30 seconds during your shift

• No open guest messages left at shift end; clean handoffs with clear notes

• Workorders created promptly and vendor/team acknowledgment confirmed quickly



Property Listing Management & OTA Updates

• Maintain accurate, up-to-date listings across Guesty, Airbnb, Vrbo, and other OTAs.

• Update photos, amenities, room configurations, access notes, and seasonal details as needed.

• Ensure descriptions reflect the true guest experience with clear, warm, and helpful language.

• Flag inconsistencies, outdated information, or missing details to the Manager for correction.

• Support seasonal updates (spring break, summer beach season, hurricane season, local events, and holiday periods) to elevate guest expectations and reduce pre-arrival questions.

• Ensure every listing reflects our Elevated Promises — clarity, care, and a welcoming tone.



Local expertise

• Become an expert on Galveston, Corpus Christi, Rockport, Port Aransas, and South Padre Island, including seasonal rhythms, beach conditions, weather impacts, and local norms.

• Learn the best restaurants, cafes, shops, beach activities, family experiences, fishing and boating options, and local attractions in each market so you can offer personalized, concierge-level recommendations that elevate each stay.

• Know our homes in detail: complete Matterport and photo walkthroughs; learn layouts, bedding, amenities, quirks, parking, access instructions, and any “good to know” details for guests.

• Stay current on local events and updates by checking event calendars, tourism sites, and community pages (including relevant local
 groups).

• Use your local and property knowledge proactively to help guests plan better stays, avoid common issues, and feel confidently looked after from booking to checkout.



What we look for

• Excellent written and spoken English and a warm, helpful tone

• Hospitality mindset (you enjoy caring for people, not just closing tickets)

• Strong ownership and follow-through, especially on weekends and busy days

• Detail-oriented and eager to learn homes, markets, and local context

• Comfortable learning and working inside Guesty, Breezeway, and RingCentral

• Reliable internet and a quiet, professional work environment



How to apply



Please submit the following:

• Resume/CV

• 2-minute voice recording introducing yourself and your experience (English)

• Speedtest.net result (screenshot)



Short written samples: How would you respond to the following guest messages?

• “The hot tub isn’t heating. Can you help?”

• “Can we request a late checkout tomorrow?”

• “We’re staying in Port Aransas — any recommendations for a great breakfast spot for our family?”



Short written samples: These three guests message you at the same time. In what order would you respond and why?

• “We can’t get into the home, the code isn’t working.”

• “The Wi-Fi is slow and we need it for work.”

• “Can we check out one hour later?”

title: Social Media Video Editor & Content Creative for Fitness/Coaching Brand
description:
Social Media Video Editor & Content Creative for Fitness/Coaching Brand



NOTE: Do not apply through here - read ad, then apply below by clicking google form link



I’m looking for a creative and reliable social media editor to join me on an ongoing part-time basis.



The majority of the work will be supporting my fitness coaching business, Peak & Base Training and Nutrition, creating content around fat loss, strength training, muscle building, nutrition and helping everyday people get into better shape.



There may also occasionally be content relating to business coaching, Anytime Fitness and other projects I’m involved with.



What you'll mainly be helping with



Your primary responsibility will be editing and repurposing social media content, including:



- Instagram Reels and other short-form videos

- Talking-head content

- Gym footage and B-roll

- Voiceover-style videos

- Podcast/coaching-call clips from time to time

- Carousels

- Story graphics

- Before-and-after transformations

- Thumbnails

- Static promotional graphics

- Occasional Meta ad or landing-page creatives

- Repurposing older content into our current branding



Most short-form videos will be approximately 45–90 seconds



The editing style is generally personality-driven rather than overly cinematic.



Think:



- Strong captions

- Punch-in zooms

- B-roll

- Stock footage where appropriate

- Sound effects

- Lists, charts and graphic overlays

- Pattern interrupts

- Clean pacing

- Good storytelling



A lot of the content uses humour, personality and sometimes cheeky or shock-style jokes, so strong English comprehension is important.



I'm looking for more than someone who just presses buttons



I'll retain the final say over the direction, hooks and messaging, but I'd love to work with someone who is confident enough to contribute ideas.



Ideally, you'll regularly bring me 3–5 content ideas, trends, hooks or formats each week that suit:



- Our audience

- Our current marketing objectives

- What's currently working on social media

- Any offer or campaign we're currently promoting



If you've got experience helping with hooks, scripts, shot ideas or content strategy, that's a big advantage.



I want this to feel collaborative.



If you see a better way of presenting something, I'd rather you tell me than simply wait for instructions.



Experience



Ideally, you have at least 1 year of regular social-media editing experience, although portfolio quality and actual ability matter far more to me than how many years you've been editing.



Experience working with:



- Fitness

- Coaches

- Personal brands

- Educational content



is preferred but isn't essential.



A great editor with excellent creative instincts will absolutely be considered regardless of niche.



Software



I'm not concerned about which specific editing software you prefer.



You may use CapCut, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut, After Effects or another tool.



I also have access to CapCut Pro and Canva Pro, which can potentially be provided if required.



We'll predominantly work through tools such as:



- Google Drive

- CapCut Cloud

- Canva

- WhatsApp



Hours



Initially, I expect this role to be approximately 5–10 hours per week.



For the right person, there is definitely room for this to grow toward 15–20+ hours per week as the business and content output grow.



Some crossover with Australian Eastern Standard Time is preferred. Ideally, you can overlap for at least 1–2 hours on most working days when required.



Most work can still be completed asynchronously.



What matters to me



I'm looking for someone who is:



- Creative

- Reliable

- Organised

- Confident

- Comfortable giving and receiving feedback

- Good at communicating

- Interested in social-media trends

- Able to understand humour and conversational English

- Capable of working independently

- Willing to bring ideas instead of constantly waiting for instructions



The goal is to build an ongoing relationship with someone who can become an important part of the content process as the role grows.



How to apply



Please do NOT apply by sending a standard application message through OnlineJobs.ph.



To be considered, complete the Google Form linked below:







The form contains questions about your experience, portfolio, availability, rate and the type of support you can provide.



Applications will be reviewed through the form so that all candidates can be assessed fairly and consistently.



Thanks — I'm looking forward to seeing your work.

 with the subject line "CS VA — [Your Name]" and include:

title: OpenClaw Agent Engineer - Build AI Agents and Keep Them Running
description:
READ THIS FIRST

 

You must have used OpenClaw before. You must be able to prove it.

 

If you have not used OpenClaw, please do not apply. We will not read your message. We are saying this clearly so we do not waste your time or ours.

 

 

THE JOB IN ONE SENTENCE

 

You build OpenClaw agents. You keep them running. You make them faster, cheaper and more reliable every week.

 

That is the whole job.

 

 

ABOUT US

 

We are a health and wellness company. We sell products online. We have a small remote team in several countries.

 

We are building a team of AI agents to run parts of our business.

 

 

WHAT IS AN AGENT HERE

 

An agent is a small program that does one job. It runs by itself on a timer. Nobody starts it by hand. It runs at 3am while everyone is asleep.

 

We want 10 to 20 agents. Each one does one job.

 

Three real examples:

 

1) STORE WATCHER. Every 3 hours it checks our online shop. Is checkout working? Is any product priced wrong? Are we selling stock we do not have? If yes, it reports. If no, it says nothing.

 

2) INBOX READER. Twice a day it reads
, Slack, Asana and meeting notes. It works out what is waiting on the owner. Then it writes the replies for him to approve.

 

3) COMPETITOR WATCHER. Once a week it checks what our competitors changed. It only reports the changes.

 

Above all the agents sits one main agent. We call it the Chief of Staff. It manages the other agents. It is the only agent that talks to the owner.

 

 

WHAT YOU WILL DO

 

1) BUILD THE PLATFORM. One AWS account. OpenClaw installed and running on a timer. A safe place to store passwords and API keys. A log of every run. A stop button.

 

2) BUILD THE AGENTS. One at a time. We give you a written brief for each one. You d
 how to build it.

 

3) KEEP THEM RUNNING. This is half the job. An agent that stops quietly is worse than no agent at all, because we will trust a silence that means nothing is being checked.

 

4) MAKE THEM BETTER EVERY WEEK.

- Using too much money? Make them cheaper.

- Too slow? Make them faster.

- Sending too many messages? Reduce the noise.

- Failing sometimes? Find out why and fix it.

 

You will send a short report every week: how many runs, how many failures, how much it cost, and what you improved.

 

5) OWN IT. You will be the only person who understands this system. We need you to write things down so that stays safe.

 

 

YOU MUST HAVE

 

1) OPENCLAW EXPERIENCE. This is not optional. You have installed OpenClaw yourself. You have run it. You have fixed it when it broke. We need proof. See the PROOF section below.

 

2) AWS. You have set up EC2 yourself. You know IAM. You have used Secrets Manager or something like it.

 

3) PYTHON. You write code that runs on a server. Not only in a notebook.

 

4) API EXPERIENCE. REST APIs. OAuth. Webhooks. You have handled rate limits and retries. You have worked with an API that gave you wrong data.

 

5) LLM API EXPERIENCE. OpenAI, Anthropic or similar. Inside real code. Not only in a chat window.

 

6) CLEAR WRITTEN ENGLISH. Most of our work is written. You must be able to explain a technical decision in writing.

 

7) TIME OVERLAP. At least 4 hours per day that overlap with Sydney, Australia business hours.

 

 

PROOF OF OPENCLAW EXPERIENCE

 

Your application must include at least one of these. Two is better.

 

OPTION A - A SHORT SCREEN RECORDING. 2 to 3 minutes. Record your own screen. Show OpenClaw running on your machine or your server. Show the config. Show the logs. Show it doing something.

 

OPTION B - A REPOSITORY. A GitHub link with your commit history, showing your OpenClaw setup or an agent you built for it.

 

OPTION C - A LIVE SYSTEM. Something running now that we can look at, or that you can show us on a call.

 

Screenshots alone are not enough. Anyone can send a screenshot. We need to see you working with it.

 

AND ANSWER THESE FIVE QUESTIONS. These are simple if you have really used it. Please answer all five.

 

1) Did you install OpenClaw yourself, or did you use a one-click hosting service or a template? Both answers are fine. We just need to know which one.

 

2) What machine did it run on? Say the operating system and where it was hosted.

 

3) How did you keep it running after you closed your laptop or logged out? Name the exact method you used.

 

4) Where do you look when you want to see what OpenClaw did? Name the file or the command.

 

5) Tell us about one time it broke. What broke, and how did you fix it?

 

 

PLEASE DO NOT APPLY IF

 

- You have never used OpenClaw

- You cannot show us proof

- You have only used no-code tools and never written code that runs on a server

- You want a job where every task is fully explained before you start

- You are sending the same message to many jobs today

 

 

ONE MORE THING, AND WE MEAN IT

 

We need you to tell us the truth about what you can and cannot do.

 

If something is too hard for you today, say so. We will pay for the course. We will give you the time.

 

What we cannot work with is a date that was never real, or a yes that was really a maybe.

 

Before you start each piece of work, we will ask you to rate it from 1 to 10. 1 is very easy. 10 is very hard. We want the real number. If it is an 8, say 8.

 

This is a real part of the job. It is not a nice sentence in a job advert.

 

 

HOW TO APPLY

 

Send a message with all five things below. If anything is missing, we will not read it.

 

1) Start your message with the word HEARTBEAT. This shows us you read the post.

 

2) Your proof of OpenClaw experience. Recording, repository or live system.

 

3) Your answers to the five OpenClaw questions above.

 

4) Your answers to these three questions. Short answers are better than long ones.

 

   a) Tell us about one program you built that ran by itself for 30 days or more. Something broke while nobody was watching. How did you find out it had broken?

 

   b) Your program runs at 3am. Nobody is logged in. It needs an API key to do its job. Where do you keep that key, and why there?

 

   c) Twenty different agents all send messages to one busy person. After one month, that person stops reading them. What do you build so this does not happen?

 

5) Your rate. USD per month, for 40 hours per week.

 

Please write your application yourself. We read a lot of AI writing every day. We are hiring for good thinking, not for good grammar.

 

 

WHAT HAPPENS NEXT

 

1) We read your proof and your answers.

2) A 30 minute video call.

3) A paid test project. One week. One small agent. We pay your normal rate. You keep the money even if we do not continue.

4) If it goes well, full time and long term.

title: WordPress Publishing Assistant
description:
I am looking for a reliable WordPress Publishing Assistant to help manage the final publishing stage for an established personal website and content platform. This is not primarily a writing position.



I will provide completed articles along with a publishing table containing the information needed for each post, including the title, category, topics, SEO information, image metadata, internal and external links, and other publishing instructions.



Your job is to take that completed material and turn it into a clean, properly formatted WordPress post.



## What You Will Do



For each article, you will:



* Add and format the completed article in WordPress

* Apply the correct headings and paragraph formatting

* Assign the correct category

* Add the provided Topics/tags

* Enter the provided SEO title, permalink, meta description, and focus keywords

* Work with Rank Math SEO

* Upload and set the provided featured image

* Enter the image title, alt text, description, and caption when applicable

* Add internal links using the anchor text and destinations provided

* Add external links when provided

* Add the specified call to action when applicable

* Check the post for formatting problems

* Check links before publication

* Review desktop and mobile appearance

* Make sure the featured image displays and crops correctly

* Schedule or prepare the article for publication according to the instructions provided



The goal is for me to hand you a finished article and its publishing information, then have you handle the WordPress production work accurately without requiring me to redo the formatting afterward.



## What You Will Not Be Expected to Do



You will not normally be responsible for:



* Writing articles from scratch

* Reworking the core argument or changing my position

* Developing the editorial direction

* Choosing what the article should say

* Creating social media posts

* Managing social media accounts

* Creating the SEO strategy from scratch

* Deciding categories, Topics, keywords, or links on your own



Some light editing may be necessary before publication. This can include correcting grammar, improving awkward wording, fixing formatting issues, or making small changes so the article better matches the established voice.



Those edits should preserve the meaning, tone, and point of view of the original article. Significant rewrites or changes to the argument should be flagged rather than made without approval.



Most editorial decisions will already be made before the article reaches you.



## What I Am Looking For



You should have experience with:



* WordPress

* WordPress block editor / Gutenberg / Kadence

* Formatting blog articles

* Uploading and managing images

* Alt text and image metadata

* Basic on-page SEO

* SEO titles and meta descriptions

* Internal and external linking



Experience with Rank Math SEO is strongly preferred.



You should also be comfortable following detailed written instructions and working from a repeatable publishing process.



## Attention to Detail Matters



This position requires someone who notices small mistakes.



For example:



* A heading should not accidentally become normal paragraph text.

* A link should point to the correct page.

* An image should have the correct alt text.

* The permalink should match the instructions.

* The correct category and Topics should be selected.

* The article should not contain duplicated titles.

* Spacing should look clean on both desktop and mobile.



I would rather have someone who checks their work carefully than someone who simply works fast.



## Work Style



You will receive articles that are already substantially complete.



Each article will include a publishing information table at the top with the instructions you need. The article itself will begin below that table.



You should be able to work independently from those instructions and ask questions when something is genuinely unclear rather than guessing.



The publishing process will become standardized, so once you learn the system, most articles should follow the same general workflow.



## Position



This will begin as a part-time remote position.



The amount of work may increase as the website and content operation grow.



There may also be opportunities to take on additional responsibilities over time if you are a good fit.



## To Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. A short introduction about yourself.

2. Your experience using WordPress.

3. Whether you have used Gutenberg / the WordPress block editor.

4. Whether you have experience with Rank Math SEO.

5. Your experience formatting and publishing blog posts.

6. Your current availability.

7. Your expected hourly rate.

8. Links or screenshots showing WordPress posts you have formatted or managed, if available.



Also answer this question:



What are the five things you would check before telling me that a WordPress article is ready to publish?



Please do not send a generic copy-and-paste application. I am much more interested in whether you understand the work and pay attention to instructions than in receiving a long cover letter.

- Product landing pages and campaign pages, designed separately for desktop and mobile. 80% of our buyers are on mobile, so mobile is not an afterthought.

What We Are Looking For

- 4+ years designing for e-commerce or DTC brands. Your portfolio must include live website URLs with shipped pages. Concept work and Dribbble mockups alone will not qualify.

- Premium visual taste. Your work should feel like it belongs next to Apple or a well-funded Kickstarter hardware launch. Clean, minimal, confident.

- Fast with AI, finished by hand. You use AI image tools for speed and volume, but your judgment and polish make the final output. You can show us the AI draft vs. your finished version and explain every change you made.

- Expert-level Figma. Clean auto-layout, organized components, files that another designer could pick up without a walkthrough.

- You design for conversion, not applause. You think about what makes someone click, scroll further, or buy. You bring ideas to the table, not just execute what is asked.

- Comfortable with time tracking through Hubstaff. Full-time hours with at least 3 to 4 hours of daily overlap with North American mornings for real-time collaboration.



What We Offer

title: UGC Brand Partnership Manager (Salary + Commission)
description:
UGC Brand Manager (Part-time, Remote)



We're looking for a part-time UGC Brand Manager for a fast-growing UGC creator. Your job is to find us brand deals and help us go viral. That's it.



Remote role. We're based in Bangkok and prefer someone in Thailand or the Philippines for timezone overlap.



WHAT WE MAKE



Every video follows the same shape: a reaction hook in the first 3 seconds filmed by our creator, a screen demo of the app in the middle, and a benefit or call to action at the end. Here's an example account: 



Every brand we work with is an app or software. We don't work with physical products. We'll train you on the UGC side, so you don't need to know it on day one.



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING



Platforms. Log in to Sideshift and the other platforms we're on. Review new campaigns, apply to the 10 best, and manage the inbox, since brands often reach out to us first. Check rates, read the brief, watch the content references, and look the brand up on Instagram and TikTok to see whether other creators are already making content for them.



Instagram outbound. Send 10-15 pitch messages to brands using our template. Send 10 DMs to UGC creators asking what deals they're working with. Follow up with anyone who hasn't replied after 3 days.




. Work our UGC communities. Read the deals channels, apply to anything that fits, post asking for referrals where it's allowed, and DM active creators who look like they're having success to find out what's paying well right now.



Tracker. Fill it out at the end of every day. What you applied to, who you pitched, who replied, and where each deal stands.



Referrals convert best, direct brand DMs second, platform applications third. On a short day you keep the referral and DM work.



JUDGING DEALS



The core of this job is d
 which opportunities are worth our time.



Our ideals are a CPM of $1.50 or above and a base of around $700 a month or more, but those trade against each other. A $2 CPM with a $500 base is fine.



What doesn't flex: other creators need to already be going viral with that brand, the content has to be straightforward to replicate, and the idea has to be easy to understand. A calorie tracker or an AI image generator works. Anything abstract doesn't.



Skip campaigns with no reference videos, campaigns that are 100% scripted, and anything over 45 videos.



WHEN A BRAND REPLIES



Take initiative and move the conversation forward. Get the brief, the reference videos, the pay terms, the deliverable count, and the deadline. Look the app up on social and see what's already working for them. Then make a call on whether we should pursue it and bring it to me with your reasoning. I confirm terms and contracts, not you.



ONCE WE'RE IN A CAMPAIGN



Our creator never talks to brands and never reads briefs. Everything reaches her through you, in plain simple language: the video styles to copy with links, the most viral videos for that brand that we can realistically remake, the app link, the pay rate, and any hard requirements like tags or hashtags.



From there you're managing the production side, and this is where a lot of the value of the role sits. One of your key responsibilities is helping us go viral. You're effectively our social media manager for that account: telling us which hooks to use, which formats to copy, what's trending in that brand's space, and how to get the most views out of every video.



Some apps need screen demo footage of the product in use. When they do, you record it. Case by case, not every brand.



COMPENSATION



Base retainer paid monthly, plus 10% commission on every deal you close. Deals typically run $500 to $2,000+.



Most of our deals pay on a CPM, so you're directly incentivised on views. A video that hits 1 million views at a $2 CPM pays $2,000, and your commission on that is $200. At a $3 CPM it's $300. The more we blow up, the more you make.



Part-time contract role, around 10 hours a week to start. You set your own hours, but you need to get results. KPIs are measured: messages sent, applications submitted, replies, and deals signed.



YOU'RE A FIT IF YOU



Have experience in marketing, social media, influencer work, or brand partnerships. Can find a brand's marketing contact without being handed a list. Communicate clearly in written English, since you'll be dealing with US brand managers. Can make a judgment call and defend it. Can hold a daily routine without supervision.



Hands-on UGC or brand partnership experience is a strong plus, either as a creator yourself or from the brand, agency, or talent side. Not a hard requirement if the rest is there.



YOU'RE NOT A FIT IF YOU



Plan to work the inbox reactively instead of proactively hunting for deals. Need close supervision to stay on a daily routine. Want a role with no measured output.



TO APPLY



Send me one or two examples of UGC or brand partnership deals you've sourced or managed, including the brand name, creator size, and outcome. If you don't have those, tell me about the closest thing you've done.



Then tell me how you'd find me 3 new deals in your first week, plus your availability and rate expectation.



THE BIGGER PICTURE



Alongside this account, I run a UGC mentorship program for people landing their first brand deals. As this role grows, I want you sourcing opportunities I can pass to students in the program.



If you want to eventually manage a pipeline of brand relationships across a network of creators rather than a single account, this is the role that gets you there.

title: Audio Quality Control Engineer
description:
About Jess Escalona Media



Jess Escalona Media helps coaches and consultants grow their reach and visibility through podcasting, without the tech overwhelm. We provide calm, systems-led, done-for-you production so our clients can focus on showing up and sharing their voice. Our founder brings 10+ years of experience as an audiobook producer for Big 5 publishers, and that same standard of professionalism runs through everything we deliver.



The Role



We're looking for an Audio Engineer & Quality Control Specialist to own mastering and final quality control on every episode we produce. Right now, every episode passes through our founder's ears before it goes to a client. This role exists to build the trust and standard that lets that step move to you, so we can grow past our current capacity without quality slipping.



We need someone with a trained ear and real technical judgment, someone who can be trusted to be the last line of defense before a client hears their episode.



What You'll Do

Master incoming audio using iZotope RX, FabFilter, and/or Waves plugins to a consistent, professional standard

Deliver finished work as a Reaper session file so your process and decisions are visible and reviewable

Act as a second, independent set of ears on every episode after the editor's first technical pass

Catch and clean up anything missed in the initial edit (artifacts, pacing issues, inconsistent levels, awkward cuts, breath control, etc.)

Apply a documented quality standard consistently, and flag anything outside it rather than guessing

Communicate proactively if something needs a decision or is at risk of missing a deadline

What Success Looks Like

Clients consistently receive polished, professional audio without Jess needing to personally review it

Deliverables are on time, every time

Over time, Jess trusts your judgment as the final check on quality, not just an extra pass



You Might Be a Fit If You

Have hands-on experience mastering audio with iZotope RX, FabFilter, and/or Waves

Are comfortable working in Reaper

Have a trained ear for quality, pacing, and consistency, and notice things other people miss

Take ownership of your work rather than waiting to be told what's wrong

Communicate clearly and proactively

Want to grow with a small business and take on more independent ownership over time



Nice to Have, Not Required

Prior experience with podcast or audiobook production specifically

Experience mentoring or QC-ing another editor's work

Compensation & Structure



$8/hour, 10-20 hours per week -- hoping to grow more.
