title: EO Content & Local Search VA — WordPress, AEO/GEO
description:
## SEO Content & Local Search VA — WordPress, AEO/GEO



Rank Local is a growing U.S.-based web design and digital marketing agency looking for a skilled **SEO Content & Local Search Virtual Assistant** to support ongoing monthly client work.



This is **not** a basic VA position and it is not a pure project-management role.



I am looking for someone who understands Local SEO, on-page SEO, off-page SEO, SEO copywriting, AEO/GEO, and WordPress well enough to independently execute recurring client work without needing detailed instructions for every task.



The right person should be able to take an assignment such as:



> “Build a new city page for this client, optimize it for local search and AI search, publish it in WordPress, add internal links and schema, and make sure it supports the client’s Local SEO strategy.”



…and carry the project through to completion.



### Primary Responsibilities



* Write high-quality SEO blog articles, service pages, location pages, and landing pages.

* Research cities, services, competitors, keywords, and local search intent before writing.

* Create genuinely unique city/location content rather than simply changing city names in a template.

* Build and publish pages in WordPress.

* Duplicate existing page layouts and replace/restructure content appropriately.

* Handle on-page SEO including titles, headings, metadata, internal links, images, alt text, URL structure, and content optimization.

* Perform Local SEO work both **on-site and off-site**.

* Optimize and maintain Google Business Profiles.

* Work with citations, NAP consistency, directories, local links, reviews/reputation signals, and other local authority opportunities.

* Analyze local competitors and identify what is helping them rank.

* Help develop and execute SEO/AEO/GEO strategies.

* Optimize content for Google Search, Google Maps, AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and other AI-driven discovery platforms.

* Create and implement appropriate schema/structured data when needed.

* Monitor Search Console, rankings, indexing, and other SEO opportunities.

* Improve existing website pages instead of only producing new content.

* Help with ongoing monthly client deliverables and recurring SEO tasks.

* Assist with Rank Local’s own websites and content when client work is lighter.



### WordPress Skills



You do not need to be a senior web developer, but you must be comfortable working inside WordPress.



You should be able to:



* Create and edit pages and posts.

* Duplicate existing layouts.

* Format content properly.

* Add internal and external links.

* Add/edit images and alt text.

* Edit metadata.

* Work with common page builders or Gutenberg.

* Make basic layout/content corrections.

* Identify when an issue requires a developer instead of attempting something outside your ability.



### SEO Skills I Care About Most



Strong experience in:



* Local SEO

* On-page SEO

* Off-page SEO

* SEO copywriting

* Keyword research

* Content strategy

* Service-area and location-page optimization

* Google Business Profile optimization

* Local citations and NAP consistency

* Competitor analysis

* Internal linking

* Schema / structured data

* Search Console

* WordPress



Working knowledge of:



* AEO

* GEO

* AI search optimization

* Google AI Overviews

* ChatGPT / Gemini / Perplexity visibility

* Entity and authority signals



I am more interested in someone who **understands why something should be done** than someone who simply follows an SEO checklist.



### Writing Ability Is Very Important



A large part of this role will involve writing and improving website content.



You should be able to write natural, persuasive American-English copy for local businesses without producing generic AI-sounding content.



AI tools are welcome and encouraged when used properly, but I do not want someone who simply generates an article with ChatGPT and publishes it without research, editing, fact checking, localization, or critical thinking.



### The Person I Am Looking For



I want someone who:



* Thinks independently.

* Notices problems without waiting for me to point them out.

* Takes ownership of assigned work.

* Can research something unfamiliar and figure it out.

* Communicates clearly when something genuinely needs my decision.

* Does not require constant micromanagement.

* Is comfortable receiving constructive feedback.

* Wants a long-term position with room to grow.



### Hours



This position will start **part-time**.



Hours may vary initially based on client workload, but I expect the position to grow as Rank Local continues adding recurring clients.



I am open to candidates who are seeking either part-time work or who would eventually like to transition into a larger/full-time role.



Please tell me:



* Your desired hourly rate.

* How many hours per week you are available.

* What hours you normally work.

* How much overlap you can provide with U.S. Eastern Time.



### To Apply



Please send me:



1. A brief introduction about yourself and your SEO experience.

2. Examples of SEO content you personally wrote.

3. Examples of WordPress websites/pages you personally worked on.

4. A Local SEO campaign or project you personally worked on and what you did.

5. Any experience you have with AEO, GEO, AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Gemini, or Perplexity optimization.

6. Your experience with Google Business Profiles and off-site Local SEO.

7. Your hourly rate and availability.



**Important:** Please do not send a generic application.



In your application, answer this question:



> A local service business is opening a second operation approximately 1,500 miles away in another state. It is the same company and brand. Would you recommend one website with separate geographic silos, two completely separate websites, or a subdomain for the second market? Explain what factors you would consider before d
.



There is not necessarily one automatic answer. I am interested in seeing how you think.



This is intended to be a long-term role for the right person.



**Mark Cass**

**Rank Local**

title: Sourcing & Procurement Specialist — Australian Market
description:
About us



We are FELIXFUSION PTY LTD, an Australian-registered electrical engineering and equipment supply company. We bid on Australian tenders — government, council, utility and private developer — for electrical and general equipment supply and engineering advisory work. We are a small, senior team, and you will work directly with the Head of Procurement and own real sourcing work from your first week.



The role



This role is about one thing done well: finding suppliers and getting the best price. When we d
 to bid a tender, you find and contact manufacturers and distributors — in Australia and overseas — obtain written quotes, clarify specifications and lead times, and build the delivered-to-site cost. This is relationship, communication and negotiation work. It is the part of our business that cannot be automated, and the part we care most about.



What you will do

- Source suppliers: identify and contact manufacturers, distributors and agents (Australia, Asia, Europe, North America) for electrical equipment and materials — cable, switchboards, transformers, power electronics, lighting, generators, PPE, tools and site consumables.

- Chase quotes: issue RFQs, follow up until you have firm written quotes with lead times and validity dates, and request datasheets, compliance certificates and standards evidence.

- Clarify specifications: read the tender's technical requirements, match products to spec, and resolve gaps with suppliers before pricing.

- Build the landed cost: turn ex-works prices into a full delivered-to-site cost — Incoterms, freight, insurance, duty, GST, port and clearance, local delivery and FX — in a clear, auditable cost model.

- Negotiate: push on price, payment terms, minimum order quantities and lead time; build relationships with reliable suppliers for repeat sourcing.

- Keep it organised: maintain a supplier database and quote tracker; flag risks early (long lead times, single-source items, currency exposure).



Must-haves

- 3+ years hands-on procurement / sourcing or RFQ / quotation management.

- A track record of contacting suppliers and obtaining and comparing written quotes.

- Confident written English and comfortable
ing (and occasionally calling) international suppliers.

- Strong Excel and experience building or working with cost models.

- Detail-oriented, deadline-driven, and reliable working independently in a remote role.



Nice-to-haves

- Familiarity with electrical, technical or engineering products.

- ERP / procurement systems (Oracle, SAP, Ariba, NetSuite, Zycus).

- Incoterms, import, customs or freight knowledge.

- Exposure to the Australian market.



How to apply

Send your CV and a short note (a few sentences) describing a time you had to source a hard-to-find product: how you found suppliers, what you did to get competing quotes, and the result. Applications with this note will be prioritised.

You’ll turn field measurements, architectural plans, and client selection sheets into complete, production-ready Mozaik jobs — including elevations, plan views, 3D renderings, cut lists, and CNC output. You’ll work directly with our Florida-based design and production team on real jobs, so accuracy and turnaround time matter.



Responsibilities



 • Build kitchens, baths, closets, and built-ins in Mozaik from plans and field measure notes

 • Produce client-facing drawing packages (elevations, plan views, renderings)

 • Generate accurate cut lists, door/drawer schedules, and CNC files

 • Apply our shop standards, construction methods, and materials library

 • Revise drawings from designer and client markups

 • Communicate daily via Slack and Trello; attend occasional video check-ins (US Eastern time)



Requirements



 • Hands-on experience with Mozaik (Cabinet and/or Closet modules). This is non-negotiable — please note your version and years of use in your application.

 • Strong understanding of frameless cabinet construction, closet systems, and standard hardware (Blum, Richelieu, Salice, etc.)

 • Ability to read architectural plans and cabinet shop drawings

 • Excellent attention to detail — cut list errors cost real money in the shop

 • Reliable internet, a PC capable of running Mozaik, and a quiet workspace

 • Strong written English; availability to overlap at least 4 hours with US Eastern business hours



Nice to Have



 • Experience with US residential cabinet standards and appliance specs

 • Mozaik CNC/nesting and post-processor setup

 • AutoCAD, SketchUp, or 2020 Design

 • Prior work with a US cabinet shop or closet company



What We Offer



 • Long-term, stable role with a growing company

 • Structured Mozaik training and certification program with clear skill levels and advancement

 • Paid weekly via [your method]

 • [Rate range — e.g., $X–$Y/hour depending on experience]



How to Apply

Reply with:



 1. Your Mozaik experience (version, years, cabinet vs. closet, CNC output yes/no)

 2. 2–3 examples of Mozaik work — screenshots or PDFs of elevations/renderings you built

 3. Your available hours in US Eastern time

 4. Put the word “DOVETAIL” at the top of your application so we know you read this

title: No-Code AI & Dashboard Specialist
description:
About the Role

We are building a strategic growth and retail advisory platform for emerging consumer brands — helping CPG brands identify the right retail opportunities, build their go-to-market strategy, and connect with the right brokers, operators, and service partners to support their growth.



As our client base expands, we're looking for a highly capable and technically minded No-Code AI & Dashboard Specialist to take complex retail data, AI-generated insights, and account activity and transform them into intuitive, professional dashboards. The goal is to create a repeatable system where each client can clearly see their retail strategy, target accounts, current opportunities, product status, next actions, and key deadlines — all in one place.



This is not a basic data-entry role. We're looking for someone who can build, improve, and automate systems — comfortable working independently, experimenting with no-code and AI tools, and determining the best way to turn an idea or rough workflow into a functional solution.



Work Structure & Requirements



Location: Remote / Virtual

Schedule: Part-time

Time Zone: EST business hours

Compensation: $10 USD per hour



Key Responsibilities



1. Dashboard & Client Portal Development



Build polished, user-friendly dashboards for each client

Transform existing Excel/Google Sheets trackers into more intuitive and visually engaging interfaces

Create reusable dashboard templates that can quickly be replicated for new clients

Display information including: current retail distribution, priority retail targets, retail opportunity size, product/SKU information, retailer and broker ownership, outreach and buyer status, samples and submissions, buyer feedback, pricing discussions, upcoming retailer resets and deadlines, and key next steps

Explore opportunities to create a client login or portal where brands can view their own data and progress

Ensure dashboards feel polished, professional, and on-brand



2. AI & Workflow Automation



Work with existing ChatGPT/AI workflows used to generate retailer strategies and recommendations

Use AI to analyse brand information, product catalogs, and existing distribution

Help automate the creation of client dashboards and retail opportunity maps

Develop repeatable workflows so new client information can be uploaded and processed efficiently

Explore ways to automatically surface recommendations, deadlines, and next-best actions

Connect different tools and data sources using APIs and no-code automation platforms where appropriate

Continuously identify opportunities to remove manual work from the client onboarding and reporting process



3. Retail Data & Operations Support



Maintain accurate retailer, product, broker, and opportunity information within the system

Research retailer information including store counts, category fit, and other relevant account details

Help maintain retailer target lists and prioritization

Update client dashboards following meetings, broker feedback, and retailer developments

Ensure data remains organized, accurate, and easy to understand



Note: Over time, the role may also support adjacent areas such as buyer lead generation and outbound infrastructure.



Required Skills & Experience



Experience: 2+ years working with no-code tools, workflow automation, dashboards, operations systems, or internal tools

No-Code Platforms: Strong experience with one or more of: Lovable, Airtable, Softr, Glide, Retool, Bubble, or similar

Automation: Experience with Zapier, Make, or n8n

AI Tools: Very comfortable using ChatGPT and other AI tools as part of daily workflows

Data: Strong understanding of databases, structured data, and how information should flow between systems; comfortable working with APIs and integrations even without a traditional software development background

Spreadsheets: Strong Google Sheets and/or Excel skills

UX/UI: Strong eye for design and ability to make complex information easy to understand

Profile: Proactive, resourceful, detail-oriented, and comfortable testing new tools and approaches; able to take an ambiguous business requirement and independently determine how to build a solution

Communication: Strong written and spoken English



To Apply:

Kindly send your resume, portfolio and introduction video

title: B2B Sales, Marketing & Operations Manager
description:
**Company:** Diamond Interiors LLC

**Location:** Remote

**Market Served:** Metro Atlanta, Georgia

**Schedule:** Full-time, 30–40 hours per week

**Required Availability:** Must be available during Eastern Time business hours



## About Diamond Interiors



Diamond Interiors is a fast-growing Atlanta cleaning company serving commercial businesses, property professionals, short-term-rental operators, and residential clients.



We are expanding in two major areas:



1. Securing recurring commercial cleaning contracts throughout Metro Atlanta.

2. Building an online education and Skool community that teaches aspiring entrepreneurs how to launch and grow profitable cleaning businesses.



We are seeking a highly experienced, tech-savvy professional who can generate B2B leads, conduct outbound sales calls, manage marketing campaigns, support cleaner recruiting, create professional presentations, and operate and grow our Skool education platform.



This is not a basic administrative virtual-assistant position. It is a performance-driven sales, marketing, automation, and community-management role.



## Primary Responsibilities



### 1. B2B Lead Research and Data Collection



* Identify Atlanta-area businesses that may need recurring janitorial or contracted cleaning services.

* Build targeted prospect lists for offices, medical and dental practices, salons, spas, retail stores, property-management companies, apartment communities, real estate offices, childcare facilities, gyms, event venues, and other commercial properties.

* Identify decision-makers such as business owners, office managers, property managers, facility managers, community managers, and operations leaders.

* Collect and verify business names, decision-maker names, telephone numbers,
 addresses, websites, locations, industries, and prospect notes.

* Use Google Maps, LinkedIn, business directories, public databases, lead-generation platforms, and approved data-scraping tools.

* Clean, organize, deduplicate, and manage lead data in Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, or the company CRM.

* Research and recommend cost-effective tools for prospecting, contact enrichment,
 verification, outreach automation, and pipeline management.



### 2. Outbound Calling and Commercial Client Acquisition



* Make professional outbound calls to qualified businesses during Eastern Time business hours.

* Conduct cold and warm calls using approved scripts, offers, and follow-up sequences.

* Reach business owners and decision-makers while professionally navigating receptionists and gatekeepers.

* Identify each prospect’s cleaning needs, current provider, facility size, service frequency, challenges, budget, and decision timeline.

* Explain the value of Diamond Interiors’ contracted cleaning services.

* Confidently handle objections and move qualified prospects toward the next step.

* Schedule walkthroughs, cleaning assessments, trial cleanings, proposal calls, and consultations for the CEO.

* Follow up by telephone,
, text, LinkedIn, and other approved channels.

* Nurture opportunities from initial contact through proposal and contract stages.

* Assist with closing recurring commercial cleaning agreements within approved company guidelines.



### 3. CRM and Sales-Pipeline Management



* Maintain an accurate pipeline showing every prospect’s status, notes, next action, and follow-up date.

* Categorize prospects as new, contacted, qualified, appointment booked, walkthrough completed, proposal sent, follow-up required, won, lost, or future opportunity.

* Document all calls,
s, objections, appointments, and outcomes.

* Ensure no qualified opportunity is lost because of missed follow-up.

* Prepare daily activity updates and weekly performance reports.

* Track key performance indicators, including:



  * Qualified leads added

  * Outbound calls completed

  * Decision-makers reached

  * Follow-ups completed

  * Appointments and walkthroughs booked

  * Proposals requested or sent

  * Contracts won

  * Recurring monthly revenue generated

  * Lead-source and campaign conversion rates



### 4. Marketing and Social Media Management



* Develop and execute marketing campaigns for Diamond Interiors’ cleaning services and cleaning-business education programs.

* Create and schedule content for Instagram,
, LinkedIn, Skool,
, and other approved platforms.

* Conduct professional outreach through social media, direct messages, local business groups, and online communities.

* Respond promptly to comments, messages, inquiries, referrals, and quote requests.

* Create content featuring testimonials, cleaning results, educational tips, service benefits, client success stories, and business-development information.

* Repurpose long-form training content into short posts, captions,
s, presentation slides, checklists, and community discussions.

* Monitor engagement, lead volume, and conversions.

* Recommend improvements based on campaign performance and audience feedback.

* Help build awareness, trust, and authority for both Diamond Interiors and its cleaning-business education division.



### 5. Skool Community Management and Growth



* Help set up, organize, maintain, and improve the Diamond Interiors Skool community.

* Upload and organize courses, lessons, modules, videos, templates, checklists, resources, and assignments.

* Create clear course titles, descriptions, lesson summaries, announcements, and member instructions.

* Manage the Skool classroom, community calendar, events, member access, and course progression.

* Welcome new members and guide them through onboarding.

* Create automated onboarding messages, reminders, follow-up sequences, and engagement campaigns.

* Monitor member activity and identify members who need assistance or re-engagement.

* Respond to questions and comments professionally and promptly.

* Encourage discussions, accountability posts, progress updates, challenges, and success stories.

* Help maintain an active, supportive, and results-oriented community.

* Promote upcoming classes, workshops, office hours, challenges, and special events.

* Track membership growth, attendance, engagement, retention, course completion, and conversions.

* Research new Skool features, integrations, community-growth practices, and automation opportunities.

* Use approved automation and integration tools to reduce repetitive administrative work.

* Test automations before implementation and monitor them to ensure they continue working properly.

* Maintain the confidentiality of Diamond Interiors’ training materials, business systems, client information, and intellectual property.



### 6. Zoom Class and Meeting Operations



* Schedule recurring Zoom classes, coaching calls, workshops, consultations, and team meetings.

* Create and distribute meeting invitations, registration links, reminders, agendas, and preparation materials.

* Connect Zoom classes with the Skool calendar and other approved scheduling or automation systems.

* Attend assigned meetings and classes attentively.

* Monitor participant admission, attendance, chat messages, questions, recordings, and basic technical issues.

* Take organized meeting notes and document key decisions, questions, responsibilities, and deadlines.

* Create follow-up summaries and action-item lists after meetings.

* Upload class recordings and accompanying resources to the correct Skool course or community section.

* Add titles, summaries, timestamps, worksheets, and calls to action to recorded classes when required.

* Send replay notifications and follow-up messages to members who attended or missed the session.

* Maintain an organized archive of recordings, presentations, meeting notes, templates, and educational materials.

* Help automate class reminders, attendance follow-ups, replay distribution, and member re-engagement.



### 7. Presentation and Educational Content Creation



* Create polished PowerPoint, Google Slides, or Canva presentations for:



  * Cleaning-business courses

  * Live Zoom classes

  * Commercial client proposals

  * Sales presentations

  * Cleaner training

  * Team meetings

  * Webinars and workshops

  * Standard operating procedures

* Turn the CEO’s voice notes, outlines, recordings, documents, and ideas into well-organized educational materials.

* Create worksheets, checklists, templates, workbooks, scripts, guides, and downloadable resources.

* Maintain consistent Diamond Interiors branding across presentations and course materials.

* Proofread all materials for grammar, spelling, accuracy, clarity, and visual consistency.

* Keep source files organized and editable for future updates.

* Use AI tools responsibly to improve efficiency without publishing inaccurate, generic, or unapproved content.



### 8. Cleaner Recruiting and Operational Support



* Recruit dependable Atlanta-area cleaners to support newly acquired contracts.

* Source permanent, part-time, freelance, and per-diem cleaning professionals.

* Post job advertisements and identify effective recruiting platforms.

* Screen applicants for experience, availability, transportation, service area, professionalism, and reliability.

* Schedule qualified candidates for interviews with the CEO.

* Maintain an organized pipeline of available cleaners.

* Assist with matching cleaners to assignments using company checklists and service requirements.

* Help ensure staffing capacity grows alongside the client base.



## Required Qualifications



Applicants must meet all of the following requirements:



* Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution.

* At least five years of relevant experience in B2B sales, lead generation, telemarketing, appointment setting, marketing, automation, online-community management, recruiting, or a closely related field.

* Fluent, professional English speaking and writing skills.

* Clear, confident, and easy-to-understand telephone presence.

* Demonstrated experience making outbound cold calls to businesses.

* Proven ability to generate qualified leads, book appointments, overcome objections, and contribute to closed sales.

* Advanced working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets, including sorting, filtering, formulas, data cleanup, deduplication, and lead tracking.

* Experience using CRMs, lead databases, sales pipelines,
 marketing, and automation tools.

* Experience creating professional presentations in PowerPoint, Google Slides, or Canva.

* Experience managing an online community, membership, course, or education platform.

* Ability to learn and confidently manage the Skool platform.

* Experience coordinating Zoom meetings, webinars, classes, and recordings.

* Strong social media marketing, written communication, organization, and follow-up skills.

* Reliable computer, high-speed internet, professional calling environment, quality headset, and working camera.

* Ability to work independently and remain accountable for measurable outcomes.

* Availability during Metro Atlanta/Eastern Time business hours.



## Preferred Qualifications



* Direct experience using Skool as an administrator or community manager.

* Experience selling commercial cleaning, janitorial, facility-maintenance, property-management, or contracted B2B services.

* Experience marketing coaching programs, online courses, memberships, or business communities.

* Experience with LinkedIn prospecting, Google Maps lead generation, contact-enrichment platforms, and approved data-scraping systems.

* Experience using no-code automation platforms and connecting forms, calendars, CRMs,
 systems, Zoom, and community platforms.

* Experience developing presentation decks, workbooks, SOPs, onboarding materials, and educational content.

* Experience recruiting cleaners or other service-based workers.

* Basic video-editing or content-repurposing experience.

* Knowledge of the Metro Atlanta business market.

* Evidence of meeting previous sales, appointment-setting, engagement, or revenue goals.



## Performance Expectations



Commercial client acquisition is the first priority of this role. The Skool community and education division is the second major priority.



Performance will be evaluated based on:



* Quality and accuracy of leads

* Outbound activity and conversations with decision-makers

* Qualified appointments and walkthroughs booked

* Proposals and recurring contracts generated

* Recurring monthly revenue produced

* Follow-up consistency

* Accuracy of the CRM and spreadsheets

* Skool membership growth and engagement

* Class attendance and course completion

* Timeliness and quality of presentations and educational materials

* Reliability of automations

* Quality of meeting notes and follow-through

* Cleaner pipeline growth



The successful candidate must produce measurable business growth—not simply remain busy.



## Position Details



* Full-time remote position: 10–40 hours per week.

* Long-term opportunity for the right candidate.

* Base compensation based on experience.

* Performance bonuses may be offered for qualified appointments, signed recurring clients, revenue generated, membership growth, course sales, and successful cleaner placements.

* Opportunity to advance into a Business Development, Marketing, Community, or Operations leadership position as Diamond Interiors grows.



## How to Apply



Please submit all of the following:



1. A brief introduction explaining your B2B sales, cold-calling, lead-generation, marketing, automation, community-management, and recruiting experience.

2. Your current résumé and LinkedIn profile or portfolio, if available.

3. A short voice recording introducing yourself and explaining why you are qualified.

4. A description of your most successful outbound-sales campaign, including measurable results.

5. Details about any online community, membership, coaching program, or course platform you have managed.

6. A list of the CRM, automation, data-scraping, spreadsheet, marketing, presentation, Zoom, and community-management tools you have used.

7. One sample presentation or training resource you personally created.

8. A sample lead-generation spreadsheet with all confidential information removed.

9. Confirmation that you can work during Eastern Time business hours.

10. Three dates and times when you are available for a Zoom interview.



Please begin your application with the words **“Diamond B2B and Skool Growth”** so we know you carefully read the complete posting.



Applications missing the work samples, or requested information may not be considered.

Job Overview

Configure user roles, permissions, and access levels as needed.

Automation & Workflow Development

5. Build advanced workflows using triggers, conditions, and actions.

Work Details



Remote position.

Paid hourly (rate based on experience).

title: Sales Representative
description:
Join a fast-growing US online home goods retailer and enjoy the learning and opportunities that you have while working with us.



We strive to provide 5-star service & shopping assistance to all of our clients, and all of our team is accountable for fulfilling this.



We are looking for a Sales Representative who can assist prospective buyers and close online ecommerce sales.



We're only looking for full-time, long-term, ongoing cooperation.



Work schedules available:

8 AM to 4 PM US EST

4 PM to 12 AM US EST



Your work week will be 5 days per week, with 2 days off per week. Days off will be selected with your manager. We will try to accommodate your preferences for which days you like, based on availability.



This role starts ASAP.



Job Duties and Responsibilities:

Receive incoming phone calls and live chats from potential customers (prospects) who indicated that they need shopping assistance. This does not include calls and chats from existing customers that need help with their orders (that’s a job for a different department)

Makes follow-up calls, writes follow-up
s, and text messages to potential buyers. We try to follow up 5x with each person that contacted us (unless they indicate that they are no longer interested). We don’t do cold calling. Only reaching out to prospects who interacted with our online store and left their contact information.

After each interaction with a prospect/customer, writes notes & comments in our CRM (Asana)

Communicate efficiently and build rapport with potential customers

Assists prospects in their shopping journey and helps make the purchase decision

title: Appointment Setter - Cold Calling for US B2B Cleaning Company
description:
# Appointment Setter - Cold Calling for US Cleaning Company



## Form fields



**Type of employment:** Full Time

**Wage/salary:** $700/month base + commission. $1,000/month at target. Uncapped.

**Desired hours per week:** 40

**Business or contact name:** Anvil Facility Services



---



We are a commercial cleaning company in New York City. We clean offices, medical practices, luxury retail stores, and similar facilities. We are hiring one appointment setter to call businesses and book walkthrough appointments for the owner.



This is a phone job. You will make 200 to 250 calls per day. If you do not like calling strangers, do not apply.



## What you will do



1. Call businesses from a list we provide. You will never build your own list.

2. Ask to speak to the person who handles cleaning.

3. Follow our script. Offer a free 20-minute walkthrough and quote.

4. Book the appointment directly on the owner's calendar while you are still on the phone.

5. Send a confirmation
 within 10 minutes of booking, a reminder
 the day before, and a text the morning of. Getting people to actually show up is part of the job, not an afterthought.

6. Log every call in the dialer. It syncs to our CRM automatically.

7. Build tomorrow's callback list during the midday break.

8. Send a short report at the end of every shift with your numbers.



## Schedule



Monday to Friday, 9:00 PM to 6:00 AM Manila time. This covers US East Coast business hours. This schedule does not change. If you cannot work nights permanently, do not apply.



The day runs in blocks:



1. 9:00 PM to 11:30 PM Manila. Dialing. Callbacks first, then new list.

2. 11:30 PM to 12:30 AM. Dialing.

3. 12:30 AM to 1:30 AM. Break, confirmation
s and texts, tomorrow's callback list.

4. 1:30 AM to 4:30 AM. Dialing.

5. 4:30 AM to 5:00 AM. End of shift report.



## Pay



$700 per month base, paid twice monthly.



Plus $20 for every walkthrough that is held. A walkthrough counts as held when the owner shows up and the meeting happens. It does not count if the prospect cancels or no-shows, which is why the confirmation
s and texts matter.



At 15 held walkthroughs per month you earn $1,000. There is no cap. At 25 held you earn $1,200.



13th month pay in December.



## What we provide



Power dialer, phone numbers, lead lists, CRM access, the script, and training. You do not pay for any tools.



## What you need



1. Clear spoken English. US businesses will hang up if they cannot understand you.

2. Wired internet, minimum 10 Mbps upload. Not mobile data.

3. A USB headset with a boom microphone. Not earbuds.

4. A quiet room. No roosters, no traffic, no family in the background.

5. Experience making cold calls to US businesses. Tell us where and for how long.



## Nice to have



Experience with HubSpot and any power dialer. Experience selling to small businesses. B2B appointment setting for a service business.



## How to apply



Applications that skip any of these three items will not be read.



1. Put the word ANVIL in your subject line.

2. Answer these three questions in your message:

   - What was your highest single-day dial count, and at what company?

   - A receptionist says "we already have a cleaning company." What is your next sentence?

   - Run a speed test and paste your upload speed.

3. Record yourself saying these two lines and attach the audio file:

   - "Hi, this is [your name] calling from Anvil Facility Services. Who handles the cleaning for your office?"

   - "We are doing free 20-minute walkthroughs in the neighborhood this week. Would Tuesday morning or Thursday afternoon work better?"

Deluxe Beauty Co is a Gold Coast-based beauty studio and education brand specialising in Korean lash lifts and brow treatments. We run both a client-facing studio and an online education arm — including a self-paced course, 1:1 mentorship program, and live webinars.

- Flagging any engagement that needs a personal response

- DM Handling (potential, depending on fit)

- Responding to common/repeat questions using provided templates

- Flagging sales-relevant or sensitive conversations for personal follow-up

- Keeping an organised log of leads/questions coming through DMs



6. Growth & Revenue Support (priority tasks):

- Ad creative refresh — Rotating fresh creative into evergreen ad campaigns using provided templates, so paid ads never go stale from being left running too long

- Lead & DM warmth screening — Using a provided scoring rubric to review inbound leads/DMs and flag the warm ones for personal follow-up, so only high-intent conversations land on my desk

- Testimonial & case study collection — Proactively following up with current and past clients to gather results, screenshots, and quotes, then formatting them into ready-to-post testimonials/case studies

- Weekly funnel reporting — Pulling key numbers (ad spend, landing page views, checkout starts) into a simple weekly tracker, so performance is visible without digging through Meta Ads Manager



4. Additional Support (open to depending on your skills)

- Scheduling posts/Stories in advance using our content calendar

- Assisting with Flodesk
 sequences (formatting, scheduling, light copy edits from provided drafts)

- Hashtag and trend research to keep content discoverable

What We're Looking For:

- Strong eye for design and brand consistency (Canva experience essential)

- Comfortable with Instagram (Reels, Stories, carousels) and ideally Thinkific

- Excellent written English — you'll be writing in our brand voice, which is confident, direct, and casual

- Reliable, proactive communicator — happy to ask questions but doesn't need micromanaging once trained

- Beauty/wellness industry experience required — see note above

- Available for regular daily check-ins/updates



Brand Voice Snapshot (for context):

Our content is confident, direct, and unfiltered — written at an accessible reading level, with lots of white space and short, punchy sentences. Nothing overly corporate or stiff. You'll be given templates and examples to work from, so you don't need to guess our tone.

title: After Hours Travel Coordinator – Luxury Tourism
description:
Location: Remote – Philippines

Employment Type: Part-Time

Working Hours:



Weekdays: within 5:30 PM – 9:00 AM Australian time

Weekends & Australian Public Holidays: as required

Hours during standard Australian business hours may be required for operational briefings, debriefings, training, and handovers at mutually agreed times.







About the Role



Our client is seeking an experienced After Hours Coordinator to provide high-level support to guests travelling throughout Australia outside of standard business hours.



The After Hours Coordinator will serve as a key point of contact for travelling guests, providing prompt, professional, and reassuring assistance when support is required. The role involves managing guest requests, travel changes, service disruptions, and urgent situations while coordinating closely with Travel Advisors, suppliers, and the wider travel operations team.



This is a highly guest-focused position suited to someone with strong experience in luxury tourism or travel operations, excellent judgement, and the confidence to manage urgent situations independently.



The successful candidate will be expected to take ownership of guest matters from initial contact through to resolution, while maintaining clear communication, accurate documentation, and seamless handovers to the daytime team.



Key Responsibilities



Guest Support & Communication



Act as the primary after-hours point of contact for guests travelling throughout Australia via phone and WhatsApp, where applicable.

Respond promptly and professionally to guest enquiries, requests, and urgent situations.

Provide calm, reassuring, and solutions-focused assistance, particularly when guests experience unexpected issues or travel disruptions.

Deliver a high-touch level of service and proactively look for opportunities to go above and beyond for guests.

Maintain a professional and personable approach across all guest interactions.

Travel Operations & Issue Resolution



Manage after-hours requests including itinerary amendments, booking changes, operational assistance, and emergency situations.

Coordinate changes to travel arrangements as required, liaising with accommodation providers, transport operators, tour operators, guides, and other tourism suppliers.

Proactively manage and resolve travel disruptions that arise outside standard office hours.

Assess situations independently and determine appropriate solutions while working within established procedures and client requirements.

Follow matters through to resolution, ensuring guests receive appropriate support and clear communication throughout.

Escalate complex, sensitive, or unresolved matters to the relevant Travel Advisor or management when required.

Communication & Coordination



Maintain clear, timely, and accurate communication with guests, Travel Advisors, suppliers, and relevant team members.

Ensure all relevant parties are kept informed of itinerary changes, actions taken, associated costs, and outstanding requirements.

Liaise with local tourism suppliers outside standard business hours when necessary to implement changes or resolve guest issues.

Provide clear and comprehensive handovers to the daytime travel operations team.

Participate in operational briefings, debriefings, and handovers during mutually agreed standard Australian business hours.

Systems & Administration



Accurately document all guest interactions, requests, actions taken, and follow-up requirements within the CRM.

Update booking and itinerary systems to accurately reflect changes made during after-hours support.

Maintain detailed and accurate records to ensure continuity of service between the after-hours and daytime teams.

Coordinate payment collection for additional guest services where required, or liaise with the relevant Travel Advisor to facilitate payment processing.

Ensure all guest matters and outstanding actions are appropriately recorded and handed over.

About You



The successful candidate will have:



5+ years of experience in the luxury tourism, travel, or high-end guest services industry.

Strong experience supporting travellers and managing travel-related requests, changes, or disruptions.

Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.

Exceptional customer service and relationship management skills.

Strong problem-solving skills and sound judgement.

A high level of confidence managing urgent situations independently.

A calm, composed, and professional approach when dealing with stressed or distressed travellers.

Excellent attention to detail and strong organisational skills.

The ability to take ownership of an issue and see it through to resolution.

Experience using CRM systems and travel booking or itinerary platforms.

Strong computer literacy and the ability to work confidently across multiple systems.

A proactive, solutions-focused approach and a genuine commitment to delivering an exceptional guest experience.

Flexibility and reliability to work evenings, weekends, and Australian public holidays.

What the Client Is Looking For



The ideal candidate will be someone who can confidently operate independently after hours while maintaining the same level of service expected during standard business hours.



You will be trusted to make sound decisions, manage urgent travel situations, communicate effectively with guests and suppliers, and ensure every matter is properly resolved or handed over to the appropriate team member.



A strong understanding of luxury travel, Australian tourism, guest expectations, and travel operations will be highly valued.

title: Technical Drafter – Windows, Doors, Façade & Automation Shop Drawings
description:
About Airla



Airla Automation Systems specialises in automated architectural openings and smart building systems. We work on automated windows, doors, louvres, sliding doors, pivot doors and other motorised architectural systems for residential and commercial projects across Australia.



We are looking for a technically strong drafter who can prepare professional, submission-ready shop drawings for architects, builders, façade contractors, window and door fabricators, electricians and other project stakeholders.



This is not a general architectural drafting role. We specifically need someone who is comfortable producing detailed technical drawings for windows, doors, aluminium framing, façade interfaces and mechanical/electrical automation components.



The Role:



You will be responsible for preparing and maintaining Airla's technical drawings, shop drawings, coordination drawings and as-built documentation.



You will work from architectural drawings, window and door schedules, supplier technical manuals, product datasheets, site measurements, photographs, sketches and instructions from the Airla technical team.



Typical drawings may show:



- window and door elevations

- head, jamb and sill sections

- mullion and transom details

- aluminium profile details

- automated window actuators

- sliding and stacking door motors

- pivot door operators

- actuator brackets and fixing points

- clearances and operating zones

- cable entry locations and pathways

- control equipment locations

- interface requirements between automation systems and window/door framing



Your drawings need to be accurate enough to be issued to builders, architects, consultants, window fabricators and installers for coordination and approval.



Key Responsibilities:



- Prepare detailed AutoCAD shop drawings for automated windows, doors, louvres and façade systems.

- Produce plans, elevations, sections and enlarged technical details.

- Interpret architectural drawings, façade drawings, window schedules and door schedules.

- Read and understand aluminium window and door system technical manuals.

- Draw aluminium profiles and framing interfaces accurately.

- Incorporate actuators, motors, brackets, switches, sensors and automation components into architectural details.

- Show dimensions, fixing locations, clearances and installation requirements.

- Prepare drawings showing how Airla equipment interfaces with window and door fabricators' products.

- Prepare markups and coordination drawings for project teams.

- Revise drawings following architect, builder, consultant or fabricator comments.

- Maintain drawing numbers, revision histories and document control.

- Prepare as-built drawings after installation.

- Assist the estimator and technical team with drawing interpretation where required.

- Identify missing information, clashes or unclear details before drawings are issued.

- Raise technical questions rather than making unsupported assumptions.

- Maintain Airla drawing templates and standard details.

- Help develop a library of standard Airla actuator, motor, bracket and control details.



Essential Experience:



Applicants should have professional drafting experience involving at least one of the following:



- aluminium windows and doors

- façade systems

- curtain wall

- glazing

- architectural metalwork

- shop drawings

- fabrication drawings

- architectural detailing



You should understand how detailed shop drawings differ from general architectural drawings.



Software Requirements



Essential:

- AutoCAD – strong proficiency

- Microsoft Office / Google Workspace

- PDF markup software such as Bluebeam or similar

Highly regarded:

- Revit

- ArchiCAD

- SketchUp

- Bluebeam Revu

- BIM 360 / Autodesk Construction Cloud



Highly Regarded Experience



Experience with any of the following will be highly valued:

- Alspec

- AWS / Elevate

- Capral

- Schüco

- Reynaers

- Aluprof

- Technal

- Kawneer

- commercial aluminium windows and doors

- sliding and stacking door systems

- operable louvres

- curtain wall systems

- façade contractors

- Australian construction projects

- Australian architectural documentation standards



Experience with automation equipment is helpful but not essential. We can teach you our actuators, motors and control systems.



What is much harder to teach is a proper understanding of windows, doors, aluminium framing and façade detailing.



The Person We Are Looking For



You should be:

- extremely detail-oriented

- technically minded

- comfortable reading complex architectural drawings

- able to work independently

- willing to question unclear information

- organised with drawing revisions and file management

- comfortable communicating in written English

- capable of following Airla drawing standards

- interested in learning automated architectural systems



We value accuracy over speed. A technically incorrect drawing issued quickly is worse than a carefully checked drawing issued slightly later.



Important



This position is not primarily for:

- interior designers

- 3D visualisation artists

- general floor-plan drafters

- civil drafters

- structural drafters

- landscape designers



Applicants without detailed window, door, façade or fabrication drawing experience may not be suitable.



How to Apply



Please send the following:

1. Your CV.

2. Your expected monthly or hourly contractor rate in PHP.

3. Your earliest available start date.

4. The software you use.

5. Three to five examples of shop drawings you personally prepared.

6. At least one example showing detailed window, door, façade, curtain wall or aluminium framing sections if available.

7. A short explanation of exactly what parts of each submitted drawing you personally completed.



Please remove or hide confidential client information where necessary.



Applications without drawing samples may not be considered.



Practical Test



Shortlisted applicants will be given a paid or short practical drafting assessment.



You may be provided with:

- an architectural drawing

- a window or door detail

- an aluminium system technical manual

- an Airla actuator or motor datasheet

- installation requirements



You will then be asked to prepare a short shop drawing showing the proposed automation arrangement.



We will assess:

- drawing accuracy

- understanding of the window/door system

- dimensions and clearances

- technical presentation

- ability to interpret source documents

- attention to detail

- ability to identify missing information

- drawing organisation and revision quality



Long-Term Opportunity

The role will initially be approximately 15–25 hours per week, depending on project workload.

For the right person, this can develop into a larger role as Airla grows its window, door, façade and building automation operations.



The long-term goal is for this person to become Airla's dedicated Technical Drafter / Shop Drawing Specialist, maintaining our technical drawing library and supporting projects from tender through to installation and as-built documentation.

title: Freight Billing Specialist
description:
GH Logistics is a growing freight brokerage and asset based logistics company specializing in dry van and refrigerated freight. Built on disciplined systems, structured SOPs, and financial accuracy, we operate with a strong focus on execution, accountability, and real-time visibility.



As we scale nationally, we are hiring a Freight Billing Specialist to serve as a critical financial control point across both load validation and carrier invoicing workflows, ensuring loads and invoices are accurate, fully documented, dispute-free, and ready for Finance and factoring.



Role Overview

You will act as the final gatekeeper before loads and invoices move to Finance and factoring, ensuring every load is fully validated first, then properly invoiced and submitted. This role requires flexibility, ownership, and the ability to operate across both functions without compromising accuracy or SOP compliance.



What You’ll Be Doing



Load Validation

• Validate all loads before final status (Completed, Cancelled, or TONU)

• Ensure every load reaches complete status (fully documented, financially accurate, dispute-free)

• Review and correct load statuses in TMS

• Enforce complete documentation (BOL, POD, white slips, rate confirmations, accessorials)

• Upload and verify documents in TMS and ELD systems

• Confirm financial accuracy (rates, TONU logic, FSC, accessorials, fines)

• Own and investigate carrier disputes before escalation

• Apply correct TONU vs Cancel determinations

• Maintain structured, audit ready notes on every load

• Prevent incomplete or inaccurate loads from reaching Finance

• Prepare validated loads for invoicing and factoring submission



Carrier Invoicing

• Upload and process carrier invoices accurately in TMS

• Verify invoice amounts against rate confirmations and approved charges

• Ensure all required documents are complete (POD, BOL, detention, lumper, etc.)

• Request and follow up on missing or incomplete invoices

• Coordinate with carriers and factoring companies for documentation

• Identify discrepancies and escalate with proper support

• Submit validated loads to factoring companies per requirements

• Resolve Held, Rejected, and Denied invoices

• Maintain structured, audit-ready invoice records

• Prevent incomplete or unsupported invoices from reaching Finance



Fuel Surcharge Updates & Fines and Detention Processing 

• Update and validate daily Fuel Surcharge (FSC) values before load submission, reconciling Customer vs. TMS revenue and adjusting Line Haul Fees as needed.

• Review and process carrier fines, including compliance photo validation, FourKites/POD verification, LoadStop updates, revised Rate Confirmations, and carrier disputes within the required timelines.

• Review and process detention requests by validating documentation and timestamps, calculating applicable charges, and rejecting requests that cannot be verified.



What Success Looks Like

• 95%+ of loads reach Finance without rework

• 0 missing documents (POD, white slips, etc.) at billing stage

• 0 financial discrepancies identified by Finance

• All loads and invoices are fully audit-ready

• Minimal disputes due to documentation or validation errors

• Loads and invoices processed within 24–48 hours

• Factoring submissions meet compliance standards



Required Skills & Qualifications

• Experience in US freight brokerage, load auditing, QA, carrier billing, or operations

• Strong understanding of dry van & refrigerated freight

• Knowledge of TONU, rate confirmations, accessorials, and FSC

• Familiarity with TMS, ELD, and tracking systems

• Experience with factoring companies (preferred)

• Strong documentation discipline and audit mindset

• High attention to financial accuracy and detail

• Ability to enforce SOPs without shortcuts

• Strong written and verbal English communication

• Minimum 45–50 WPM typing speed

• Comfortable working in a structured, accountability-driven environment

• Ability to shift priorities between validation and invoicing workflows



Schedule & Work Setup

• Full Time Remote Role| Direct Hire to US Company

• Current Shift Availability: Monday - Friday 8 AM - 5 PM CDT | Wednesday - Sunday 8 AM - 5 PM CDT

• Zoom presence (with camera open) required

• Time tracking software used for accountability and performance support



Why Join GH Logistics?

• Independent Contractor Setup

• $75 monthly insurance stipend (eligibility begins 30 days after hire)

• SOP-driven operational systems

• High impact financial control role across two critical workflows

• Direct involvement in revenue protection and billing accuracy

• Performance based growth opportunities

• Structured training and certification path



If you take pride in closing operational loops, enforcing standards, and ensuring financial accuracy from validation to invoicing, this role is designed for you.

title: Short-Form TikTok Editor (Spark Creator)
description:
SALARY: PHP 90,000–120,000/month (~$1,600–$2,100 USD) — with performance bonuses and raises as you prove out.



Hours: Full-time, structured daily schedule







Read this part first - 



Most editing jobs on here are churn-and-burn: vague briefs, no system, a client who disappears, and you're treated as disposable. This is the opposite. I'm building a small, elite team around a paid TikTok ad operation that's already working. I run on documented systems, clear SOPs, and clean structure. I pay top-of-market because I'm hiring one person for this seat and I want the best editor sitting in it, long-term.



If you're genuinely elite at native, organic-style TikTok editing — the kind that looks like a real person filmed it, not a brand ad — and you want a stable seat where there's a real path to grow with the company: keep reading.









The mission -



We produce high-volume, native-style TikTok content we call Sparks — short videos engineered to stop the scroll and pull a real reaction in the first second. Not corporate. Not YouTube-style. Not polished brand ads. Raw, fast, native-to-the-FYP content that looks organic and converts.



You'll work from briefs, hooks, references, and a documented Spark SOP. You're not inventing 50 videos from scratch — you're running a proven creative system at speed: core builds, hook swaps, variations, recuts. The system is mapped. Your job is to execute it at elite quality and volume, every single day, and to make each Spark feel native and alive.







What you'll do -



• Produce 30–50 Sparks/day off our documented system — core builds plus rapid variations (new hooks, new openers, recuts)



• Nail a specific native-FYP style from our reference library — casual, organic, scroll-stopping



• Work fluently with slideshows, text-on-screen, native captions, trending audio, and quick-cut footage



• Follow our naming, formatting, and delivery system precisely (clean operators win here)



• Hit daily output targets without the quality ever dropping



• Take feedback fast, iterate faster, and bring your own instincts for what makes a video hit







Who I'm looking for (non-negotiable) -



• Proven native-style short-form work — TikTok / Reels / Shorts in the casual, organic look (not brand promos). Your portfolio is the proof.



• Genuine speed with quality — you can produce volume without it ever looking mass-produced



• CapCut fluency (Premiere a plus) — fast, clean, precise



• Deep feel for TikTok pacing: 1-second hooks, fast cuts, native text styling, trend awareness



• Reliable daily availability and sharp, consistent communication



• Stable internet + a machine that handles daily video work without choking







What makes you stand out -



• Experience editing for paid ads / performance marketing, not just organic creators



• A real instinct for why a video stops the scroll vs. gets skipped



• Fluency in US-audience TikTok trends, humor, and rhythm







Why this seat is worth it -



• Top-of-market pay (?90k–?120k), with bonuses tied to winning Sparks and raises as you prove out. 



• Stability — this is a long-term core seat, not a one-off gig. I want you here for years. 



• Real systems — documented SOPs, clean briefs, reference libraries. You'll never be guessing.



• Growth path — as trust builds, this seat can grow into a lead creative role as the team expands



• Respect — your work is the engine of the business, and you'll be treated that way







How to apply (follow exactly — anything that skips a step is deleted) -



This is a competitive seat. I read every application that follows the steps, and I ignore every one that doesn't. 







Do all four:



• Put the word SCROLL at the very top of your application, so I know you read this in full.



• Send 3 examples of native-style TikTok / Reels / Shorts videos you personally edited. They must be the casual, organic-looking style — not corporate or brand promos. Make sure the links actually work.



• In 2–3 sentences, answer: What makes a TikTok hook stop someone from scrolling in the first 1 second?



• In one line, tell me the single best Spark/video you ever edited and why it worked (numbers if you have them — views, retention, conversions).







Strong applicants who show real native work and a sharp answer to #3 move to a paid test edit (a real Spark from a real brief). Nail the test and you're in.



I'm hiring one person for this. Make me certain it's you.

title: Recruiting Operations Manager, Spend Talent (Remote, Full-Time)
description:
We're a US-based recruiting agency that places creative strategists at e-commerce and DTC brands. The agency is established with active clients and a proven placement process. We need someone to own the day-to-day operations while the founder focuses on business development and client relationships.



This is not a VA role. You will be running the recruiting pipeline from end to end. Finding candidates, vetting them through conversations, managing the CRM, generating documents using our AI systems, coordinating interviews, and handling all candidate and client communication through messaging.



What You'll Own



The entire candidate pipeline. Sourcing candidates using scraping tools (Apollo, Phantom Buster, Hunter, or similar), LinkedIn outreach, job board monitoring, and prospect lists. Having professional back-and-forth DM conversations with candidates on LinkedIn to evaluate their experience, skills, and fit. Running candidate information through our AI-powered evaluation system and organizing the output in Airtable. Sending opportunity briefs to matched candidates, collecting interest, and coordinating interviews between candidates and clients. Handling all post-placement check-ins with both candidates and clients. Managing all documents including agreements, invoices, candidate briefs, and opportunity briefs using templates and tools we provide. Keeping Airtable fully updated at all times with every candidate's status, notes, and information. Following up on unsigned agreements, unpaid invoices, and unresponsive candidates using our follow-up sequences.



What You Won't Own



New client acquisition calls. The founder handles these. Agreement negotiations. The founder handles these. Final candidate approval. You flag your top picks, the founder reviews and approves. Strategic decisions about pricing, client selection, or business direction.



What Makes This Role Different



We've built AI-powered systems that handle most of the analytical work. You don't need to be a creative strategist or a marketing expert. You need to follow our processes, use our AI tools effectively, and communicate professionally with candidates and clients. The systems do the heavy thinking. You manage the execution and the relationships.



Who You Are



Exceptional written English. This is the most critical requirement. You will be having professional conversations with creative strategists, marketing professionals, and brand founders in the US, UK, and other English-speaking countries. Your writing must be natural, clear, and professional. Not robotic. Not overly formal. Conversational and credible.



Experienced with prospecting and scraping tools. You've used Apollo, Phantom Buster, Hunter, Snov, Clay, or similar tools to build prospect lists and find contact information at scale.



Highly organized. You'll be managing dozens of candidates across different stages simultaneously, tracking multiple client searches, and keeping a CRM perfectly updated. Nothing falls through the cracks.



Self-motivated and proactive. You'll be given targets and processes. You don't need daily check-ins. You manage your time, hit your numbers, and flag issues before they become problems.



Good judgment about people. Through text conversations, you can tell the difference between someone who's genuinely skilled and someone who's just talking a good game. We'll train you on what to look for, but the instinct helps.



Comfortable with AI tools. You'll be using Claude AI projects daily to generate documents, evaluate candidates, and build client materials. You don't need AI experience, but you should be comfortable learning new tools quickly and following prompt-based workflows.



Required Experience



Strong written English communication. Non-negotiable. Experience with at least one data scraping or prospecting tool (Apollo, Phantom Buster, Hunter, Snov, Clay, or similar). Experience with a CRM or database tool (Airtable, Google Sheets, HubSpot, or similar). Experience in any role involving recruiting, sourcing, outreach, lead generation, or professional communication. Minimum 2 years of professional work experience.



Preferred Experience



Previous experience in recruiting or talent acquisition. Experience managing pipelines or operations independently. Familiarity with marketing, advertising, or e-commerce industries. Experience with LinkedIn Sales Navigator. Experience setting up automated scraping workflows or multi-tool prospecting systems.



Schedule



Full-time. Must be available during US business hours for at least 5 to 6 hours of overlap with Eastern Standard Time.



How to Apply



Send a message introducing yourself in your own words. Do not use AI. Tell me about your relevant experience, which scraping tools you've used, and why you think you'd be a good fit for running recruiting operations independently. Include your LinkedIn profile if you have one.



We'll send a short test to qualified applicants before making a final decision.

- A confident, friendly communicator who's comfortable on the phone and enjoys helping customers

- Self-motivated and able to work independently — you don't need someone standing over your shoulder

- Eager to learn new skills and genuinely curious about e-commerce and how online businesses grow

- Comfortable working in a fast-paced start-up where things change quickly

Experience isn't essential— attitude, work ethic and organisation matter far more to us. If you're a fast learner who wants to work hard and grow, we want to hear from you.



What we offer

- $1,200-$1,800 per month salary - depending on experience

- 40 hours per week, full-time and permanent

To apply, we'd love to see a bit of your personality — so instead of a cover letter, please record a short Loom video (under 2 minutes) and send it to 
 your video, please answer these three questions: (1) Why do you think you'd be great for this role? (2) What previous experience do you have that will help you excel here? Don't worry about it being polished — we just want to get a feel for who you are, so keep it natural and be yourself. We can't wait to meet you!

Ready to work hard, learn fast and grow with us? Apply now — we'd love to hear from you.

title: Senior WordPress Developer & Graphic Designer – Full-Time
description:
We’re a 34-year-old Australian technology and events company looking for a highly capable Senior WordPress Developer & Graphic Designer to join our team full-time.



This is a hands-on technical and creative role. We are looking for someone who is genuinely strong in BOTH WordPress development and graphic design.



You’ll work directly with our Australian Sales Manager and become a key part of developing and improving our websites, landing pages, product pages, graphics, photography and overall digital presence.



WEB DEVELOPMENT



A major part of your role will be taking ownership of the ongoing development and improvement of our WordPress websites.



Your work will include:

- WordPress website development and maintenance

- Advanced Elementor / Elementor Pro development

- WooCommerce products, categories and shop development

- Building new landing pages and website sections

- WordPress theme and template customisation

- HTML and CSS development

- JavaScript modifications where required

- Responsive development across desktop, tablet and mobile

- Troubleshooting WordPress, plugin and layout problems

- Website speed and performance improvements

- UX and conversion improvements

- Managing redirects, URLs and website structure

- Implementing tracking scripts and website integrations

- Testing and deploying website changes



We particularly want someone who can be given an outcome such as “we need this page to work like this” and independently determine how to build it.



GRAPHIC DESIGN



You’ll also be an important internal resource for our graphic design and image production.



Your work will include:

- Adobe Photoshop – strong competency is essential

- Canva

- Website banners and hero graphics

- Product imagery

- Photo retouching and colour correction

- Background removal and image manipulation

- Corporate event photography enhancement

- Social media and advertising graphics

- Website icons and supporting graphics

- Sales and marketing collateral

- Maintaining consistency with our existing brand



We want someone with a good design eye, not simply someone who knows how to use Photoshop and Canva.



SEO & DIGITAL MARKETING



Our SEO strategy is managed by a specialist third-party agency, so you will NOT be responsible for developing our SEO strategy.



However, the Web Developer is a vital part of actually making that strategy happen.



You’ll work with our Australian Sales Manager and SEO specialists to implement recommendations including new landing pages, website structure changes, internal linking, redirects, technical fixes, content layouts, metadata, schema and other website improvements.



Basic SEO knowledge is highly desirable, but your primary responsibility is being able to correctly build and implement the required website changes.



SKILLS WE’RE LOOKING FOR



You should already be highly competent with:

- WordPress

- Elementor Pro

- WooCommerce

- HTML

- CSS

- Adobe Photoshop

- Canva

- Additional experience with JavaScript, PHP, Cloudflare, GA4, Google Tag Manager, technical SEO, website performance optimisation and Adobe Creative Cloud will be highly regarded.



We value people who can troubleshoot problems independently, research solutions and get things done without requiring constant step-by-step instructions.



SALARY & BENEFITS



AUD $1,000–$1,500 per month depending on demonstrated skills and experience.



The package also includes SSS, PhilHealth and Pag-IBIG.



This is a genuine full-time, long-term position with an established Australian company.



WORKING HOURS

- Monday–Friday

- 7:00 AM–3:30 PM Philippine Time

- This includes a 30-minute unpaid lunch break, providing 40 paid working hours per week.



These hours align with our Australian office, allowing you to work directly with our Sales Manager and Australian team throughout the working day.



ABOUT US



We are an established Australian company operating in the technology, IT rental and corporate events industry for 34 years.



Our business works with everything from laptops, computers and servers through to LED displays, touchscreens, audiovisual equipment and major corporate event technology.



We’re an established business that is actively investing in our websites, digital presence, technology and systems.



This isn't a role where you'll spend all day making minor content updates. We want someone who enjoys building things, solving problems and seeing their work have a direct impact on a real business.



IMPORTANT – PRACTICAL SKILLS TEST



Please only apply if you genuinely have the skills required for this position.



Shortlisted applicants will complete a practical skills examination / live demonstration BEFORE progressing to a formal interview.



You may be asked to demonstrate WordPress and Elementor development, troubleshoot a website problem, reproduce a supplied design, complete a Photoshop task or explain how you would approach a practical development problem.



Your CV and portfolio may get you through the door. Your demonstrated ability will determine whether you progress to interview.



We’re looking for someone who wants to become a long-term and important member of our team, take ownership of our websites and creative output, and see the direct impact of their work on a growing Australian business.

title: Shopify Product Page Builder (High-Volume Dropshipping)
description:
Salary: $600 USD/month



Schedule: Monday to Friday

8:00 AM – 5:00 PM (Philippine Time)



About Us



We are a fast-growing Shopify dropshipping brand specializing in men’s apparel.



Our team launches a high volume of new products every week, and we’re looking for an experienced Shopify Product Page Builder who can create professional, branded Shopify product pages quickly and accurately.

?

* Creating compelling product titles

?

* Shopify product creation

* Shopify Partner account

* 1688

* ChatGPT

* Gemini

* Google Sheets

* High-volume Shopify product listing

* Product image preparation

* Strong written English

* Excellent attention to detail



?



Please Do NOT Apply If



* You have only worked in customer service or order fulfillment.

* You have never created Shopify product pages from scratch.

* You have never worked with Shopify product variants.

* You are uncomfortable using AI tools as part of your daily workflow.

* You are not comfortable creating 10–15 complete Shopify product pages every day.

* You require constant supervision or detailed instructions to complete repetitive work accurately.



?

* Every tool you would use

* How you prepare the images

* How you create the content

* How you organize variants

* What you check before publishing



4.



How do you organize color and size variants inside Shopify to avoid customer mistakes?



5.



When a supplier provides Chinese clothing sizes, how do you prepare the sizing information for U.S. customers?



6.



What image dimensions do you normally upload to Shopify, and why?



7.



Which AI tools do you use most often while creating Shopify product pages? Explain exactly how you use them.



8.



When creating 10–15 Shopify product pages in one day, how do you maintain the same quality on the last product as you did on the first?



9.



What are the five most common mistakes people make when creating Shopify product pages?



10.



Why do you believe you are a good fit for this position?



?



We’re looking for someone who enjoys building high-quality Shopify product pages, works efficiently, pays close attention to detail, and wants to grow with our company for the long term.

title: Local SEO, Google business profile & AI Search Specialist
description:
Local SEO, Google business profile & AI Search Specialist



100% Remote | 15–25 Hours/Week Initially → Expected Full-Time

Base Pay: $4–$6 USD/hour DOE + Significant Performance Bonuses

Strong performers may earn approximately $8–$12+ USD/hour total compensation



Hunt Glass is a growing U.S. auto glass company building an all-star marketing team.



Our goal is to become the leading auto glass company in Utah, then expand nationally.



We are looking for an exceptional Local SEO & AI Search Specialist who can help make Hunt Glass easy to find across Google Search, Google Maps, Google Business Profiles, our website, and AI-powered search.



Our focus is not vanity metrics:



Search Visibility → Qualified Leads → Scheduled Jobs → Revenue & Profit



What You'll Do



Create, verify, optimize, and manage Google Business Profiles as Hunt Glass expands into new eligible locations and markets



Develop and execute our Google Business Profile and Google Maps strategy



Improve local-search rankings and generate qualified local leads



Grow organic Google rankings and qualified website traffic



Own the SEO strategy for our website



Improve on-page SEO, search intent, internal linking, and SEO-focused content



Identify and prioritize service, location, and search-intent pages based on their potential to generate customers and revenue



Research high-value keywords, competitors, services, and geographic opportunities



Help plan organic-search expansion into new markets



Develop strategies for generating and leveraging customer reviews



Track rankings, calls, leads, and organic/local-search performance



Identify which SEO efforts are actually producing customers



Improve Hunt Glass's visibility in AI-powered search and recommendations



Use AI extensively to improve research, analysis, productivity, and results



Work with our CRO/Landing Page Specialist so website changes improve both search visibility and conversion





What We're Looking For



Proven local SEO and Google Business Profile results



Strong experience creating, verifying, optimizing, and managing Google Business Profiles



Strong understanding of Google Maps/local search



Proven organic SEO results



Experience generating leads for local businesses
