Strong analytical and problem-solving skills



Excellent organization and English



High proficiency using AI for SEO



Experience or strong interest in AI Search / GEO / AEO





Most importantly, we want someone who can demonstrate real, measurable business results.



Compensation & Growth



Base Pay: $4–$6 USD/hour DOE + significant performance bonuses



We are building an all-star team and want exceptional people to be rewarded for exceptional results.



Someone producing outstanding measurable results may earn approximately $8–$12+ USD/hour total compensation.



Performance bonuses will be based on meaningful, clearly defined business outcomes—not simply hours worked, impressions, rankings, or other vanity metrics.



This position will begin at approximately 15–25 hours/week and is expected to grow into a full-time, long-term position of approximately 40 hours/week as Hunt Glass expands.



We want someone who wants to grow with the company, take increasing ownership, and be rewarded as their impact grows.



How to Apply



Please answer all 10 questions and number your answers.



1. How many years of professional local SEO, Google Business Profile, and organic SEO experience do you have?





2. Describe your best measurable Google Business Profile / Google Maps result. Include the type of business, starting point, ending result, timeframe, and exactly what you personally did.

6. Rate your AI proficiency from 1–10. Which AI tools do you use for SEO, what do you use them for, and how do they improve your results or productivity?

title: Off-Page SEO Specialist – Link Building & Local SEO
description:
Hickey Marketing Group is looking for an experienced Off-Page SEO Specialist to join our team.



We’re a digital marketing agency working with clients in different industries, and we’re looking for someone who can take ownership of the off-page side of SEO and work alongside our on-page SEO, content, and web development teams.



We’re looking for someone with actual hands-on experience in link building. We don't want hundreds of backlinks just for the sake of having them. We want someone who knows how to research a client, look at their competitors, find good opportunities, and build links that actually make sense for the business.



What you'll be doing:



→ Researching and building quality backlinks for our clients

→ Finding link opportunities based on the client's industry, location, and competitors

→ Reaching out to relevant websites, publications, organizations, local businesses, and potential partners

→ Managing local citations and keeping business information consistent

→ Reviewing existing backlinks and identifying low-quality or spammy links

→ Researching competitor backlinks and finding opportunities we may be missing

→ Tracking backlinks, including the source, target page, anchor text, date completed, and current status

→ Checking that previously built backlinks are still live

→ Monitoring rankings and off-page SEO performance

→ Helping investigate ranking drops or changes that may be related to off-page SEO

→ Providing recommendations on what should be worked on next

→ Keeping clear records of completed, pending, and planned work

→ Communicating with our on-page SEO, content, and web development teams when needed



What we're looking for:



You should already have hands-on experience with Off-Page SEO and be comfortable working independently without needing step-by-step instructions.



You should have a good understanding of:



→ Link building

→ Backlink quality and relevance

→ Anchor text strategy

→ Competitor backlink analysis

→ Competitor research

→ Guest posting

→ Outreach and link acquisition

→ Broken-link building

→ Brand mentions and unlinked mention opportunities

→ Digital PR

→ Local SEO

→ Business listings and citations

→ Online reputation management

→ Backlink monitoring

→ Backlink audits

→ Relationship building for link opportunities

→ Identifying spammy or potentially harmful backlinks

→ How off-page SEO works together with on-page SEO and content



Experience with tools such as Moz, Ahrefs, SEMrush, BrightLocal, Google Search Console, or similar SEO tools is preferred. You don't need to know every tool, but you should be comfortable using SEO data to make decisions.



Being organized is also important. We work with multiple clients, so we need someone who properly tracks their work and can clearly show us what's been completed, what's pending, and what they plan to work on next.



One important thing:



We are not looking for someone whose entire link-building strategy is submitting websites to hundreds of directories. Directories and citations can be useful, especially for local SEO, but they shouldn't be the whole strategy. We would rather have fewer quality and relevant backlinks than hundreds of random links that don't provide any real value to the client.



How to Apply



Please send us:



→ A short introduction about yourself

→ Your Off-Page SEO experience

→ How many years you've been working in SEO

→ Examples of backlinks you've personally acquired

You and your counterpart will share the guest communications and reservations desk between you on staggered shifts, and each of you brings a second discipline to the team. Yours is bookkeeping. 



This is a genuine two-sided role. Half your week is guests and reservations. The other half is the books. Both halves matter and we staff, schedule, and measure them separately. 



 



An unusual note about experience 



You do not need vacation rental experience. We will teach you that half of the job. 



Guest communications and reservations are learnable, and we would rather train someone sharp, well-educated, and genuinely good with people than hire someone who already knows a different company's way of doing things. We have a structured six-to-eight week training program and we expect to use all of it. 



What we cannot teach is a strong accounting foundation, excellent English on the phone, and composure with a demanding guest. Bring those and we'll handle the rest. 



 



What you'll do 



Guest communications and reservations — 50% of your time 



Voice (roughly half of this half). You'll take inbound reservation calls through our phone system. Someone calls asking about a five-bedroom home over Presidents' Week — you find out what they actually need, walk them through the right properties, quote it, and book it. You'll also take service calls from guests already in a home. 



Online. Inquiries and messages by
, text, and through online websites (eg Airbnb). Pre-arrival questions: arrival instructions, ski storage, parking, altitude tips, restaurant recommendations. In-stay issues — triage, enter tickets for and/or route to our Park City operations and maintenance team, follow up until the guest confirms it's resolved. Post-stay follow-up. 



Reservations administration. Modifications, cancellations, ancillary sales, date changes, and payment processing in our property management system and change requests in 3rd party systems (eg Airbnb). Accurate booking records are the foundation everything else in the business sits on. 



Reason-coding. Every inquiry that doesn't book gets a reason — price, dates unavailable, wrong property type, no hot tub, too far from the lift. Every time. This is one of the most valuable things you'll do and almost nobody in our industry does it. 



Bookkeeping — 40% of your time 



Reconciliations. Guest payments, refunds, damage charges, security deposits, and chargebacks reconciled against the property management system and our merchant processors. 

Owner statement preparation. Reconcile monthly owner statements against reservations, folios, work orders, credit card charges and vendor invoices before they go out — merge interrelated work orders, find the miscoded fee, improve descriptions to be concise and clear, correct the maintenance bill posted to the wrong unit, ensure correct tax treatment of supplies and services. Homeowners read these closely; errors are expensive in trust, not just dollars. 

Accounts payable. Vendor invoice intake, coding, approval routing, and payment tracking. Maintain the documentation behind every owner-billable line item: invoice, work order, photos, owner approval on the estimate. 

Revenue audit. Spot-check that rates, fees, taxes, and discounts on bookings match what was quoted and what policy says. Adjust commissions as required for certain channels. Booking errors caught in week one cost nothing; caught at statement time they cost a phone call with an owner. 

Financial setup of new homes. Set up recurring charges, calculate and setup cleaning fees, set up applicable sales and lodging tax for the jurisdiction, set up commission split. 

Month-end close support. Work the close calendar, chase what's missing, hit the deadlines. Statement day does not move. 

Cost tracking. Work-order and vendor spend by property, so we can see which homes are expensive to run. 

Inventory Management. Entering inventory in the system 

QuickBooks.  Maintain accounting in QuickBooks. 

We have a financial operating system that assists with the processing a categorization of bills and payments, integrated into our system of record and QuickBooks. You are not building a parallel accounting system in spreadsheets, and tax decisions stay with our U.S. CPA. Your job is accuracy, evidence, and clean books. 



Making it better — 10% 



Document what you do. Recurring guest questions become templates; recurring reconciliation problems become process fixes. Cover your teammate's desk during their time off and peak weeks — you are each other's backup. 



 



What we're looking for you to bring 



Education 



Bachelor's degree in Accountancy, Management Accounting, Finance, or Business Administration. This is the one hard credential requirement. 

CPA, CPA candidate, or CMA is a strong plus but not required. 

Experience 



2+ years in bookkeeping, accounting, or finance. Enough that reconciliation, AP, and month-end close are familiar territory rather than concepts from a textbook. 

Language — this is the highest bar in the posting 



Excellent spoken English with a clear, neutral, easily understood accent. You will be on the phone with American guests spending thousands of dollars a week. We assess this on a live call. 

Excellent written English. Clear, warm, no errors. 

Foundation 



Genuine numeracy — you can look at two exports that don't match and methodically find out why. 

Excel or Google Sheets beyond the basics: pivot tables, lookups, comparing datasets. 

Working knowledge of accounting software (QuickBooks Online, Xero, NetSuite, SAP, or similar). 

Disposition 



Composure. When a guest is upset at 8 PM about a cold hot tub, you stay calm and useful. 

Coachability. We are going to teach you an industry. You need to take feedback well and get better fast. 

Comfortable saying "I don't know yet, I'll find out and come back to you by [time]" and then actually doing it. 

Self-directed. We don't use time-tracking software and we don't micromanage. We need someone who doesn't require either. 

Setup 



Wired internet, 25 Mbps down / 10 Mbps up minimum, with a backup connection. 

A quiet, enclosed room — this is a voice role and background noise is disqualifying. 

A UPS or backup power plan for storm season (June–November). 

A quality headset. We'll reimburse it. 

A real plus, though not required 



Vacation rental, short-term rental, hotel, resort, or property management experience — especially on the accounting side. If you've touched owner statements, trust accounting, or folio reconciliation, say so prominently. 

Vacation rental software: Streamline, Track, Guesty, Hostaway, OwnerRez, Buildium, AppFolio. 

BPO or call center experience on a U.S. voice account. 

Comfort with AI tools — we use them daily and expect you to. 

 



Schedule 



This role works U.S. Mountain Time hours. Park City is 14–15 hours behind the Philippines, so your working day will fall outside standard Philippine business hours — overnight or early morning, depending on the shift. A shift differential applies. 



We staff this desk with two people on staggered shifts, so that between them we cover our full guest day and our busiest check-in days have two people on. Which shift and which days you take depends on the pair we hire and on how demand moves through the year, and schedules can change with reasonable notice. Expect some weekend coverage. We confirm your exact hours and days before you start. 



The U.S. observes daylight saving time and the Philippines does not, so the Mountain Time equivalent shifts by one hour in March and November. We adjust the Philippine-time schedule so your hours stay consistent. 



Peak weeks — Christmas/New Year, Sundance, Presidents' Week, Spring Break — may require shifted coverage. We give advance notice and we pay a premium for it. 



 



Compensation 



$1,200 USD per month. 

13th month pay. 

15 days (3 weeks) paid time off per year, plus Philippine regular holidays. 

$25 monthly internet and power allowance. 

Headset reimbursement. 

Shift differential. 

Annual performance and salary review. 

We pay on time, every time, and we're looking for someone who wants this to be a career, not a stopover. 



 



What's hard about this job 



The guests are wealthy and their expectations are high. When something goes wrong at 8 PM in a $4M house, you're the first person they talk to, and "I'll look into it" is not an answer they accept gracefully. 



Park City is a place you've probably never been. You'll need to learn a mountain town's geography, seasons, and rhythms well enough to advise someone on where to stay and what to do — from the Philippines. The people who do this well get genuinely curious about the destination. 



And the job asks you to switch between two modes: the interrupt-driven phone and inbox, and focused reconciliation work that requires you to be careful and uninterrupted. We protect the second on your calendar, but you have to be someone who can make that switch cleanly. 



 



How to apply 



Start your application with the word POWDER so we know you read this. 



Send us: 



A short note (under 300 words): your accounting education and background, and where you've dealt with customers, clients, or the public directly. 

Your resume. 

A 60–90 second voice recording introducing yourself and telling us about a time you found and fixed a mistake in someone's numbers. Any format. This is required — we assess spoken English early because it's the hardest thing to teach. 

Applications without the keyword or without the voice recording will not be reviewed. 



Process: short screening call → work sample (a reconciliation exercise, two written guest messages, and a mock reservation call after we give you a property fact sheet) → final video interview with our leadership team. 



 



Luxury Mountain Destinations is an equal opportunity employer. We hire on demonstrated ability.

title: Exceptional Virtual Assistant for Airbnb Business - 4PM - 11PM PST
description:
Night Shift Operations Coordinator

Vo Rental ("Vo Place Like Home") — Anaheim, CA



ABOUT US



Vo Rental owns and manages a portfolio of roughly 50 short-term rental and residential properties. The core of the business is in Orange County — Anaheim, Garden Grove, Westminster, Santa Ana, Midway City — with additional homes in Las Vegas, Panama City and Panama City Beach, FL, and Kissimmee, FL. We run a cleaning team of about 19 people and turn over homes every single day of the year.



Our day shift gets the houses cleaned. Our night shift gets the guests in the door and sets up tomorrow. This is the second half of that.



THE ROLE



You take the handoff from the day shift at 4 PM — right as guests start arriving — and you carry the business through the evening. You get every arriving guest into their home, you build and send out tomorrow's cleaning schedule, and you catch the late bookings that land after everyone else has signed off. When you finish your shift, tomorrow is already set up.



SCHEDULE AND PAY



Hours: 4:00 PM – 11:00 PM PST (Pacific Standard Time, US West Coast)

Days: Wednesday through Monday. Tuesdays off.

Pay: $1,000 per month



WHAT YOU'LL DO



Guest arrivals



Guests check in from 4 PM onward. Make sure every one of them gets into their home: door codes, gate codes, parking, wifi, directions

Handle arrival problems fast — a code that isn't working, a house that isn't ready yet, a guest arriving at midnight

Answer messages on Airbnb, 
, and direct channels through the evening

Approve or decline early check-in and late checkout requests



Tomorrow's cleaning schedule



Build the next day's cleaning assignments across a team of about 19 cleaners and balance the load fairly

Send each cleaner her schedule for tomorrow, along with any special instructions — guest counts, supplies to leave, promised early check-in times, long stays

Confirm every checkout tomorrow has a cleaner on it



Late bookings



Reservations come in all evening. When one lands for tomorrow or the same day, make sure a cleaner is assigned and actually told

Update the calendars so the morning shift starts from an accurate picture



Claims and documentation



Work through the damage reports and photo documentation queued up during the day

Organize photos, timestamps, and receipts into the supporting file

Keep the claims tracker current



Records and handoff



Log the day's cleaner assignments and any changes

Maintain calendars, task lists, and property records

Leave a clean handoff for the morning: what happened, what's outstanding, what to watch



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Required



Fluent written and spoken English

Genuinely reliable with time. Guests arrive on a schedule and cleaners need tomorrow's assignments tonight — neither can wait.

Strong written communication — clear, short, warm messages to guests and to staff.

Calm under pressure. Most of what goes wrong in this business goes wrong in the evening, and you'll often be the only one on.

Comfortable working independently without being checked on.

Working knowledge of Google Calendar, Google Sheets or Excel, WhatsApp, and a shared task manager. You should be able to learn a property management system quickly.

Discretion. You will see guest information, addresses, access codes, and payment records.



Nice to have



Spanish. Much of our cleaning team communicates in Spanish, so it helps every day.

Prior short-term rental, property management, hospitality, or dispatch experience

Familiarity with Airbnb and 
 host tools

Experience coordinating field staff or contractors



Not required



A college degree

Prior experience with our specific software



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



First 30 days: You know the properties by name and can get any arriving guest into any house without help. You can build tomorrow's schedule with review.

First 60 days: The schedule goes out on time every night, correct, without anyone checking it. Guests get answers within minutes.

First 90 days: Nothing reaches the morning as a surprise. Late bookings are handled, cleaners know before they ask, and the handoff tells the day shift exactly what it needs.



TO APPLY



You must include a Loom video or a YouTube clip with your application. I will not entertain any proposal or applicant that does not include one.



In your video, introduce yourself and tell us about a time something went wrong late in the day and you had to solve it on your own — what happened, what you did, and how it turned out. Also confirm that you can work 4:00 PM – 11:00 PM PST, Wednesday through Monday.



You must spend at least 10 AP on this application, or it will not be reviewed.

title: Highly Wanted: Experienced CS Rep (Don't Reply If Inexperienced)
description:
We're Just Jenny, a beauty and wellness brand. We sell skincare tools, patches, serums and supplements to customers across Europe, and most of them are women in their 40s, 50s and 60s who just want to feel good in their own skin again.



Small team, no corporate nonsense, and a healthy amount of orders coming in every single day.



Those orders come with questions. "Where's my package?" "Can I change my address?" "How do I actually use this thing?" "I want my money back." That's where you come in.



We're looking for someone who takes real ownership of the inbox. Not someone who fires off canned replies, but someone who reads what the customer actually wrote, answers like a human being, and turns a grumpy "refund me now" into "oh nice, thanks for sorting that out."



One thing up front: this role is for people who have already done it. If you're brand new to customer support, we're not the right first stop for you.



What you'll be doing



Running the daily customer inbox in CommSlayer

Answering order and shipping questions, chasing track & trace, and staying on top of our suppliers and fulfilment partner when a package goes missing

Handling refund and return requests. Solve the actual problem first, reach for the refund button last

Filing and winning chargebacks in Shopify Payments and PayPal: gathering the evidence, writing the response, submitting well before the deadline

Answering product questions. Our customers are often trying something like this for the first time, so a little reassurance goes a long way

Spotting patterns. If 15 people
 about the same product this week, we want to hear it from you before we see it in the numbers



The two numbers we care about



Refund rate and chargeback rate. Keeping both as low as humanly possible, without ever being difficult with a customer, is basically the whole job. If that sounds like a fun puzzle instead of a headache, you're going to like it here. And yes, there's a bonus tied to it.



What we're looking for



1–2+ years in customer support for an e-commerce or dropshipping brand. You know what a "where is my order" wave feels like

Real hands-on experience with chargebacks and disputes. Not "I've heard of them" but "I've won them"

Comfortable, natural written English. Warm and clear, not stiff and corporate

Reliability. This is a daily job, weekends included. Not a "I'll batch it on Friday" situation

Experience with CommSlayer is a big plus. Used Gorgias, Zendesk, Reamaze or Richpanel instead and you pick things up fast? Still apply

Nice to have: Shopify experience, and any tools you've used to fight disputes



The details



Part-time to start, around 2–4 hours a day, 7 days a week (weekends are lighter)

Competitive hourly rate plus a bonus structure tied to your refund and chargeback numbers. Do the job well and you earn more

Nothing in the inbox sits longer than 10 hours. That's the one hard rule

100% remote. Beyond that response time, you pick your own hours

Room to grow, and we mean it. As our volume goes up we'll give you more hours and review your rate along with it. The plan is for this person to grow into owning our whole support operation, and eventually to help us build out the team

Long-term. We're not looking for a two-month patch

Start date: ASAP



How to apply



Skip the cover letter, we won't read it. Send us a 30-second video instead.



Film it on your phone, don't overthink it, and don't script it word for word. We're not judging your camera. We just want to hear you talk. In those 30 seconds, tell us:



Who you are

Why you want to work with us

Why YOU are better than other CS reps



That third one is the one that matters. Be specific. "I'm hardworking and detail-oriented" tells us nothing. "I brought a client's chargeback rate from 1.2% to 0.4% in four months" tells us everything.



How to send the video



Upload it to Google Drive and send us the link.



Set the sharing to "Anyone with the link" before you send it. This is important. If we click your link and get an access request screen, we move on to the next applicant. We're not chasing permissions. Test it yourself first: open your own link in a private/incognito window. If the video plays, you're good.



If your video lands well, we'll set up a short call.

title: Full-Time WFH Technical Onboarding Specialist — $900 Base + Bonuses
description:
We are hiring a Technical Onboarding Manager (TOM).



Your job is to guide new clients through their first 48 hours inside the program. You remove confusion, fix tech issues, assign the right 1:1 Coach, and make sure clients are fully set up before strategy begins.



This is not a passive support role. You are responsible for structure, clarity, activation speed, and client confidence.



This is a client-facing role. You must be clear, confident, calm, and reliable.



Most of our clients are 45+ and not tech-savvy. Patience and strong communication are required.



BENEFITS



- Salary: $900 per month

- Payment: Twice a month via Wise. Always on time.

- Performance bonuses based on CSAT (client rating) and CSQ (coach rating)

- OTE: $1,050–$1,400/month

- Bonus tiers from $30–$100 per category (minimum 20 surveys / 20 handoffs per month)

- Fully remote, long-term role

- Clear scorecard and monthly reviews

- Career growth path (Senior TOM, Lead TOM, CSM)

- 4,000+ clients served since 2019



SCHEDULE



- Full-time: 7.5 hours a day; 37.5 hours/week

- No fixed shift required. You may work a straight or split shift.

- You must attend team meetings (usually 3pm CET)

- Work 7.5 total hours per day within the 8 AM ET to 2 AM ET coverage window, not across the entire window

- Confirm your preferred working hours during hiring

- Maintain a schedule that is sustainable long term



Consistently low energy or repeated mistakes caused by poor schedule management will be treated as performance issues.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run structured Activation Calls

- Fully activate every client within 48 hours. Activation means the client has access to Kajabi, Slack, the Client Master Sheet, AI tools (AVA & VERA), understands where everything is, has a Coach assigned, and has their Kickoff Call booked.

- Book Kickoff Call same day or next day

- Assign the correct 1:1 Coach based on phase, fluency, timezone, and availability

- Build authority for the assigned Coach so the client feels confident before strategy begins

- Ensure basic access or setup issues do not reach Coaches

- Update CRM immediately after each call

- Send clear handoff notes to Coaches

- Upload all call recordings

- Reply in #tech-support within 24 hours (weekdays)

- Onboard 20–25 clients per week. Activation Calls are structured and typically 30–45 minutes.

Some weeks are high-volume during promotions. Quality and clarity must remain strong under pressure.

- Keep your calendar accurate and available

- Proactively manage your calendar capacity and flag issues early

- Avoid repeated client-facing process errors



Main goal: Zero confusion for the client. No surprises for the Coach.



CORE STANDARDS



- 100% activation within 48 hours

- CSAT average 85%+

- No Kickoff Call no-shows

- Prevent basic technical escalations

- High CRM accuracy and immediate handoffs

- 24-hour Slack response time

- Reliable, consistent performance



REQUIREMENTS



- Strong customer support or onboarding experience

- C1 English or higher

- Calm with older or low-tech clients

- Comfortable repeating instructions clearly multiple times

- Follows SOPs and scripts closely

- Advanced Slack skills

- Comfortable with Kajabi, Google Drive, and Zoom

- Willing to learn basic creator tools

- Reliable internet, strong camera, proper lighting, and quiet workspace

- Strong schedule discipline



WE ARE NOT A FIT IF



- You are low energy or unclear

- You get frustrated with confused clients

- You cannot explain tech in simple words

- You struggle to follow structured processes

- You cannot consistently maintain agreed working hours

- You have poor camera, lighting, or internet setup



HOW TO APPLY



Fill in the form: 
/to/nI8lIXV4



In the Name field, write: “TOM” + Your First and Last Name



Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.



P.S. Once hired, you will be contracted under Social Influence Consulting LLC.

We also believe in rewarding employees who perform well, take initiative, grow their skills, and consistently contribute at a high level. There is real opportunity to grow with the company for someone who proves themselves.**



We are looking for someone who is **creative, fast, technically skilled and capable of turning a story into an image or video that makes people stop scrolling.**

title: TIKTOK SHOP/ META ADS EDITOR
description:
# TikTok Short-Form Video Editor — TikTok Shop / UGC



I’m looking for a **high-level short-form video editor** who understands how to edit specifically for **TikTok retention, engagement, and conversions**.



This is **not** a traditional video editing position. I’m looking for someone who understands why people stop scrolling, what keeps them watching, and how editing can make a TikTok Shop video perform better.



## What You’ll Be Editing



You’ll primarily edit:



* TikTok Shop product videos

* UGC-style advertisements

* Beauty, skincare, haircare, grooming, and lifestyle content

* Talking-head videos

* Product demonstrations

* Before/after style content where appropriate

* 15–60 second short-form videos



I will usually provide the **raw footage and overall concept**. Your job is to turn that footage into a polished, high-retention TikTok.



## Creative References & Inspiration



I need an editor who is comfortable working from **video inspiration and references**.



I should be able to send you examples of TikToks, Reels, ads, or specific edits and say:



**“I want this video edited similar to this style.”**



You should be able to study the reference and understand things like:



* Pacing

* Caption style

* Cuts and transitions

* Zooms and punch-ins

* B-roll placement

* Sound effects

* Graphics

* Hook structure

* Overall editing energy and flow



You should be able to take inspiration from the reference **without simply copying it**, and adapt that editing style to my own footage and content.



The goal is for me to be able to send you **raw footage + a reference video + basic instructions**, and have you understand the direction without needing excessive back-and-forth.



## The Editing Style I Want



I want editing that feels **native to TikTok**, not like a traditional commercial.



You should understand how to use:



* Strong visual hooks within the first 1–3 seconds

* Fast, natural cuts that remove unnecessary pauses

* Pattern interrupts to maintain attention

* Strategic punch-ins and zooms

* Clean, readable on-screen text

* Attention-grabbing text hooks

* Dynamic captions

* B-roll and product close-ups

* Images/graphics when they help explain a point

* Sound effects when appropriate

* TikTok-style pacing

* Music that complements the video without overpowering it

* Visual emphasis on important words or selling points



The goal is **high retention without making the video feel obnoxiously overedited**.



## Most Important Skill



You need to understand **short-form viewer psychology**.



I don't just want someone who knows how to use Premiere Pro or CapCut.



You should be able to look at raw footage and think:



**"What can I change here to stop someone from scrolling and keep them watching?"**



You should understand concepts like:



* Scroll stopping

* Curiosity

* Open loops

* Pattern interrupts

* Watch-time optimization

* Retention

* Pacing

* Product-focused storytelling

* Direct-response style editing



## Requirements



You should have experience editing content for at least one of the following:



* TikTok

* TikTok Shop

* Instagram Reels

* YouTube Shorts

* UGC advertisements

* Direct-response social media ads



**TikTok Shop or UGC editing experience is strongly preferred.**



You should also be:



* Reliable

* Easy to communicate with

* Able to follow an established editing style

* Able to recreate the feel of reference videos I provide

* Able to take direction without needing every individual edit explained

* Able to deliver consistently

* Comfortable receiving large amounts of raw footage

* Detail-oriented

* Able to turn around videos quickly



CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, or similar professional editing software is acceptable.



## What I DON'T Want



Please do not apply if your experience is primarily:



* Long-form YouTube videos

* Podcasts

* Weddings

* Cinematic videos

* Corporate videos

* Music videos



unless you also have a **strong short-form TikTok/Reels portfolio**.



I'm specifically looking for someone who understands **performance-focused short-form content**.



## Potential Long-Term Opportunity



I'm a high-volume content creator and regularly produce TikTok Shop videos.



I'm looking for someone I can potentially work with **long term**, so there will be consistent work available for the right editor.



As we develop a workflow, I want the editor to learn my style well enough that I can send over **raw footage and video inspiration**, and they can understand exactly how the finished video should look.



## How to Apply



Please send:



1. Your short-form editing portfolio

2. **3–5 of your BEST TikTok/Reels/Shorts edits**

3. Any TikTok Shop or UGC ads you've edited

4. The software you use

5. Your typical turnaround time

6. Your rate per short-form video

7. How many videos you can realistically edit per week



**Important:** Do not send me a portfolio with 50 videos and ask me to choose.



Send me the **3–5 videos that best demonstrate your ability to edit high-retention TikTok content.**

title: Social Media & Content Coordinator
description:
About Onsight Films



Onsight Films is a Sydney-based video production company creating strategic video content for brands and businesses.



We work across corporate video, branded content, product videos, social content, interviews and campaigns.



We’re looking for a creative and organised Social Media & Content Coordinator to help us consistently share the work we’re already producing, grow our online presence and keep Onsight visible even when our production team is busy shooting and editing.



The Role



You’ll work closely with our team to turn existing projects, behind-the-scenes content, completed videos, photos, ideas and business insights into regular social media content.



You won’t be expected to invent everything from scratch.



We’ll give you access to our content, projects, brand guidelines and content creation tools. Your job is to help turn that material into engaging posts and keep our social channels active and consistent.



You’ll prepare content for approval before anything is published.



What You’ll Be Doing



* Create and prepare social media posts for LinkedIn, Instagram,
 and 

* Turn completed Onsight projects into social content

* Create project showcases and case-study style posts

* Turn behind-the-scenes photos and videos into posts

* Create short-form video/Reels/TikTok content from existing footage

* Write captions and post copy in Onsight’s tone of voice

* Create simple graphics/carousels where appropriate

* Repurpose one piece of content across different platforms rather than simply posting the exact same thing everywhere

* Use our internal Onsight Social Content Creator and AI tools to help develop content

* Upload and schedule approved posts through Buffer

* Maintain a simple weekly/monthly content calendar

* Keep track of what’s been posted and what content is available

* Identify older projects or content that could be repurposed

* Suggest content ideas based on the work Onsight is currently doing

* Research relevant social trends and formats we could use

* Help maintain a consistent posting rhythm even when our production team is busy



The Kind of Content You’ll Create



Content may include:



Our Work

Project showcases, finished videos, campaign highlights and case studies.



Behind the Scenes

Shoot days, cameras, lighting setups, production moments, editing and post-production.



Educational Content

Video marketing tips, production advice and useful insights for businesses considering video.



Onsight Insights

Our thoughts on video strategy, storytelling, content creation and what makes business video actually work.



Short-Form Content

Reels, TikToks, clips and vertical edits created from existing footage.



Company Content

Updates about Onsight, our team, new projects, milestones and what’s happening behind the scenes.



What We’re Looking For



You don’t need to be an expert filmmaker, but you should have a strong eye for content and understand what makes social media feel polished and engaging.



Ideally, you:



* Have experience managing social media accounts

* Have good written English

* Can write natural, professional captions without sounding overly corporate or AI-generated

* Understand LinkedIn, Instagram and TikTok

* Have basic graphic design skills

* Can use Canva or similar design tools

* Have basic short-form video editing skills

* Understand vertical video, Reels and TikTok formatting

* Are comfortable using AI tools such as ChatGPT

* Are organised and can work independently

* Have good attention to detail

* Can follow an established brand style

* Are comfortable receiving feedback and making revisions



Experience with Buffer, Canva, CapCut, Adobe Premiere, Final Cut Pro or similar tools is a bonus.



Experience working with a creative agency, production company or marketing agency would also be highly regarded.



How We’d Work Together



You’ll be given access to:



* Onsight’s approved social media assets

* Previous projects and completed videos

* Behind-the-scenes photos and footage

* Brand guidelines

* Content ideas and information from our team

* Our internal Onsight Social Content Creator

* Buffer for preparing and scheduling posts



You’ll prepare content and place it into our approval workflow.



Nothing needs to be published without approval.



Once approved, posts can be scheduled and published through Buffer.



The goal is to build a system where our team can concentrate on producing great work while you make sure we’re consistently showing that work to the world.



Hours



Initially, we’re looking for someone part-time, approximately 10–15 hours per week.



We’re more interested in consistency and quality than someone simply filling hours.



There is potential for the role to grow as Onsight grows.



Location - Remote.



You’ll need reliable internet and be comfortable communicating online with our Sydney-based team.



To Apply



Please send us:



1. A short introduction about yourself

2. Your previous social media/content experience

3. Examples of social media accounts or content you’ve worked on

4. Examples of graphics, Reels or TikToks you’ve created

5. The tools you normally use

6. Your expected hourly rate

7. Your weekly availability



Small Application Task



Please also take a look at Onsight Films and give us three social media post ideas you would create for our business.



We’re not looking for perfect answers.



We want to see how you think, what you notice about our business and how you’d approach turning our work into interesting content.



Please don’t send a generic AI-generated application. We’d much rather hear from you in your own words.

title: Creative Strategist - DTC / E-Commerce (Remote, Freelance)
description:
Growing creative studio producing performance ads for DTC brands on Meta is looking for a creative strategist who can concept, write, and produce ad creative using AI tools. This is not a traditional design role. We care about marketing fundamentals, strong copy, and the ability to turn strategy into finished static ads and video scripts, not your Photoshop skills.

You'll be building ad concepts from the ground up. That means researching the brand and audience, writing the messaging, choosing the format, generating the visuals using AI tools, and delivering final assets ready to upload. We need someone who can think strategically about why an ad will work and then actually build it themselves, not just hand off a brief to someone else.

The brands we work with are DTC and e-commerce. The ads we make are intentionally raw, native, and ugly. Notes app screenshots, tweet style posts, fake text threads, comparison graphics, AI generated visuals, UGC style statics. If it looks like a real person posted it instead of a brand designing it, that's the goal. We also write scripts for UGC video ads and AI voiceover videos, so you need to be comfortable writing for both static and video formats.

AI is central to how we work. We use AI tools to generate visuals, write variations, build statics, and produce content faster than traditional workflows allow. If you're not already using AI tools daily in your creative process, this isn't the right fit. We're looking for someone who's ahead of the curve, not someone who needs to be convinced that AI is useful.

What you'll be doing



Concepting static ad ideas based on brand research, customer data, and performance insights

Writing headlines, ad copy, and full video scripts for DTC brands

Generating finished static ads using AI tools and Canva

Writing UGC video scripts and AI voiceover scripts with hook variations

Working from creative strategy documents and also building your own concepts independently

Producing 15-20+ static creatives and 5-10 video scripts per week across client accounts

Reviewing ad performance data and using it to inform what you create next

Iterating on winning concepts with new angles, formats, and variations



What you need



Experience in DTC or e-commerce advertising, specifically creating ads that ran on Meta or TikTok with real spend

Strong copywriting skills. You understand hooks, awareness stages, pain points, desire language, and how to write for someone who's never heard of the brand

Daily use of AI tools in your creative workflow. Whether that's Midjourney, ChatGPT, Claude, Runway, Flux, Ideogram, or whatever else you use, we need someone who's already deep in AI, not just experimenting

Understanding of direct response fundamentals. You know why an ad works, not just what it looks like. You can look at performance data and make creative decisions based on it

Ability to concept independently. We'll train you on our systems and strategy frameworks, but you need to be able to take a brand's research and come up with original ad concepts on your own

Self driven and communicative. You're active in our workflow daily, responsive, and proactive about flagging ideas or issues



What you don't need



Advanced graphic design skills. We don't use Photoshop or Illustrator. AI tools and Canva handle production

A portfolio of polished brand work. We make ugly ads intentionally. If your portfolio is full of clean corporate design, this probably isn't your lane

Video editing skills. We have a dedicated editor. You write the scripts and concepts, someone else cuts the footage



Bonus



You've worked at or with a DTC ad agency before

You understand Meta's ad delivery system and why creative diversity matters

You've written UGC scripts that were filmed by real creators

You follow the DTC ad space closely and can name 5 brands running great creative right now

You've used AI to build entire ad concepts end to end, not just generate images



Details



Remote, freelance

Monthly retainer with growth as client volume increases

Consistent weekly workload across multiple client accounts

Opportunity to grow into a senior role as the studio scales



To apply

D
 with:



3-5 examples of static ads or video scripts you've created for DTC or e-commerce brands

Which AI tools you use daily and how they fit into your workflow

One sentence on what makes a static ad stop the scroll

title: DTC Performance Video Editor (Remote, Freelance)

If you've never thought about how your editing decisions affect thumb stop rates, hold rates, and CPAs, this isn't the right fit.

title: GoHighLevel CRM & Revenue Operations Specialist
description:
GoHighLevel CRM & Revenue Operations Specialist

BKT Ventures · B2B haircare · Sydney-based, remote-friendly · Contract engagement with potential to extend





About the role

GoHighLevel has become the spine of how we sell, onboard and retain across our B2B business — but right now it runs as a collection of individual workflows rather than one connected system. We're looking for someone who can see the whole picture: audit how the platform is actually being used, connect it properly to Shopify and our wholesale application, and turn the data it holds into dashboards that management and the sales team can act on without stitching numbers together by hand.



This is a systems-and-numbers role, not a workflow-building one. You'll own how our platforms talk to each other, what data we capture, and how we measure the journey from a
 ad through to a repeat wholesale order. The distinction matters, so we've made it explicit at the bottom of this brief.



What GoHighLevel does for us today:



Captures and manages leads from
 and Instagram advertising

Supports our Shopify B2B trade-account journey

Runs welcome and nurture flows

Manages our education and BKT Mastery journeys

Powers outbound sales calls and follow-up tracking

Handles social media messages and comments

Segments customers and leads

Supports our wholesale and distributor pipelines



Our stack: GoHighLevel (CRM/automation), Shopify (B2B trade store), 
 (primary integration layer), plus Xero, Gorgias and a wholesale-application flow feeding into the above.





What you'll own

1. Audit the complete customer journey. Map every stage from acquisition to retention —
/Instagram ad → Become a Stockist page → Shopify trade-account application → wholesale approval → GoHighLevel contact creation and tagging → welcome flow → sales follow-up → first order → repeat order → retention. Then pinpoint where it's leaking: where leads get lost, where data is missing or duplicated, whether tags and fields are applied correctly, whether each lead enters the right workflow, whether the sales team can see the next required action, and whether conversions can be attributed to the correct source and campaign.



2. Integrate Shopify, the wholesale app and GoHighLevel. Review our current integrations and recommend the most reliable way to connect these systems — via native integrations, APIs, webhooks or 
 (Zapier where appropriate). The goal is trustworthy visibility into things we currently can't see cleanly: new trade-account applications by day/week/month, application source, approval and rejection status, approved accounts that haven't ordered, time from application to approval, time from approval to first order, first-order conversion rate, average first-order value, repeat-purchase rate, and inactive or at-risk wholesale customers.



3. Build dashboards management can d
 from. Clear, self-serve dashboards across five areas:



Lead acquisition — volume by day/week/month, source/channel/campaign/ad, cost per lead where ad data exists, Become a Stockist applications, lead quality by source, and duplicate/incomplete/invalid leads.

Wholesale pipeline — new applications, awaiting review, approved vs declined, approved-but-not-ordered, lead-to-approval and approval-to-first-order conversion, average time to first order, revenue by acquisition source, and repeat/reactivation performance.

Sales activity — calls made, contact rate, follow-ups completed vs overdue, lead response time, appointments booked, stage conversion, conversion by salesperson, lost-lead reasons, and revenue influenced by follow-up.

Automations & welcome flows — contacts entering each workflow,
/SMS delivery, opens/clicks, replies, unsubscribes, first orders generated, revenue influenced, conversion by message and by workflow, and drop-off points.

Distributor pipeline — prospects by country/territory, current stage, last contact and next action, estimated value, samples/proposals sent, negotiation status, expected decision date, won/lost with reasons, conversion by country and stage, and revenue from active distributors.



4. Rebuild segmentation. Turn our existing data into commercially useful segments — new leads, trade applicants, awaiting approval, approved-not-purchased, first-time buyers, repeat wholesale, high-value, approaching reorder, lapsed/inactive, Education/Mastery participants, salon partners, distributor prospects, active distributors — cut further by country, source and product interest.



5. Measure workflow-generated revenue. Give us a real attribution method for our welcome, nurture, reactivation and education flows: how many entered each flow, how many completed the intended action, how many ordered, how much revenue resulted, how long conversion took, which messages influenced it, which audiences convert best, and which workflows to improve, stop or expand.



6. Recommend what's next. Once you understand the business, propose further ways GoHighLevel can lift lead management, sales follow-up, onboarding, wholesale activation, retention, distributor management, Education/Mastery journeys, social communication, customer service, reporting and internal accountability — prioritised by expected impact, cost and implementation complexity.





What you'll deliver

The initial engagement produces:



A complete audit of the current GoHighLevel account

A customer-journey and data-flow map

A prioritised list of tracking, data and integration gaps

A recommended CRM and integration architecture

A defined KPI and reporting framework

Working wholesale, sales, automation and distributor dashboards

Improved pipeline stages, tags, fields and segmentation

Conversion and revenue attribution for priority workflows

Tested, verified integrations and automations

Written documentation and recorded team training

A 30-, 60- and 90-day optimisation roadmap





What you bring

This is the line between the specialist we need and someone who builds basic workflows. You can demonstrate that you have previously:



Connected GoHighLevel with Shopify or another e-commerce platform in a live sales operation

Designed CRM architecture for a real sales team, not just individual funnels

Built management dashboards that drove commercial decisions

Tracked leads from acquisition all the way through to revenue

Measured automation performance and conversion, not just delivery

Diagnosed and fixed missing, duplicated or unreliable data



Core capabilities



Advanced, hands-on GoHighLevel expertise (CRM architecture, pipelines, automations, reporting)

Shopify and B2B/wholesale experience

Multi-platform integration via APIs, webhooks, 
 or Zapier

Lead attribution and conversion measurement across a full lifecycle

 and SMS automation

Strong grasp of sales funnels and customer-lifecycle management

Ability to translate business requirements into practical technical solutions

Clear documentation and team-training skills





The important distinction

This role is not suited to someone whose experience is limited to landing pages or basic
 workflows. We need someone who thinks in systems and revenue — who can look past the individual automation and tell us what data we need, where it should come from, how our platforms should communicate, and how that should surface as decisions we can make.





Practical skills test (paid)

Shortlisted candidates complete a short paid test. Review our current journey from
 ad → Shopify trade-account application → GoHighLevel follow-up → first wholesale order, identify the main tracking gaps, and propose the fields, tags, pipeline stages, integrations and dashboard metrics needed to measure the complete journey. Present:



A basic customer-journey map

The five biggest current visibility risks

The data that must pass between each platform

Your proposed dashboard structure

How you'd attribute the first order to its original source and welcome flow

Your recommended implementation priorities



This quickly separates a genuine CRM and data specialist from someone who only knows how to build workflows.





How to apply

Send a short note on a comparable system you've built (ideally GoHighLevel + Shopify), the commercial result it produced, and your availability and rate for an initial project engagement.

title: Real Estate Caller & Marketing Assistant — Appointments, Ads & Automation
description:
We're a real estate tech company in Canada that runs paid ads and converts leads into booked appointments. We need someone based in the Philippines who can get on the phone, talk to real people, and book meetings — not someone who hides behind a screen all day.



About 80% of your calls will be warm — people who clicked our ads and already know who we are. The other 20% is cold outreach. Either way, you need to be comfortable picking up the phone, handling objections, and getting the appointment booked.



But this isn't just a calling role. We also need someone who understands the basics of marketing and automation — how ads generate leads, how a CRM works, how follow-up sequences run. You don't need to be an expert in any of it, but you need to get how the pieces connect. If you've never touched a CRM, never looked at an ad dashboard, and don't know what a follow-up sequence is — this isn't the role.



This is a long-term remote role with room to grow. We start at 4 hours a day and expand scope based on what you deliver.



What you'll do:

- Call leads generated from our paid ad campaigns and book appointments with real estate clients

- Follow up with prospects who didn't answer or need a second touch

- Handle inbound calls from people responding to our ads

- Update the CRM after every call — notes, status, next steps

- Help manage basic marketing tasks — scheduling posts, pulling ad reports, assisting with campaign setup

- Learn and use our automation tools to keep the pipeline moving





You're a fit if you:

- Have made real phone calls to real people in a work setting — not just chat or
 support

- Can handle rejection, pivot the conversation, and still book the appointment

- Understand the basics of digital marketing — you know what a
 ad is, what a landing page does, and how leads flow from an ad to a CRM

- Have used a CRM before (GoHighLevel, HubSpot, Salesforce — any of them)

- Are curious about AI and automation — you don't need to build it, but you want to understand how it works

- 4 hrs/day to start · scalable with performance

- 100% remote — work from home

- Performance bonuses for hitting booking targets

- Long-term opportunity — we're building a team, not filling a seat

title: Virtual Assistant – Administration & Operations Support
description:
We are an Australian-based service business looking for a reliable, highly organised and proactive Virtual Assistant to join our team and provide ongoing administrative, accounts and operational support.



Our business has grown quickly and, quite simply, some of our administration has not kept pace with that growth. We have a backlog of tasks to work through and need someone who is genuinely passionate about helping us get on top of things, get organised and stay organised.



This isn't a position where you'll be sitting around waiting for something to do. There is plenty to get stuck into!



A particularly important part of the role will be helping us improve our accounts receivable and chasing overdue customer accounts. We need someone who is comfortable being persistent, professional and consistent with follow-up and who gets satisfaction from seeing an overdue task list shrink.



You will work closely with and support our current Administration Manager, who handles the majority of our incoming phone calls and day-to-day customer communication. Your role will help take administrative pressure off our existing team, keep tasks moving and make sure important follow-ups don't fall through the cracks.



This is a hands-on role. We need someone who doesn't just complete the easy items on a task list, but takes ownership of tasks and follows them through until they are finished.



We are looking for someone who wants to become a long-term member of our team, learn our business and gradually take ownership of key administrative and operational tasks.



Key Responsibilities



Your role may include:



Working through existing administrative backlogs and helping us get systems and records up to date

Managing and responding to customer
s

Monitoring shared inboxes and ensuring enquiries are followed up

Supporting our Administration Manager with day-to-day administration

Preparing and sending quotes

Following up outstanding quotes until an outcome is received

Scheduling jobs and coordinating appointments

Updating customer and job information in SortScape CRM

Data entry and general administration

Preparing documents, spreadsheets and reports

Creating and sending customer invoices in Xero

Entering and managing supplier bills in Xero

Preparing and processing bill payments

Regularly reviewing outstanding accounts and actively chasing overdue invoices

Contacting customers professionally by
 and, when required, telephone regarding overdue accounts

Keeping clear records of account follow-ups and commitments to pay

Following up again when promised payments are not received

Assisting with accounts receivable and accounts payable

Reconciling and checking financial information as directed

Following up outstanding information from customers, suppliers or staff

Maintaining digital files and business records

Assisting with staff documentation and compliance records

Creating and updating procedures, forms and templates

Basic website and online content updates

Researching suppliers, products and business information

Keeping management aware of outstanding tasks, deadlines and follow-ups

Assisting management with day-to-day administrative tasks

Following tasks through from beginning to completion



The position will evolve as you learn the business, with the opportunity to take responsibility for more areas over time.



Getting Us Organised



This is an important part of the position.



Our business has outgrown some of our existing administrative processes.



We're busy, we've grown quickly, and there are areas where we need to catch up.



We aren't looking for someone who will be overwhelmed by seeing a backlog. We want someone who looks at it and immediately starts thinking:



“Right. Where do we start, what is most important, and how do we get this under control?”



We want someone who enjoys creating order, clearing outstanding tasks, building good systems and then keeping those systems running so we don't end up back where we started.



In particular, we need someone who will take ownership of overdue accounts.



That means regularly checking what's outstanding, contacting customers, recording follow-ups, following up promised payments and continuing to chase accounts professionally until they are resolved or need to be escalated to management.



We need someone who is polite but persistent. If an invoice is still outstanding, sending one
 and forgetting about it isn't enough.



Xero Experience Is Essential



Previous hands-on Xero experience is required for this position.



This is not a role where Xero will simply be used occasionally. You will be required to use Xero as part of your regular duties, including:



Customer invoicing

Entering and managing supplier bills

Preparing and processing bill payments

Accounts receivable

Accounts payable

Reviewing aged receivables and overdue accounts

Following up outstanding invoices

Checking account information

General Xero administration



You do not need to be a qualified bookkeeper or accountant, but you must already be comfortable working within Xero and understand basic bookkeeping and accounts processes.



Attention to detail is extremely important. You will be working with real customer, supplier and financial information, so accuracy and confidentiality are essential.



A Very Important Part of This Role: Follow-Through



Our management team is busy. Things move quickly and sometimes management may forget to respond to something, provide information or complete the next step of a task.



We need you to be relentless with follow-up.



If you are waiting for something from management, don't assume that because you've asked once, your job is finished.



Follow it up. Remind us. Keep it on your list. Ask again.



Keep chasing it until the task is completed.



The same applies to customers, suppliers, overdue accounts and outstanding administrative tasks.



We want someone who thinks:



“This is my task until it is finished.”



rather than:



“I sent an
, so I've done my part.”



A major part of your role will be helping us stay organised, keeping track of loose ends and making sure tasks don't disappear simply because everyone became busy.



Customer Communication & English



Our current Administration Manager handles the majority of our telephone calls, so this is not primarily a call-centre or phone-based position.



However, you must have excellent spoken and written English and be confident communicating professionally with Australian customers.



There will be occasions where you need to contact customers directly, particularly when following up overdue accounts, confirming information or assisting when our Administration Manager is unavailable.



You must therefore be comfortable speaking English on the phone and communicating clearly, naturally and professionally with customers.



Systems We Use



You must have previous experience using Xero.



Experience with some of the following would also be highly regarded:



SortScape CRM

Microsoft 365

Outlook

Word

Excel

OneDrive / SharePoint

Canva

Wix / WordPress

ChatGPT and other AI productivity tools



We don't expect applicants to already know SortScape, but you must be confident learning new software and processes.



About You



We are looking for someone who:



Has previous hands-on Xero experience

Has experience with accounts receivable and following up overdue invoices

Has excellent written and spoken English

Is highly organised and detail-focused

Enjoys turning a backlog into an organised, manageable system

Communicates clearly and professionally

Is confident speaking with Australian customers when required

Can be persistent with overdue accounts while remaining professional

Can work independently without needing constant supervision

Takes ownership of tasks from start to finish

Is persistent and confident with follow-ups

Isn't afraid to remind management when they owe you something

Keeps excellent task lists and records

Can manage multiple outstanding items without losing track of them

Is comfortable asking questions when something is unclear

Can follow procedures accurately

Notices when something has been missed and takes action

Can prioritise tasks in a busy environment

Is comfortable learning new systems

Has reliable internet and a suitable home working environment

Is dependable and accountable for their work



Most importantly, we want someone who thinks beyond the task immediately in front of them.



If you notice a customer hasn't been followed up, an invoice is overdue, a document is missing, an appointment hasn't been confirmed, management hasn't responded to something you need, or something simply doesn't look right, we want you to investigate it and follow it through.



Experience



Previous experience as a Virtual Assistant, Administrative Assistant, Executive Assistant, Accounts Assistant, Customer Service Representative or Operations Assistant is preferred.



Previous Xero experience is essential. Applications without Xero experience will not be considered.



Experience supporting an Australian business would be highly regarded.



Experience in trades, property services, landscaping, maintenance, cleaning, facilities management or another field-service business would also be an advantage.



Working Hours



The role will be remote from the Philippines and offers some flexibility around working hours. Beginning at 30hours a week there is room to increase for the right person.



We do require you to have regular availability during Australian business hours (Sydney time) for tasks that need to happen during the business day, including:



Responding to customer
s and enquiries

Following up overdue accounts

Contacting customers when required

Communicating with our Administration Manager and management team

Handling time-sensitive administrative tasks



However, not all of your work needs to be completed during Australian business hours.



Many administrative, Xero, data entry, reporting, document preparation and other back-office tasks can be completed at times that suit you.



We are happy to discuss a working arrangement that provides flexibility while ensuring our customers and Australian-based team receive the support they need during business hours.



There is potential for the position to grow in hours, responsibility and seniority as the business grows.



How to Apply



Please send:



A short introduction about yourself and your previous experience.

Your current location in the Philippines.

Your availability and preferred working hours.

Your expected hourly or monthly salary in PHP.

Details of any experience working with Australian businesses.

Details of your Xero experience, including the tasks you have personally completed within Xero.

Details of any experience you have managing accounts receivable and chasing overdue customer accounts.

The other software and systems you are confident using.

Your internet connection and backup arrangements if your primary internet or power is unavailable.



Please also answer these questions:



1. A customer
s saying they were expecting their gardening service today, but you can see their job is actually scheduled for tomorrow. What would you do?



2. Your manager asked you to prepare something for a customer, but you need information from the manager before you can finish it. You asked for the information yesterday and haven't received a response. What would you do next?



3. Briefly describe your previous Xero experience. What Xero tasks could you confidently complete without training?



4. You are reviewing Xero and find a customer invoice that is 45 days overdue. There are notes showing that the customer was
ed two weeks ago but there has been no response. What would you do next?



Please start your application with the words “OOT VA” so we know you have read the full advertisement.



We are looking for someone who wants to become part of our team for the long term, help us get organised, stay organised and keep things moving, rather than simply complete whatever task happens to land in front of them.

title: Accountant/Bookkeeper (US)
description:
APPLY HERE





At PIVOTL, we don’t just offer jobs; we build careers. We partner with high-growth US businesses and provide our team with the training, tools, and support needed to deliver exceptional financial insights.



We’re looking for a high-performing Accountant who wants more than routine bookkeeping. Someone ready to take ownership, contribute to financial strategy, and grow into a long-term, high-impact role.



The Opportunity

title: Cinematic Video Editor — Short-Form and Long-Form (Real Estate)

6. Proficient in DaVinci Resolve or Premiere Pro or similar

7. Strong English communication skills, able to write, speak, and understand clearly

8. Reliable internet and able to overlap with US Eastern hours

Nice to have

2. Knows how to use AI tools (Higgsfield, Veo, etc.)

title: Sales Representative — Setter & Closer
description:
About the Role

We partner with e-commerce wellness brands to sell high-ticket coaching programs to their existing product buyers. Our leads are warm — these are people who have already purchased a product and are looking for the next step. You are not cold calling strangers.



We have two sales tracks. You will be placed based on your strengths:

Track A — Setter: Contact warm leads, build rapport, qualify the buyer, and book a discovery call. You are the first voice the customer hears.

Track B — Closer: Run the discovery call, identify the buyer's goals and pain points, present the right coaching offer, and close the sale. You are the last voice before payment goes through.



What You Will Do

Make outbound calls to warm product buyers on behalf of our brand partners

Follow proven call scripts while adapting naturally to each conversation

Run discovery conversations to identify buyer goals and obstacles

Present coaching offers clearly and confidently

Handle objections with empathy and logic — no pressure tactics

Send SMS checkout links immediately after verbal agreement on the call

Log every call outcome in the CRM accurately and on time

Participate in daily team huddles and weekly performance reviews



What We Are Looking For

1+ year of outbound sales, phone sales, or call center experience

Confident, warm, and natural on the phone — not robotic or scripted

Resilient — you do not take rejection personally

Coachable — you listen to feedback and implement it immediately

Reliable — you log your calls, you show up, you do the work

Experience in health, wellness, or coaching sales is a plus

Fluent English — additional languages (French, Spanish, Italian) are a bonus



What You Get

Base pay + uncapped commission on every close

Full training provided — scripts, objection handling, product knowledge

Clear career path: top setters become closers, top closers become team leads

Remote — work from anywhere

Weekly performance bonuses for top converters



To Apply

Send a 60-second voice memo introducing yourself and explaining why you are the right person for this role. Applications without a voice memo will not be considered.

title: Senior Electrical Drafter (AutoCAD)
description:
I am looking for a Senior Electrical Drafter to work directly with us on a flexible, project-by-project basis. This role is ideal for a self-managed professional who excels at transforming technical briefs into precise, production-ready drawings while maintaining high-quality CAD standards.



Key Responsibilities:

- Produce electrical schematics and wiring diagrams in AutoCAD from briefs, mark-ups, and reference designs.

- Prepare single-line diagrams strictly adhering to relevant Australian standards and drafting conventions.

- Generate accurate bills of materials (BOM) directly from completed drawings.

- Revise, update, and clean up drawings based on red-line mark-ups and design changes.

- Thoroughly check all drawings for accuracy, consistency, and completeness before final issue.

- Create and maintain standard AutoCAD templates, title blocks, and drawing borders for the business from scratch.

- Develop and document internal style guides covering layers, symbols, text, and dimensioning conventions.

- Build, organize, and manage functional symbol and block libraries for electrical components.

- Keep all drawing files clean, well-structured, and consistently named.

- Recommend drafting workflow and efficiency improvements as the engagement matures.

-  Scope each job from the brief, confirm technical requirements, and proactively flag ambiguities before starting.

- Provide realistic time estimates per job and consistently deliver within agreed turnaround times.



Required (Must-Haves)

AutoCAD Mastery: Senior-level AutoCAD proficiency paired with substantial, hands-on electrical drafting experience.

Drawing Track Record: Proven history of personally producing schematics, wiring diagrams, and single-line diagrams.

Library Creation: Experience creating CAD templates, style guides, and symbol libraries from scratch.

Standards & Conventions: Strong understanding of electrical drafting conventions and the verified ability to work to Australian standards.

Data Accuracy: Highly accurate BOM generation capabilities and meticulous attention to detail.

Communication: Clear written and spoken English with highly responsive communication across time zones.

Reliability: Completely self-managed, dependable, and comfortable working on a variable, project-based workload.



Desirable (Nice-to-Haves)

Advanced Toolsets: Hands-on experience with AutoCAD Electrical or similar specialized electrical CAD software.

Industry Background: Professional background in industrial controls, switchboards, automation, or building services.

Compliance Knowledge: Strong familiarity with AS/NZS 3000 and related Australian electrical standards.

Remote History: Prior experience successfully handling remote, project-based work for Australian engineering or controls businesses.



To be considered:

1. Years of Experience: Specify your total years of experience working as a CAD Draftsperson specifically for Australian clients or projects.

2. Tool & Software List: List the CAD software versions, specialized toolsets, and project management platforms you are most proficient with.

3. Portfolio: Provide a link to your ready-to-review portfolio, including samples of electrical schematics, single-line diagrams, or formatting examples you have personally produced.

title: Loan Processor
description:
Loan Processor Job Description



• Conduct detailed serviceability checks to confirm applicants can meet repayment obligations, using relevant calculators and tools.

• Check loan scenarios against individual lender credit policies to confirm eligibility and identify potential issues before proceeding.

• Research and compare suitable lender products, interest rates, and policies to identify the best-fit options for each client's circumstances.

• Evaluate the financial position of loan applicants to determine borrowing capacity, analysing income, expenses, and existing debt obligations.

• Collect all required documents from loan applicants, including income statements, credit reports, and identification documents, and verify their authenticity and completeness.

• Prepare loan proposals presenting suitable lender options based on the client's situation and lender policies, and ensure all proposals are reviewed with the broker.

• Ensure all documents are accurate, complete, and meet lender requirements prior to lodgement.

• Input client and loan data accurately into CRM systems and submit applications to lenders via the appropriate online portals.

• Act as the central point of contact for brokers, clients, and lenders throughout the application process, providing timely progress updates and addressing queries accurately.

• Follow up with lenders and/or clients via phone or
 for updates and outstanding requirements.

• Coordinate with underwriters, brokers, and internal tea
mbers to resolve any issues arising during assessment or processing.

• Continuously develop and maintain knowledge of lender policies, products, and credit criteria through training and self-study.

• Follow up all cases from formal approval through to settlement, including checking loan documents upon issuance and following up on outstanding settlement conditions.

• Ensure the outgoing financier (OFI) is ready for settlement where applicable (refinances).

• Advise clients on funds required to complete settlement, and liaise with all relevant parties — solicitors, lenders, and agents — to ensure files are ready.

• Notify clients once settlement is booked, send settlement breakdowns, and complete the settlement checklist in the system.

• Set up post-settlement action plans and support clients with ongoing loan maintenance enquiries and requests.

• Follow up with clients every six months, handle loan change requests, and apply and confirm cash rebates.

• Conduct birthday and annual reviews, including follow-up on fixed rate expiries.

• Manage construction progress drawdowns: collect and follow up on construction document checklists, follow up on commencement letters, and track construction progress through to completion.



Qualifications:

• Minimum 2–3 years of Australian mortgage broking or lending experience.

• Demonstrated experience with Australian Mortgage CRM platforms (e.g., Mercury, MyCRM, Salestrekker, Flex)

• Strong understanding of lender credit policies, serviceability requirements, and loan structures.

• Excellent attention to detail and accuracy in data entry and document management.

• High level of written and spoken English communication skills.

• Analytical mindset with strong numeracy skills.

• Excellent problem-solving ability and a proactive, solutions-focused approach.

• Ability to manage multiple files simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.

• Strong interpersonal skills and a client-first approach.

HTML, CSS and basic JavaScript knowledge

Experience configuring Shopify discounts and promotional offers

Experience with B2B or wholesale Shopify stores

Experience managing Shopify wholesale apps

Strong testing and quality-control skills

Build a promotional landing page

About Us

The Blog Content Coordinator supports the production and publishing of engaging blog and video content. The ideal candidate is highly organized, has a good eye for design and video quality, and understands the fundamentals of effective digital content. They should be able to recognize when an AI-generated video looks or sounds unnatural and identify issues such as mispronunciations, awkward movements, unusual sounds, or other inconsistencies before the content moves forward for review and publishing. While this is not a client-facing role, the position requires decent English communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with writers and other members of the content team. 

 

Responsibilities: 



Content Asset Creation

AI Video Production

● Troubleshoot basic issues encountered during the video generation process.

● Identify and flag issues such as:

    ○ Visual inconsistencies
